"""
Module: core/time_utils.py

Purpose: High-Performance Multi-Asset Timekeeper, Exchange Session Engine & Market State Provider.
         Single Source of Truth for: "WHAT TIME / SESSION STATE IS IT?"
         (Never decides trading actions, position migrations, or risk decisions).

Design Principles:
  1. High Performance by Default: O(1) in-memory hot-path operations, zero I/O or network on tick paths.
  2. Canonical UTC Internally: UTC is standard; exchange-local timezones applied at session boundaries.
  3. Rich MarketStatus & Explainability: OPEN, CLOSED, PRE_OPEN, POST_MARKET, SPECIAL_SESSION, HALTED, UNKNOWN.
     Provides explicit provenance: "Why is the market in this state?"
  4. Extensible Exchange Session Registry: Multi-session support (MCX morning/evening, US pre/after, Crypto 24/7).
  5. Multi-Asset Trading Date & Session IDs: Unique session_id for reliable database joins and research.
  6. Zero Business Logic: Does not decide what to trade or when to square-off. Pure time & session state only.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, date, time, timezone, timedelta
from enum import Enum
import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# â”€â”€ 1. TIMEZONES & CANONICAL TIME â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

UTC = timezone.utc

try:
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    IST = ZoneInfo('Asia/Kolkata')
    EST = ZoneInfo('America/New_York')
except ImportError:
    try:
        import pytz
        IST = pytz.timezone('Asia/Kolkata')
        EST = pytz.timezone('America/New_York')
    except ImportError:
        IST = timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))
        EST = timezone(timedelta(hours=-5))


def localize_ist(dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None) -> datetime:
    """
    Safely convert any datetime (naive, aware, UTC, or ISO string) into an IST-aware datetime.
    Guarantees zero TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes.
    """
    if dt is None:
        return datetime.now(IST)
    
    if isinstance(dt, str):
        clean_str = dt.replace('Z', '+00:00')
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(clean_str)
        return localize_ist(parsed)
    
    if isinstance(dt, date) and not isinstance(dt, datetime):
        d = datetime(dt.year, dt.month, dt.day, 0, 0, 0)
        return getattr(IST, 'localize', lambda x: x.replace(tzinfo=IST))(d) if hasattr(IST, 'localize') else d.replace(tzinfo=IST)
    
    if isinstance(dt, datetime):
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            return getattr(IST, 'localize', lambda x: x.replace(tzinfo=IST))(dt) if hasattr(IST, 'localize') else dt.replace(tzinfo=IST)
        return dt.astimezone(IST)
            
    return datetime.now(IST)


def to_utc(dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None) -> datetime:
    """Convert any datetime or ISO string to canonical UTC timezone."""
    if dt is None:
        return datetime.now(UTC)
    ist_dt = localize_ist(dt)
    return ist_dt.astimezone(UTC)


def now_ist() -> datetime:
    """Return current datetime in IST timezone."""
    return datetime.now(IST)


def today_ist() -> date:
    """Return today's date in IST timezone."""
    return datetime.now(IST).date()


# â”€â”€ 2. ENUMS & DATA STRUCTURES â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class MarketStatus(str, Enum):
    OPEN = "OPEN"                        # Regular trading session active
    PRE_OPEN = "PRE_OPEN"                # Pre-market / auction session active
    POST_MARKET = "POST_MARKET"          # Post-closing / reconciliation window
    CLOSED = "CLOSED"                    # Exchange closed (weekend, holiday, off-hours)
    SPECIAL_SESSION = "SPECIAL_SESSION"  # Muhurat trading, Saturday DR testing
    HALTED = "HALTED"                    # Trading halted (circuit breaker / regulatory)
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"                  # State unverified


class Exchange(str, Enum):
    NSE = "NSE"                          # National Stock Exchange Cash Equities
    NFO = "NFO"                          # NSE Futures & Options (Nifty / BankNifty)
    NSE_EVENING = "NSE_EVENING"          # Extended Evening Derivatives Session (18:00 - 21:00 IST)
    BSE = "BSE"                          # Bombay Stock Exchange Cash
    BFO = "BFO"                          # BSE Futures & Options (Sensex / Bankex)
    MCX = "MCX"                          # Multi Commodity Exchange (Crude, Gold, Metals)
    CDS = "CDS"                          # NSE Currency Derivatives (USDINR, EURINR)
    US_EQUITY = "US_EQUITY"              # NYSE / NASDAQ
    CRYPTO = "CRYPTO"                    # 24/7/365 Continuous Crypto Spot & Perpetuals


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SessionState:
    """
    Immutable snapshot of an exchange's session state.
    Provides complete provenance: 'Why is the market in this state?'
    """
    exchange: Exchange
    status: MarketStatus
    is_open: bool
    trading_date: date
    session_id: str
    reason: str
    minutes_elapsed: int
    minutes_remaining: int
    timestamp_utc: datetime
    timestamp_local: datetime


# â”€â”€ 3. DYNAMIC EXCHANGE CALENDAR & HOLIDAY ENGINE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

_holiday_cache: Dict[Tuple[str, int], Set[str]] = {}
_special_session_overrides: Dict[Tuple[str, date], Tuple[time, time, str]] = {}
_manual_exchange_halt: Dict[str, Tuple[bool, str]] = {}
_USING_FALLBACK_CALENDAR: bool = False


def register_special_session(exchange: Union[Exchange, str], session_date: date, start_t: time, end_t: time, reason: str):
    """Register a special trading session (e.g. Muhurat Trading 18:15 - 19:15, Saturday DR 09:15 - 15:30)."""
    ex_str = exchange.value if isinstance(exchange, Exchange) else exchange.upper()
    _special_session_overrides[(ex_str, session_date)] = (start_t, end_t, reason)
    logger.info(f"[time_utils] Special session registered: {ex_str} on {session_date} ({start_t}-{end_t}) - {reason}")


def set_exchange_halt(exchange: Union[Exchange, str], is_halted: bool, reason: str = ""):
    """Set explicit market halt or resumption (e.g. index circuit breaker, technical halt)."""
    ex_str = exchange.value if isinstance(exchange, Exchange) else exchange.upper()
    _manual_exchange_halt[ex_str] = (is_halted, reason)
    if is_halted:
        logger.warning(f"[time_utils] Exchange {ex_str} HALTED: {reason}")
    else:
        logger.info(f"[time_utils] Exchange {ex_str} resumed trading.")


def _load_holidays(year: int, exchange: str = "NSE") -> Set[str]:
    """
    O(1) in-memory cache lookup.
    Loads official exchange calendar dynamically via pandas_market_calendars / exchange_calendars.
    """
    global _USING_FALLBACK_CALENDAR
    cache_key = (exchange, year)
    if cache_key in _holiday_cache:
        return _holiday_cache[cache_key]

    # 1. Primary: pandas_market_calendars
    try:
        import importlib
        mcal = importlib.import_module("pandas_market_calendars")
        import pandas as pd
        cal_name = 'NSE' if exchange in ('NSE', 'BSE', 'CDS') else exchange
        mcal_cal = mcal.get_calendar(cal_name)
        schedule = mcal_cal.schedule(start_date=f"{year}-01-01", end_date=f"{year}-12-31")
        all_weekdays = pd.bdate_range(start=f"{year}-01-01", end=f"{year}-12-31")
        trading_days = set(schedule.index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        weekdays = set(all_weekdays.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        holidays = weekdays - trading_days
        _holiday_cache[cache_key] = holidays
        _USING_FALLBACK_CALENDAR = False
        return holidays
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"[time_utils] pandas_market_calendars unavailable for {exchange} ({year}): {e}")
        _USING_FALLBACK_CALENDAR = True

    # 2. Secondary: exchange_calendars
    try:
        import importlib
        xcals = importlib.import_module("exchange_calendars")
        cal_name = 'XNSE' if exchange in ('NSE', 'BSE', 'CDS') else exchange
        xcal = xcals.get_calendar(cal_name)
        holidays = {d.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') for d in xcal.regular_holidays.holidays(start=f"{year}-01-01", end=f"{year}-12-31")}
        _holiday_cache[cache_key] = holidays
        _USING_FALLBACK_CALENDAR = False
        return holidays
    except Exception:
        pass

    _holiday_cache[cache_key] = set()
    return set()


def _is_nse_holiday(dt: Union[date, str, datetime]) -> bool:
    """Compatibility alias for execution/tracker.py and data/earnings/earnings_check.py."""
    if isinstance(dt, str):
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(dt.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
            d = parsed.date()
        except Exception:
            d = datetime.strptime(dt[:10], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    elif isinstance(dt, datetime):
        d = dt.date()
    else:
        d = dt
    return not is_trading_day(d, Exchange.NSE)


# Legacy compatibility aliases
_CURRENT_YEAR = datetime.now(IST).year
_NSE_HOLIDAYS: Set[str] = _load_holidays(_CURRENT_YEAR, "NSE")
NSE_HOLIDAYS_2026 = _NSE_HOLIDAYS


# â”€â”€ 4. HIGH-PERFORMANCE EXCHANGE SESSION LOGIC â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _is_us_dst(dt: datetime) -> bool:
    """O(1) Daylight Saving Time check for US (EDT vs EST)."""
    try:
        aware_dt = dt if dt.tzinfo else dt.replace(tzinfo=IST)
        ny_dt = aware_dt.astimezone(EST)
        return bool(ny_dt.dst())
    except Exception:
        return 3 < dt.month < 11


def get_session_state(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> SessionState:
    """
    Master High-Performance Session Resolver.
    Returns complete, immutable SessionState with status, session_id, and explainable reason.
    """
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    ist_dt = localize_ist(dt)
    target_date = ist_dt.date()
    target_time = ist_dt.time()
    ex_str = exch.value
    utc_dt = ist_dt.astimezone(UTC)

    # 1. Check Explicit Manual Halt
    if ex_str in _manual_exchange_halt:
        is_halted, halt_reason = _manual_exchange_halt[ex_str]
        if is_halted:
            return SessionState(
                exchange=exch,
                status=MarketStatus.HALTED,
                is_open=False,
                trading_date=target_date,
                session_id=f"{ex_str}_{target_date}_HALTED",
                reason=f"Exchange trading halted: {halt_reason}",
                minutes_elapsed=0,
                minutes_remaining=0,
                timestamp_utc=utc_dt,
                timestamp_local=ist_dt,
            )

    # 2. Check Special Session Overrides (e.g. Diwali Muhurat / Saturday DR)
    override_key = (ex_str, target_date)
    if override_key in _special_session_overrides:
        start_t, end_t, session_name = _special_session_overrides[override_key]
        if start_t <= target_time <= end_t:
            mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(target_date, target_time) - datetime.combine(target_date, start_t)).total_seconds() // 60)
            mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(target_date, end_t) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
            return SessionState(
                exchange=exch,
                status=MarketStatus.SPECIAL_SESSION,
                is_open=True,
                trading_date=target_date,
                session_id=f"{ex_str}_{target_date}_SPECIAL",
                reason=f"Active special session: {session_name} ({start_t}-{end_t})",
                minutes_elapsed=mins_elapsed,
                minutes_remaining=mins_rem,
                timestamp_utc=utc_dt,
                timestamp_local=ist_dt,
            )

    # 3. Crypto 24/7/365 Continuous Session
    if exch == Exchange.CRYPTO:
        return SessionState(
            exchange=exch,
            status=MarketStatus.OPEN,
            is_open=True,
            trading_date=target_date,
            session_id=f"CRYPTO_{target_date}_24H",
            reason="Crypto spot and perpetual markets trade 24/7/365",
            minutes_elapsed=target_time.hour * 60 + target_time.minute,
            minutes_remaining=1440 - (target_time.hour * 60 + target_time.minute),
            timestamp_utc=utc_dt,
            timestamp_local=ist_dt,
        )

    # 4. Weekend Check (Saturday / Sunday)
    weekday = ist_dt.weekday()
    if weekday >= 5:
        day_name = "Saturday" if weekday == 5 else "Sunday"
        return SessionState(
            exchange=exch,
            status=MarketStatus.CLOSED,
            is_open=False,
            trading_date=target_date,
            session_id=f"{ex_str}_{target_date}_WEEKEND",
            reason=f"Exchange closed on {day_name}",
            minutes_elapsed=0,
            minutes_remaining=0,
            timestamp_utc=utc_dt,
            timestamp_local=ist_dt,
        )

    # 5. Holiday Check
    holidays = _load_holidays(target_date.year, ex_str)
    date_str = target_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    if date_str in holidays:
        # MCX allows evening session even on certain Indian holidays
        if exch == Exchange.MCX:
            close_t = time(23, 30) if _is_us_dst(ist_dt) else time(23, 55)
            if time(17, 0) <= target_time <= close_t:
                mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(target_date, target_time) - datetime.combine(target_date, time(17, 0))).total_seconds() // 60)
                mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(target_date, close_t) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
                return SessionState(
                    exchange=exch,
                    status=MarketStatus.OPEN,
                    is_open=True,
                    trading_date=target_date,
                    session_id=f"MCX_{target_date}_EVENING_HOLIDAY",
                    reason="MCX evening commodity session open on domestic holiday",
                    minutes_elapsed=mins_elapsed,
                    minutes_remaining=mins_rem,
                    timestamp_utc=utc_dt,
                    timestamp_local=ist_dt,
                )
        return SessionState(
            exchange=exch,
            status=MarketStatus.CLOSED,
            is_open=False,
            trading_date=target_date,
            session_id=f"{ex_str}_{target_date}_HOLIDAY",
            reason=f"{ex_str} scheduled trading holiday ({date_str})",
            minutes_elapsed=0,
            minutes_remaining=0,
            timestamp_utc=utc_dt,
            timestamp_local=ist_dt,
        )

    # 6. Session Timings Evaluation per Exchange
    if exch in (Exchange.NSE, Exchange.NFO, Exchange.BSE, Exchange.BFO):
        if target_time < time(8, 0):
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.CLOSED, False, target_date, f"NSE_{target_date}_EARLY", "Pre-market not yet started", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        elif time(8, 0) <= target_time < time(9, 15):
            mins_to_open = int((datetime.combine(target_date, time(9, 15)) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.PRE_OPEN, False, target_date, f"NSE_{target_date}_PRE", f"Pre-market window ({mins_to_open}m to open)", 0, mins_to_open, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        elif time(9, 15) <= target_time <= time(15, 30):
            mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(target_date, target_time) - datetime.combine(target_date, time(9, 15))).total_seconds() // 60)
            mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(target_date, time(15, 30)) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.OPEN, True, target_date, f"NSE_{target_date}_REGULAR", "Regular continuous trading session", mins_elapsed, mins_rem, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        elif time(15, 30) < target_time <= time(16, 30):
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.POST_MARKET, False, target_date, f"NSE_{target_date}_POST", "Post-closing reconciliation session", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        else:
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.CLOSED, False, target_date, f"NSE_{target_date}_CLOSED", "Market closed for the day", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)

    elif exch == Exchange.MCX:
        close_t = time(23, 30) if _is_us_dst(ist_dt) else time(23, 55)
        if time(9, 0) <= target_time <= close_t:
            mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(target_date, target_time) - datetime.combine(target_date, time(9, 0))).total_seconds() // 60)
            mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(target_date, close_t) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
            dst_label = "US Summer EDT (closes 23:30)" if close_t == time(23, 30) else "US Winter EST (closes 23:55)"
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.OPEN, True, target_date, f"MCX_{target_date}_COMMODITY", f"MCX active session [{dst_label}]", mins_elapsed, mins_rem, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        else:
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.CLOSED, False, target_date, f"MCX_{target_date}_CLOSED", "MCX closed (trading 09:00 - 23:30/23:55)", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)

    elif exch == Exchange.CDS:
        if time(9, 0) <= target_time <= time(17, 0):
            mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(target_date, target_time) - datetime.combine(target_date, time(9, 0))).total_seconds() // 60)
            mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(target_date, time(17, 0)) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.OPEN, True, target_date, f"CDS_{target_date}_REGULAR", "Currency derivatives session active", mins_elapsed, mins_rem, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        else:
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.CLOSED, False, target_date, f"CDS_{target_date}_CLOSED", "Currency CDS market closed (09:00 - 17:00 IST)", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)

    elif exch == Exchange.NSE_EVENING:
        if time(18, 0) <= target_time <= time(21, 0):
            mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(target_date, target_time) - datetime.combine(target_date, time(18, 0))).total_seconds() // 60)
            mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(target_date, time(21, 0)) - datetime.combine(target_date, target_time)).total_seconds() // 60)
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.OPEN, True, target_date, f"NSE_EVENING_{target_date}", "NSE Extended Evening Derivatives active (18:00 - 21:00 IST)", mins_elapsed, mins_rem, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        else:
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.CLOSED, False, target_date, f"NSE_EVENING_{target_date}_CLOSED", "NSE Evening session closed (18:00 - 21:00 IST)", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)

    elif exch == Exchange.US_EQUITY:
        # Convert to US Eastern Time
        try:
            est_dt = utc_dt.astimezone(EST) if hasattr(EST, 'localize') else utc_dt.astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=-5)))
        except Exception:
            est_dt = utc_dt.astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=-5)))
        est_t = est_dt.time()
        if time(9, 30) <= est_t <= time(16, 0):
            mins_elapsed = int((datetime.combine(est_dt.date(), est_t) - datetime.combine(est_dt.date(), time(9, 30))).total_seconds() // 60)
            mins_rem = int((datetime.combine(est_dt.date(), time(16, 0)) - datetime.combine(est_dt.date(), est_t)).total_seconds() // 60)
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.OPEN, True, est_dt.date(), f"US_{est_dt.date()}_REGULAR", "US Equity regular session active (09:30 - 16:00 EST)", mins_elapsed, mins_rem, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        elif time(4, 0) <= est_t < time(9, 30):
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.PRE_OPEN, False, est_dt.date(), f"US_{est_dt.date()}_PRE", "US Pre-Market trading session", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        elif time(16, 0) < est_t <= time(20, 0):
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.POST_MARKET, False, est_dt.date(), f"US_{est_dt.date()}_POST", "US After-Hours trading session", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)
        else:
            return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.CLOSED, False, est_dt.date(), f"US_{est_dt.date()}_CLOSED", "US market closed", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)

    return SessionState(exch, MarketStatus.UNKNOWN, False, target_date, f"{ex_str}_{target_date}_UNKNOWN", "Unknown exchange session", 0, 0, utc_dt, ist_dt)


# â”€â”€ 5. PUBLIC CONVENIENCE APIS (100% BACKWARDS COMPATIBLE) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def is_market_open(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE,
    mode: str = "LIVE"
) -> bool:
    """Return True if exchange is currently in an active trading session."""
    state = get_session_state(dt, exchange)
    return state.is_open


def is_pre_market(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> bool:
    """Return True if exchange is in pre-market window."""
    state = get_session_state(dt, exchange)
    return state.status == MarketStatus.PRE_OPEN


def is_post_market(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> bool:
    """Return True if exchange is in post-market reconciliation window."""
    state = get_session_state(dt, exchange)
    return state.status == MarketStatus.POST_MARKET


def is_eod_decision_window(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> bool:
    """Return True if currently in the 3:10 PM - 3:15 PM IST session window."""
    ist_dt = localize_ist(dt) if dt is not None else now_ist()
    state = get_session_state(ist_dt, exchange)
    if not state.is_open:
        return False
    t = ist_dt.time()
    return time(15, 10) <= t < time(15, 15)


def is_trading_day(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> bool:
    """Return True if date is a scheduled trading day (skipping weekends & holidays)."""
    ist_dt = localize_ist(dt) if dt is not None else now_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    if exch == Exchange.CRYPTO:
        return True
    if ist_dt.weekday() >= 5:
        return False
    holidays = _load_holidays(ist_dt.year, exch.value)
    return ist_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') not in holidays


def week_of_month(dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None) -> int:
    """Return week number within the month (1-5). Formula: ((day - 1) // 7) + 1."""
    ist_dt = localize_ist(dt) if dt is not None else now_ist()
    return ((ist_dt.day - 1) // 7) + 1


def market_open_minutes(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> int:
    """Return minutes elapsed since market open (negative if before open)."""
    state = get_session_state(dt, exchange)
    if state.status == MarketStatus.OPEN:
        return state.minutes_elapsed
    elif state.status == MarketStatus.PRE_OPEN:
        return -state.minutes_remaining
    return 0


def minutes_to_market_close(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> int:
    """Return minutes remaining until market close (0 if closed)."""
    state = get_session_state(dt, exchange)
    return state.minutes_remaining


def get_previous_trading_day(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> date:
    """Return previous active trading day, skipping weekends and holidays automatically."""
    curr = localize_ist(dt).date() if dt is not None else today_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    curr -= timedelta(days=1)
    while not is_trading_day(curr, exch):
        curr -= timedelta(days=1)
    return curr


def get_next_trading_day(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> date:
    """Return next active trading day, skipping weekends and holidays automatically."""
    curr = localize_ist(dt).date() if dt is not None else today_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    curr += timedelta(days=1)
    while not is_trading_day(curr, exch):
        curr += timedelta(days=1)
    return curr


# â”€â”€ 6. OPTIONS EXPIRY UTILITIES (NSE INDEX & EQUITY DERIVATIVES) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_nifty_monthly_expiry(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> date:
    """
    Return official monthly F&O expiry date for the given month.
    Rule: Last Thursday of the month. If that Thursday is a market holiday,
    it rolls back to the previous trading day (Wednesday/Tuesday).
    """
    target = localize_ist(dt).date() if dt is not None else today_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    if target.month == 12:
        next_month = date(target.year + 1, 1, 1)
    else:
        next_month = date(target.year, target.month + 1, 1)
    last_day = next_month - timedelta(days=1)

    # Step backward to find the last Thursday (weekday 3)
    offset = (last_day.weekday() - 3) % 7
    candidate = last_day - timedelta(days=offset)

    # If the last Thursday is a holiday, walk backward to prior trading day
    while not is_trading_day(candidate, exch):
        candidate -= timedelta(days=1)

    return candidate


def get_nifty_weekly_expiry(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> date:
    """
    Return active weekly expiry date for the current week.
    Rule: Thursday of the current week (or previous trading day if Thursday is a holiday).
    """
    target = localize_ist(dt).date() if dt is not None else today_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    days_ahead = 3 - target.weekday()
    if days_ahead < 0:
        days_ahead += 7
    candidate = target + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

    while not is_trading_day(candidate, exch):
        candidate -= timedelta(days=1)

    return candidate


def is_expiry_day(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> bool:
    """Return True if target date is either a Weekly or Monthly Options Expiry day."""
    target = localize_ist(dt).date() if dt is not None else today_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    return target == get_nifty_weekly_expiry(target, exch) or target == get_nifty_monthly_expiry(target, exch)


def days_to_expiry(
    dt: Optional[Union[datetime, date, str]] = None,
    expiry: Optional[date] = None,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE
) -> float:
    """
    Return remaining days to expiry (DTE) as a float (e.g. 2.4 days).
    Essential for accurate Black-Scholes Greeks and Theta decay.
    """
    ist_dt = localize_ist(dt) if dt is not None else now_ist()
    exch = Exchange(exchange.upper()) if isinstance(exchange, str) else exchange
    if expiry is None:
        expiry = get_nifty_weekly_expiry(ist_dt, exch)

    expiry_dt = datetime.combine(expiry, time(15, 30), tzinfo=IST)
    diff_seconds = (expiry_dt - ist_dt).total_seconds()
    return max(0.0, diff_seconds / 86400.0)

"""
Module: data/angelone/historical.py
Purpose: High-Performance Historical OHLCV & Open Interest (OI) Candle Engine.
         Fetches historical candle data from AngelOne SmartAPI with yfinance fallback.
         Supports multi-timeframe intervals (1m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1d),
         automated 3 req/sec rate limiting (HTTP 429 protection), dynamic token resolution,
         and mathematical candle invariant sanitization.

Architectural Principles:
  1. Strict 3 Req/Sec Rate Limiter: Thread-safe token bucket prevents API key bans.
  2. 6 vs 7 Column Dynamic Parsing: Native support for Open Interest (OI) on F&O derivatives.
  3. Automatic Token Resolution: Seamlessly resolves tokens via token_map if not provided.
  4. Mathematical Candle Sanitization: Validates high/low invariants and drops corrupt ticks.
  5. Multi-Asset & Timeframe Coverage: Supports NSE, NFO, BSE, BFO (Sensex), MCX, and CDS.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from enum import Enum
import logging
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

import pandas as pd

from core.time_utils import Exchange
from data.angelone.token_map import get_token_for_symbol

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# â”€â”€ 1. ENUMS & DATA PROVIDER PROVENANCE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class CandleInterval(str, Enum):
    """AngelOne SmartAPI candle intervals."""
    ONE_MINUTE     = "ONE_MINUTE"
    THREE_MINUTE   = "THREE_MINUTE"    # Scalping & ORB breakouts
    FIVE_MINUTE    = "FIVE_MINUTE"     # Primary intraday scanning
    TEN_MINUTE     = "TEN_MINUTE"
    FIFTEEN_MINUTE = "FIFTEEN_MINUTE"  # Trend & confirmation
    THIRTY_MINUTE  = "THIRTY_MINUTE"
    ONE_HOUR       = "ONE_HOUR"
    ONE_DAY        = "ONE_DAY"         # Daily baseline & EMAs


class DataProvider(str, Enum):
    """Provenance tracking for historical feeds."""
    SMART_API = "SMART_API"
    YFINANCE  = "YFINANCE"
    OFFLINE   = "OFFLINE"


# Interval mapping for yfinance fallback
YF_INTERVAL_MAP: Dict[CandleInterval, str] = {
    CandleInterval.ONE_MINUTE:     "1m",
    CandleInterval.THREE_MINUTE:   "2m",
    CandleInterval.FIVE_MINUTE:    "5m",
    CandleInterval.TEN_MINUTE:     "15m",
    CandleInterval.FIFTEEN_MINUTE: "15m",
    CandleInterval.THIRTY_MINUTE:  "30m",
    CandleInterval.ONE_HOUR:       "1h",
    CandleInterval.ONE_DAY:        "1d",
}


# â”€â”€ 2. RATE LIMITER (MAX 3 REQ/SEC FOR SMARTAPI) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class SmartAPIRateLimiter:
    """Thread-safe rate limiter to strictly respect AngelOne's 3 requests/sec rule."""
    def __init__(self, min_interval_seconds: float = 0.35):
        self.min_interval = min_interval_seconds
        self.last_request_time = 0.0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def acquire(self) -> None:
        """Enforce spacing between consecutive API calls to prevent HTTP 429."""
        with self._lock:
            now = time.time()
            elapsed = now - self.last_request_time
            if elapsed < self.min_interval:
                time.sleep(self.min_interval - elapsed)
            self.last_request_time = time.time()


_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMITER = SmartAPIRateLimiter(min_interval_seconds=0.35)

# â”€â”€ 3. IN-MEMORY HIGH-SPEED CANDLE CACHE (TTL DEDUPLICATOR) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

_CANDLE_CACHE: Dict[str, Tuple[datetime, pd.DataFrame]] = {}
_candle_cache_lock = threading.Lock()
_DEFAULT_CANDLE_TTL_SECONDS: int = 60  # 60s TTL for real-time strategy deduplication


def clear_candle_cache() -> None:
    """Flush all in-memory candle caches (e.g. at market open or test reset)."""
    with _candle_cache_lock:
        _CANDLE_CACHE.clear()


def get_candle_cache_size() -> int:
    """Return count of active cached candle series in RAM."""
    with _candle_cache_lock:
        return len(_CANDLE_CACHE)


# â”€â”€ 4. CANDLE SANITIZER & INVARIANT ENFORCER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _sanitize_candles(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Sanitize OHLCV candles ensuring mathematical validity:
    - High >= max(Open, Close)
    - Low <= min(Open, Close)
    - Volume >= 0
    - Drop NaN / Inf values
    """
    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Drop NaNs or Infs
    df = df.replace([float("inf"), float("-inf")], float("nan")).dropna(subset=["Open", "High", "Low", "Close"])
    if df.empty:
        return df

    # Enforce candle invariants
    df["High"] = df[["High", "Open", "Close"]].max(axis=1)
    df["Low"] = df[["Low", "Open", "Close"]].min(axis=1)
    if "Volume" in df.columns:
        df["Volume"] = df["Volume"].clip(lower=0)
    if "OpenInterest" in df.columns:
        df["OpenInterest"] = df["OpenInterest"].clip(lower=0)

    return df


# â”€â”€ 5. MASTER HISTORICAL CANDLE FETCHER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def fetch_historical_candles(
    symbol: str,
    token: Optional[str] = None,
    interval: CandleInterval = CandleInterval.FIVE_MINUTE,
    days_back: int = 5,
    exchange: Union[Exchange, str] = Exchange.NSE,
    smart_api_client: Optional[Any] = None,
    use_cache: bool = True,
    cache_ttl_seconds: int = 60,
) -> Optional[pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Fetch historical candle data for an equity, index, or option contract.
    Priority: RAM TTL Cache -> AngelOne SmartAPI -> yfinance fallback -> None.

    Args:
        symbol: Clean symbol (e.g. "RELIANCE", "NIFTY") or with suffix ("RELIANCE.NS")
        token: AngelOne instrument token (optional; auto-resolved if None)
        interval: CandleInterval enum
        days_back: Number of calendar days of history to fetch
        exchange: Exchange enum or string ("NSE", "NFO", "BSE", "BFO", "MCX", "CDS")
        smart_api_client: Initialized SmartConnect instance (optional)
        use_cache: Enable sub-microsecond in-memory TTL caching (default True)
        cache_ttl_seconds: Cache validity window in seconds (default 60s)

    Returns:
        Standardized pandas DataFrame with columns: [Open, High, Low, Close, Volume]
        (and optionally [OpenInterest] for F&O) and DatetimeIndex, or None if fetch fails.
    """
    clean_sym = symbol.replace(".NS", "").replace(".BO", "").strip().upper()
    exch_str = exchange.value if isinstance(exchange, Exchange) else exchange.upper()

    # Auto-resolve token if not explicitly provided
    if token is None:
        token = get_token_for_symbol(clean_sym, exchange=exch_str)

    # Check In-Memory RAM Cache first
    cache_key = f"{clean_sym}_{token or 'NO_TOK'}_{interval.value}_{days_back}_{exch_str}"
    if use_cache:
        with _candle_cache_lock:
            entry = _CANDLE_CACHE.get(cache_key)
            if entry is not None:
                cached_time, cached_df = entry
                if (datetime.now() - cached_time).total_seconds() < cache_ttl_seconds:
                    return cached_df.copy()

    # 1. Try AngelOne SmartAPI if client & token available
    if smart_api_client is not None and token is not None:
        try:
            # Enforce 3 req/sec rate limit to prevent HTTP 429
            _GLOBAL_RATE_LIMITER.acquire()

            to_date = datetime.now()
            from_date = to_date - timedelta(days=days_back)

            # Format dates depending on timeframe
            if interval == CandleInterval.ONE_DAY:
                from_date_str = from_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d 00:00")
                to_date_str = to_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d 23:59")
            else:
                from_date_str = from_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d 09:15")
                to_date_str = to_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d 15:30")

            params = {
                "exchange": exch_str,
                "symboltoken": token,
                "interval": interval.value,
                "fromdate": from_date_str,
                "todate": to_date_str,
            }

            response = smart_api_client.getCandleData(params)
            if response and response.get("status") and response.get("data"):
                raw_data = response["data"]
                if not raw_data:
                    logger.warning(f"[historical] Empty data returned for {clean_sym} (Token {token})")
                    return None

                # Detect 6 vs 7 elements (Open Interest on F&O)
                sample_row = raw_data[0]
                num_cols = len(sample_row)

                if num_cols >= 7:
                    cols = ["Timestamp", "Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume", "OpenInterest"]
                    # Slice to first 7 columns if extra fields exist
                    cleaned_rows = [r[:7] for r in raw_data]
                    df = pd.DataFrame(cleaned_rows, columns=cols)
                else:
                    cols = ["Timestamp", "Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume"]
                    cleaned_rows = [r[:6] for r in raw_data]
                    df = pd.DataFrame(cleaned_rows, columns=cols)

                df["Timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Timestamp"])
                df.set_index("Timestamp", inplace=True)
                
                # Convert numeric columns to float
                numeric_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != "Timestamp"]
                df[numeric_cols] = df[numeric_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

                df = _sanitize_candles(df)
                df.attrs["data_provider"] = DataProvider.SMART_API.value

                # Store in RAM Cache
                if use_cache and not df.empty:
                    with _candle_cache_lock:
                        _CANDLE_CACHE[cache_key] = (datetime.now(), df.copy())

                logger.info(f"[historical] Fetched {len(df)} {interval.value} candles for {clean_sym} via AngelOne")
                return df

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[historical] AngelOne fetch failed for {clean_sym}: {e} â€” attempting yfinance fallback")

    # 2. Fallback to yfinance
    try:
        import yfinance as yf
        yf_sym = f"{clean_sym}.NS" if not symbol.endswith(".NS") and not symbol.startswith("^") else symbol
        if clean_sym in ("NIFTY", "NIFTY 50", "NIFTY50"):
            yf_sym = "^NSEI"
        elif clean_sym in ("BANKNIFTY", "NIFTY BANK"):
            yf_sym = "^NSEBANK"
        elif clean_sym in ("FINNIFTY", "NIFTY FINANCIAL SERVICES"):
            yf_sym = "NIFTY_FIN_SERVICE.NS"
        elif clean_sym in ("INDIAVIX", "INDIA VIX"):
            yf_sym = "^INDIAVIX"

        yf_interval = YF_INTERVAL_MAP.get(interval, "5m")
        period_str = f"{max(1, days_back)}d" if days_back <= 60 else "1y"

        df = yf.download(yf_sym, period=period_str, interval=yf_interval, progress=False)
        if df is not None and not df.empty:
            if isinstance(df.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
                df.columns = df.columns.get_level_values(0)
            
            # Standardize column naming
            col_map = {c: c.capitalize() for c in df.columns}
            df = df.rename(columns=col_map)

            req_cols = [c for c in ["Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume"] if c in df.columns]
            df = df[req_cols]
            df = _sanitize_candles(df)
            df.attrs["data_provider"] = DataProvider.YFINANCE.value

            # Store in RAM Cache
            if use_cache and not df.empty:
                with _candle_cache_lock:
                    _CANDLE_CACHE[cache_key] = (datetime.now(), df.copy())

            logger.info(f"[historical] Fetched {len(df)} candles for {clean_sym} via yfinance ({yf_interval})")
            return df

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[historical] yfinance fallback failed for {clean_sym}: {e}")

    return None

FILE: mjonai-build\data\angelone\token_map.py

"""
Module: data/angelone/token_map.py
Purpose: Self-Healing High-Performance Instrument & Security Token Resolver.
         Supports Cash Equities (NSE), Index Spot & Futures (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/FINNIFTY),
         Index & Stock Options, Dynamic Lot Sizes & Tick Sizes, and local JSON caching.

Architectural Principles:
  1. 100% JSON-Native: Zero static CSV files. Eliminates stale manual CSV maintenance forever.
  2. Spot Index Separation: Explicit INDEX_TOKEN_MAP for Nifty 50, Bank Nifty, FinNifty, India VIX.
  3. Dynamic Lot & Tick Sizes: Automatically extracts live lotsize and ticksize from official broker master.
  4. Resilient Local JSON Snapshot: Caches daily snapshot locally for instant < 50ms startup.
  5. Dynamic Options Resolution: Resolves live weekly/monthly option strike tokens (e.g. NIFTY 24500 CE).
  6. O(1) Memory Lookups: Instant case-insensitive symbol <-> token conversions.
  7. 100% Backward Compatibility: Preserves TOKEN_MAP, SYMBOL_MAP, WATCHLIST_TOKENS for all existing callers.
"""

from datetime import date, datetime
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union
import urllib.request

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# AngelOne Official Open-API Instrument Master URL
ANGELONE_SCRIP_MASTER_URL = "https://margincalculator.angelbroking.com/OpenAPI_File/files/OpenAPIScripMaster.json"

# In-Memory Fast Lookup Stores
TOKEN_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {}         # Token -> Symbol Name (e.g. "2885" -> "RELIANCE")
SYMBOL_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {}        # Symbol Name -> Token (e.g. "RELIANCE" -> "2885")
OPTION_TOKEN_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {}  # Formatted Key -> Token (e.g. "NIFTY_2026-08-27_24500.0_CE" -> "54321")
LOT_SIZE_MAP: Dict[str, int] = {}      # Symbol -> Contract Lot Size (e.g. "NIFTY" -> 65, "BANKNIFTY" -> 30)
TICK_SIZE_MAP: Dict[str, float] = {}   # Symbol -> Tick Size (e.g. "RELIANCE" -> 0.05)
WATCHLIST_TOKENS: Dict[str, Any] = {"exchangeType": 1, "tokens": []}

# Official AngelOne Index Spot Tokens on NSE
INDEX_TOKEN_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {
    "NIFTY": "99926000",
    "NIFTY 50": "99926000",
    "NIFTY50": "99926000",
    "BANKNIFTY": "99926009",
    "NIFTY BANK": "99926009",
    "FINNIFTY": "99926037",
    "NIFTY FINANCIAL SERVICES": "99926037",
    "MIDCPNIFTY": "99926074",
    "NIFTY MIDCAP SELECT": "99926074",
    "INDIAVIX": "99926017",
    "INDIA VIX": "99926017",
    "SENSEX": "99919000",
}

# Standard Option Strike Steps per Underlying
INDEX_STRIKE_INTERVALS: Dict[str, float] = {
    "NIFTY": 50.0,
    "NIFTY 50": 50.0,
    "NIFTY50": 50.0,
    "BANKNIFTY": 100.0,
    "NIFTY BANK": 100.0,
    "FINNIFTY": 50.0,
    "NIFTY FINANCIAL SERVICES": 50.0,
    "MIDCPNIFTY": 25.0,
    "NIFTY MIDCAP SELECT": 25.0,
    "SENSEX": 100.0,
    "BANKEX": 100.0,
}

_TOKEN_MAP_LOADED: bool = False
_LAST_SYNC_DATE: Optional[date] = None

# Paths
_CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
_CACHE_JSON_PATH = _CURRENT_DIR / "instrument_master_cache.json"


def _send_token_map_alert(message: str) -> None:
    """Send Telegram alert on token map degradation. Non-blocking & crash-safe."""
    try:
        from communication.telegram import send_message
        send_message(f"âš ï¸ <b>MJONAI TOKEN MAP</b>\n{message}")
    except Exception:
        pass


def _normalize_symbol(symbol: str) -> str:
    """Sanitize and normalize symbol for robust case-insensitive lookup."""
    return symbol.strip().upper().replace("-EQ", "").replace(".NS", "").replace(".BO", "")


# â”€â”€ 1. JSON CACHE LOADER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _load_local_json_cache() -> bool:
    """Load token mappings from local JSON snapshot if present."""
    global TOKEN_MAP, SYMBOL_MAP, OPTION_TOKEN_MAP, LOT_SIZE_MAP, TICK_SIZE_MAP, WATCHLIST_TOKENS, _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED, _LAST_SYNC_DATE
    if not _CACHE_JSON_PATH.exists():
        return False

    try:
        with open(_CACHE_JSON_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
            TOKEN_MAP.clear()
            TOKEN_MAP.update(data.get("token_map", {}))
            SYMBOL_MAP.clear()
            SYMBOL_MAP.update(data.get("symbol_map", {}))
            OPTION_TOKEN_MAP.clear()
            OPTION_TOKEN_MAP.update(data.get("option_token_map", {}))
            LOT_SIZE_MAP.clear()
            LOT_SIZE_MAP.update(data.get("lot_size_map", {}))
            TICK_SIZE_MAP.clear()
            TICK_SIZE_MAP.update(data.get("tick_size_map", {}))
            WATCHLIST_TOKENS.clear()
            WATCHLIST_TOKENS.update(data.get("watchlist_tokens", {"exchangeType": 1, "tokens": []}))
            
            sync_str = data.get("sync_date")
            if sync_str:
                try:
                    _LAST_SYNC_DATE = date.fromisoformat(sync_str)
                except Exception:
                    _LAST_SYNC_DATE = None

            _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED = bool(TOKEN_MAP and SYMBOL_MAP)
            if _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED:
                logger.info(f"[token_map] Loaded instrument master snapshot: {len(TOKEN_MAP)} equities, {len(OPTION_TOKEN_MAP)} options, {len(LOT_SIZE_MAP)} lot specs")
                return True
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"[token_map] Failed to read JSON cache {_CACHE_JSON_PATH}: {e}")

    return False


# â”€â”€ 2. DYNAMIC LIVE INSTRUMENT MASTER SYNC â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def sync_instrument_master(force: bool = False, timeout_seconds: int = 15) -> bool:
    """
    Synchronize official daily Instrument Master JSON from AngelOne.
    Extracts equities, options, lot sizes, and tick sizes.
    Caches parsed tokens locally as JSON to guarantee sub-50ms future boots.
    """
    global TOKEN_MAP, SYMBOL_MAP, OPTION_TOKEN_MAP, LOT_SIZE_MAP, TICK_SIZE_MAP, WATCHLIST_TOKENS, _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED, _LAST_SYNC_DATE

    today = date.today()
    if not force and _LAST_SYNC_DATE == today and _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED:
        return True

    # 1. Check if fresh local JSON cache exists from today
    if not force and _CACHE_JSON_PATH.exists():
        try:
            mtime = date.fromtimestamp(_CACHE_JSON_PATH.stat().st_mtime)
            if mtime == today and _load_local_json_cache():
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 2. Network Download from AngelOne Master Feed
    logger.info(f"[token_map] Fetching live Scrip Master from AngelOne ({ANGELONE_SCRIP_MASTER_URL})...")
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            ANGELONE_SCRIP_MASTER_URL,
            headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) MJONAI/3.0"}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout_seconds) as response:
            if response.status != 200:
                raise ValueError(f"HTTP {response.status} from AngelOne scrip master")
            raw_data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))

        new_token_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
        new_symbol_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
        new_option_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
        new_lot_size_map: Dict[str, int] = {}
        new_tick_size_map: Dict[str, float] = {}
        watchlist_tokens_list: List[str] = []

        # Parse AngelOne master objects
        for item in raw_data:
            exch_seg = (item.get("exch_seg") or "").lower()
            token = (item.get("token") or "").strip()
            name = (item.get("name") or "").strip()
            symbol = (item.get("symbol") or "").strip()
            inst_type = (item.get("instrumenttype") or "").upper()
            lotsize_raw = item.get("lotsize", 1)
            ticksize_raw = item.get("tick_size", 0.05)

            if not token:
                continue

            try:
                lotsize = int(lotsize_raw)
            except Exception:
                lotsize = 1

            try:
                t_val = float(ticksize_raw)
                ticksize = t_val / 100.0 if t_val > 10 else t_val
            except Exception:
                ticksize = 0.05

            # Cash Equities on NSE
            if exch_seg == "nse_cm" and symbol.endswith("-EQ"):
                clean_name = _normalize_symbol(name)
                new_token_map[token] = clean_name
                new_symbol_map[clean_name] = token
                new_lot_size_map[clean_name] = lotsize
                new_tick_size_map[clean_name] = ticksize
                watchlist_tokens_list.append(token)

            # Index & Stock Options on NFO
            elif exch_seg == "nfo_fo" and inst_type in ("OPTIDX", "OPTSTK"):
                expiry_str = (item.get("expiry") or "").strip()
                strike_str = (item.get("strike") or "-1").strip()
                try:
                    s_val = float(strike_str)
                    strike_val = s_val / 100.0 if s_val > 100000 else s_val
                except Exception:
                    strike_val = 0.0
                
                opt_type = "CE" if symbol.endswith("CE") else "PE" if symbol.endswith("PE") else ""
                clean_underlying = _normalize_symbol(name)
                if opt_type and clean_underlying and expiry_str:
                    canonical_key = f"{clean_underlying}_{expiry_str.upper()}_{strike_val:.1f}_{opt_type}"
                    new_option_map[canonical_key] = token
                    new_lot_size_map[clean_underlying] = lotsize
                    new_tick_size_map[clean_underlying] = ticksize

        if new_token_map:
            TOKEN_MAP.clear()
            TOKEN_MAP.update(new_token_map)
            SYMBOL_MAP.clear()
            SYMBOL_MAP.update(new_symbol_map)
            OPTION_TOKEN_MAP.clear()
            OPTION_TOKEN_MAP.update(new_option_map)
            LOT_SIZE_MAP.clear()
            LOT_SIZE_MAP.update(new_lot_size_map)
            TICK_SIZE_MAP.clear()
            TICK_SIZE_MAP.update(new_tick_size_map)
            WATCHLIST_TOKENS.clear()
            WATCHLIST_TOKENS.update({
                "exchangeType": 1,
                "tokens": watchlist_tokens_list
            })
            _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED = True
            _LAST_SYNC_DATE = today

            # Save clean local JSON cache
            try:
                cache_payload = {
                    "sync_date": today.isoformat(),
                    "token_map": TOKEN_MAP,
                    "symbol_map": SYMBOL_MAP,
                    "option_token_map": OPTION_TOKEN_MAP,
                    "lot_size_map": LOT_SIZE_MAP,
                    "tick_size_map": TICK_SIZE_MAP,
                    "watchlist_tokens": WATCHLIST_TOKENS
                }
                with open(_CACHE_JSON_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    json.dump(cache_payload, f)
                logger.info(f"[token_map] Master synced ({len(TOKEN_MAP)} equities, {len(OPTION_TOKEN_MAP)} options, {len(LOT_SIZE_MAP)} lot specs)")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"[token_map] Could not write cache file: {e}")

            return True

    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"[token_map] Live scrip master download failed ({e}), attempting local JSON cache...")

    # 3. Fallback to existing local JSON cache
    if _load_local_json_cache():
        return True

    logger.critical("[token_map] Failed to load instrument master from network and no valid local JSON cache exists")
    _send_token_map_alert("Failed to load instrument master from network and no local JSON cache exists.")
    return False


# â”€â”€ 3. PUBLIC RESOLUTION & CONVENIENCE APIS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_token_for_symbol(symbol: str, exchange: str = "NSE") -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Get exchange security token for equity symbol.
    Case-insensitive with zero allocation.
    """
    clean = _normalize_symbol(symbol)
    # Check index tokens first, then equity symbols
    if clean in INDEX_TOKEN_MAP:
        return INDEX_TOKEN_MAP[clean]
    return SYMBOL_MAP.get(clean)


def get_symbol_for_token(token: str, exchange: str = "NSE") -> Optional[str]:
    """Get equity symbol name for a given token string."""
    clean_token = token.strip()
    # Check index tokens
    for idx_name, idx_tok in INDEX_TOKEN_MAP.items():
        if idx_tok == clean_token:
            return idx_name
    return TOKEN_MAP.get(clean_token)


def get_index_token(index_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Get official AngelOne spot token for an index (e.g. 'NIFTY' -> '99926000', 'BANKNIFTY' -> '99926009')."""
    clean = _normalize_symbol(index_name)
    return INDEX_TOKEN_MAP.get(clean)


def get_option_token(
    underlying: str,
    expiry_str: str,
    strike_price: float,
    option_type: str
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Resolve live exchange token for Options contract.
    Example: get_option_token('NIFTY', '27AUG2026', 24500.0, 'CE') -> '54321'
    """
    clean_underlying = _normalize_symbol(underlying)
    clean_type = option_type.strip().upper()
    clean_expiry = expiry_str.strip().upper()
    key = f"{clean_underlying}_{clean_expiry}_{strike_price:.1f}_{clean_type}"
    return OPTION_TOKEN_MAP.get(key)


def get_atm_strike(
    underlying: str,
    spot_price: float,
    strike_interval: Optional[float] = None
) -> float:
    """
    Calculate At-The-Money (ATM) strike price rounded to standard exchange step.
    Example: get_atm_strike('NIFTY', 24532.5) -> 24550.0
    """
    clean = _normalize_symbol(underlying)
    step = strike_interval or INDEX_STRIKE_INTERVALS.get(clean, 50.0)
    return round(spot_price / step) * step


def get_option_chain_tokens(
    underlying: str,
    expiry_str: str,
    spot_price: float,
    num_strikes: int = 5,
    strike_interval: Optional[float] = None
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Resolve option contract tokens for ATM and surrounding ITM/OTM strike ladder.
    Returns dictionary with all strike specs and a flat list of tokens ready for WebSocket streaming.
    """
    clean = _normalize_symbol(underlying)
    atm = get_atm_strike(clean, spot_price, strike_interval)
    step = strike_interval or INDEX_STRIKE_INTERVALS.get(clean, 50.0)

    strikes_ladder: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    tokens_to_stream: List[str] = []

    for offset in range(-num_strikes, num_strikes + 1):
        strike = atm + (offset * step)
        ce_tok = get_option_token(clean, expiry_str, strike, "CE")
        pe_tok = get_option_token(clean, expiry_str, strike, "PE")
        
        strikes_ladder.append({
            "strike": strike,
            "offset": offset,
            "is_atm": offset == 0,
            "ce_token": ce_tok,
            "pe_token": pe_tok,
        })
        if ce_tok:
            tokens_to_stream.append(ce_tok)
        if pe_tok:
            tokens_to_stream.append(pe_tok)

    return {
        "underlying": clean,
        "expiry": expiry_str.strip().upper(),
        "spot_price": spot_price,
        "atm_strike": atm,
        "strike_interval": step,
        "num_strikes": num_strikes,
        "strikes": strikes_ladder,
        "tokens_to_stream": tokens_to_stream,
    }


def get_lot_size(symbol: str) -> Optional[int]:
    """Get live market lot size for an equity or index contract."""
    clean = _normalize_symbol(symbol)
    return LOT_SIZE_MAP.get(clean)


def get_tick_size(symbol: str) -> Optional[float]:
    """Get live minimum tick size for an instrument."""
    clean = _normalize_symbol(symbol)
    return TICK_SIZE_MAP.get(clean, 0.05)


def is_token_map_loaded() -> bool:
    """Health check helper for startup verification."""
    return _TOKEN_MAP_LOADED and len(SYMBOL_MAP) > 0


# â”€â”€ 4. INITIALIZE ON IMPORT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

# Load tokens immediately on module import (uses cache or network sync)
try:
    if not _load_local_json_cache():
        sync_instrument_master(force=False)
except Exception as _e:
    logger.critical(f"[token_map] Fatal error initializing token map: {_e}")
    _send_token_map_alert(f"Token map initialization failed: {_e}")

"""
Module: data/angelone/websocket.py
Purpose: High-Performance AngelOne SmartWebSocketV2 Real-Time Tick & Quote Engine.
         Ingests streaming market ticks, extracts LTP, Cumulative Volume, and Open Interest (OI),
         maintains thread-safe in-memory stores, tracks token-level staleness, and manages auto-reconnections.

Architectural Principles:
  1. Multi-Mode Streaming: Supports Mode 1 (LTP), Mode 2 (Quote with Volume & OI), and Mode 3 (Full Depth).
  2. Complete Derivative Data: Real-time Open Interest (OI) & Day Volume maps for Options & Volume surge scanning.
  3. Token-Level Staleness Tracking: Granular timestamps per token to distinguish illiquid stocks from dead sockets.
  4. Thread-Safe O(1) Reads: Instant in-memory lookups for strategy scan loops without lock contention.
  5. Resilient Auto-Reconnect: Exponential backoff reconnector with Telegram alerts and watchdog integration.
"""

import logging

# â”€â”€ 1. ENUMS & SUBSCRIPTION MODES â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

# In-Memory Fast Lookup Stores (Token -> Metric)
live_prices: Dict[str, float] = {}          # Token -> Last Traded Price (â‚¹)

live_ask_qty: Dict[str, int] = {}           # Token -> Best Ask Quantity
live_timestamps: Dict[str, datetime] = {}   # Token -> Last Received Tick Timestamp (IST)
total_ticks_received: int = 0               # Telemetry metric: Lifetime received ticks counter

_prices_lock = threading.Lock()
_tick_listeners: List[Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None]] = []
_listeners_lock = threading.Lock()

# Connection State
_sws: Optional[Any] = None
_auth_token: Optional[str] = None
_feed_token: Optional[str] = None
_client_id: Optional[str] = None
_token_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
_correlation_id: str = "mjonai_live"

# Watchdog & Reconnect Controls
_stop_requested: bool = False
_reconnect_attempts: int = 0

_reconnect_lock = threading.Lock()

_last_price_time: Optional[datetime] = None
_STALE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS: int = 120  # 2 minutes with no ticks during market hours = stale

# â”€â”€ 4. STALENESS & HEALTH WATCHDOG â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def is_websocket_healthy() -> bool:
    """
    Returns True if WebSocket received a price update within last 2 minutes.
    Returns True outside market hours (no ticks expected).
    Called by supervisor watchdog.
    """
    if not is_market_open():
        return True  # Outside market hours â€” lack of ticks is expected

    if _last_price_time is None:
        return False  # Market open but never received any price

    elapsed = (now_ist() - _last_price_time).total_seconds()
    return elapsed < _STALE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS


def get_token_staleness(token: str) -> Optional[float]:
    """Return seconds elapsed since last tick for a specific token. None if never received."""
    with _prices_lock:
        ts = live_timestamps.get(token.strip())
        if ts is None:
            return None
        return (now_ist() - ts).total_seconds()


# â”€â”€ 5. WEBSOCKET EVENT HANDLERS (ON_DATA / ON_OPEN / ON_ERROR / ON_CLOSE) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def on_data(wsapp: Any = None, data: Any = None, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """
    Called on every tick from SmartWebSocketV2.
    Parses LTP, Cumulative Volume, and Open Interest.
    Thread-safely updates in-memory stores.
    """
    global _last_price_time, total_ticks_received

    message: Dict[str, Any] = data if isinstance(data, dict) else (args[0] if args and isinstance(args[0], dict) else {})
    if not message:
        return

    try:
        token = str(message.get("token", "")).strip()
        if not token or token == "None":
            return

        raw_price = message.get("last_traded_price")
        if raw_price is None or raw_price == 0:
            return

        # Convert paise to rupees (AngelOne WebSocket sends all prices in paise)
        ltp = float(raw_price) / 100.0

        # Sanity check price bounds
        if ltp < 0.05 or ltp > 1000000.0:
            return

        # Extract Volume & Open Interest if present (Mode 2 & 3)
        raw_volume = message.get("volume_trade_for_the_day") or message.get("volume")
        volume = int(raw_volume) if raw_volume is not None else None

        raw_oi = message.get("open_interest") or message.get("oi")
        oi = int(raw_oi) if raw_oi is not None else None

        # Extract Day OHLC & Previous Close (Mode 2 Quote)
        raw_high = message.get("high_price_of_the_day") or message.get("high")
        day_high = float(raw_high) / 100.0 if raw_high is not None and float(raw_high) > 0 else None

        raw_low = message.get("low_price_of_the_day") or message.get("low")
        day_low = float(raw_low) / 100.0 if raw_low is not None and float(raw_low) > 0 else None

        raw_open = message.get("open_price_of_the_day") or message.get("open")
        day_open = float(raw_open) / 100.0 if raw_open is not None and float(raw_open) > 0 else None

        raw_close = message.get("closed_price") or message.get("close") or message.get("prev_close")
        prev_close = float(raw_close) / 100.0 if raw_close is not None and float(raw_close) > 0 else None

        # Extract Best Bid & Ask (Mode 2/3 Quote & Depth)
        raw_bid = message.get("best_5_buy_data", [{}])[0].get("price") if isinstance(message.get("best_5_buy_data"), list) and message.get("best_5_buy_data") else (message.get("buy_price") or message.get("best_bid") or message.get("bid"))
        best_bid = float(raw_bid) / 100.0 if raw_bid is not None and float(raw_bid) > 0 else None

        raw_ask = message.get("best_5_sell_data", [{}])[0].get("price") if isinstance(message.get("best_5_sell_data"), list) and message.get("best_5_sell_data") else (message.get("sell_price") or message.get("best_ask") or message.get("ask"))
        best_ask = float(raw_ask) / 100.0 if raw_ask is not None and float(raw_ask) > 0 else None

        raw_bid_qty = message.get("best_5_buy_data", [{}])[0].get("quantity") if isinstance(message.get("best_5_buy_data"), list) and message.get("best_5_buy_data") else (message.get("buy_quantity") or message.get("bid_qty"))
        bid_qty = int(raw_bid_qty) if raw_bid_qty is not None else None

        raw_ask_qty = message.get("best_5_sell_data", [{}])[0].get("quantity") if isinstance(message.get("best_5_sell_data"), list) and message.get("best_5_sell_data") else (message.get("sell_quantity") or message.get("ask_qty"))
        ask_qty = int(raw_ask_qty) if raw_ask_qty is not None else None

        current_time = now_ist()

        # WS01: Thread-safe batch update
        with _prices_lock:
            live_prices[token] = ltp
            live_timestamps[token] = current_time
            total_ticks_received += 1
            if volume is not None:
                live_volumes[token] = volume
            if oi is not None:
                live_oi[token] = oi
            if day_high is not None:
                live_day_high[token] = day_high
            if day_low is not None:
                live_day_low[token] = day_low
            if day_open is not None:
                live_day_open[token] = day_open
            if prev_close is not None:
                live_prev_close[token] = prev_close
            if best_bid is not None:
                live_best_bid[token] = best_bid
            if best_ask is not None:
                live_best_ask[token] = best_ask
            if bid_qty is not None:
                live_bid_qty[token] = bid_qty
            if ask_qty is not None:
                live_ask_qty[token] = ask_qty

        _last_price_time = current_time

        # Dispatch to registered tick listeners
        with _listeners_lock:
            listeners = list(_tick_listeners)
        if listeners:
            tick_event = {
                "token": token,
                "ltp": ltp,
                "volume": volume,
                "oi": oi,
                "high": day_high,
                "low": day_low,
                "open": day_open,
                "prev_close": prev_close,
                "bid": best_bid,
                "ask": best_ask,
                "bid_qty": bid_qty,
                "ask_qty": ask_qty,
                "timestamp": current_time,
            }
            for listener in listeners:
                try:
                    listener(tick_event)
                except Exception as ex:
                    logger.warning(f"[WebSocket] Listener callback error: {ex}")

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[WebSocket] Tick parse error: {e} | payload: {message}")


def on_error(wsapp: Any = None, error: Any = None, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """Called on WebSocket error."""
    err = error if error is not None else (args[0] if args else "Unknown error")
    logger.error(f"[WebSocket Error] {now_ist().strftime('%H:%M:%S IST')} â€” {err}")


def on_close(wsapp: Any = None, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """
    Called when WebSocket disconnects.
    Clears stale prices immediately to prevent strategies executing on old data.
    Spawns background reconnect if shutdown was not intentionally requested.
    """
    global _stop_requested

    logger.warning(f"[WebSocket Closed] {now_ist().strftime('%H:%M:%S IST')}")

    with _prices_lock:
        live_prices.clear()
        live_volumes.clear()
        live_oi.clear()
        live_day_open.clear()
        live_day_high.clear()
        live_day_low.clear()
        live_prev_close.clear()
        live_best_bid.clear()
        live_best_ask.clear()
        live_bid_qty.clear()
        live_ask_qty.clear()
        live_timestamps.clear()

    logger.info("[WebSocket] Live caches cleared â€” system falling back to alternative feeds")

    # Send alert
    _send_telegram("âš ï¸ <b>MJONAI</b> â€” WebSocket disconnected. Initiating auto-recovery...")

    if _stop_requested:
        logger.info("[WebSocket] Stop was intentionally requested â€” skipping auto-reconnect")
        _stop_requested = False
        return

    # Trigger background reconnect thread
    threading.Thread(target=_reconnect_loop, daemon=True).start()


def _subscribe_in_chunks(client: Any, correlation_id: str, mode_val: int, token_list: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_chunk_size: int = 400) -> None:
    """Chunk subscriptions to strictly enforce AngelOne's 500-token per packet limit."""
    for item in token_list:
        exchange_type = item.get("exchangeType", 1)
        tokens = item.get("tokens", [])
        for i in range(0, len(tokens), max_chunk_size):
            chunk = tokens[i : i + max_chunk_size]
            payload = [{"exchangeType": exchange_type, "tokens": chunk}]
            client.subscribe(correlation_id, mode_val, payload)


def on_open(wsapp: Any = None, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """Called when WebSocket connection is established â€” subscribes token list."""
    logger.info(f"[WebSocket Connected] {now_ist().strftime('%H:%M:%S IST')}")

    if not _token_list:
        logger.warning("[WebSocket] No tokens to subscribe â€” token_list is empty")
        return

    client = wsapp if (wsapp is not None and hasattr(wsapp, "subscribe")) else _sws
    if client is not None:
        try:
            _subscribe_in_chunks(client, _correlation_id, _active_mode.value, _token_list)
            total_tokens = sum(len(item.get("tokens", [])) for item in _token_list)
            logger.info(f"[WebSocket] Subscribed to {total_tokens} instruments in Mode {_active_mode.name} (Chunked)")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[WebSocket] Subscription error on open: {e}")


# â”€â”€ 6. RESILIENT RECONNECT LOOP â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _reconnect_loop() -> None:
    """
    Exponential backoff reconnect loop running in a dedicated daemon thread.
    Attempts up to _MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS before alerting supervisor.
    """
    global _reconnect_attempts, _is_reconnecting

    with _reconnect_lock:
        if _is_reconnecting:
            logger.info("[WebSocket] Reconnect already in progress â€” skipping duplicate trigger")
            return
        _is_reconnecting = True

    try:
        delays = [2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
        for attempt in range(1, _MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS + 1):
            delay = delays[min(attempt - 1, len(delays) - 1)]
            logger.info(f"[WebSocket] Reconnect attempt {attempt}/{_MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS} (waiting {delay}s)...")
            time.sleep(delay)

            try:
                start_websocket(_token_list, mode=_active_mode)
                logger.info(f"[WebSocket] Reconnected successfully on attempt {attempt}")
                _reconnect_attempts = 0
                _send_telegram(f"âœ… <b>MJONAI</b> â€” WebSocket reconnected successfully (attempt {attempt}/{_MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS}).")
                return

            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"[WebSocket] Reconnect attempt {attempt} failed: {e}")
                _reconnect_attempts += 1

        logger.critical("[WebSocket] All reconnect attempts failed â€” supervisor alert sent")
        _send_telegram(
            "ðŸš¨ <b>MJONAI â€” WebSocket Recovery Failed</b>\n"
            f"All {_MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS} reconnect attempts failed.\n"
            "Live prices unavailable â€” fallback feeds active."
        )

    finally:
        _is_reconnecting = False


# â”€â”€ 7. LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT (START, RESTART, STOP, ACCESSORS) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def start_websocket(token_list: List[Dict[str, Any]], mode: WebSocketMode = WebSocketMode.QUOTE) -> None:
    """
    Start WebSocket connection in a daemon thread.
    Closes existing connection before creating a new socket.
    """
    global _sws, _token_list, _stop_requested, _active_mode

    _token_list = token_list
    _active_mode = mode
    _stop_requested = False

    # Close existing connection if active
    if _sws is not None:
        try:
            _sws.close_connection()
            time.sleep(1)
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        from SmartApi.smartWebSocketV2 import SmartWebSocketV2
        api_key = (os.getenv("ANGELONE_API_KEY") or "").strip()
        auth_token = (_auth_token or "").strip()
        client_id = (_client_id or "").strip()
        feed_token = (_feed_token or "").strip()

        if not (auth_token and api_key and client_id and feed_token):
            logger.warning("[WebSocket] Missing required credentials for live SmartWebSocketV2. Operating in offline/paper simulation mode.")
            return

        sws_instance = SmartWebSocketV2(auth_token, api_key, client_id, feed_token)
        _sws = sws_instance

        _sws.on_open = on_open
        _sws.on_data = on_data
        _sws.on_error = on_error
        _sws.on_close = on_close

        def run():
            try:
                logger.info("[WebSocket] Starting connect()...")
                sws_instance.connect()
                logger.info("[WebSocket] connect() loop exited.")
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("[WebSocket] connect() thread crashed")

        thread = threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True)
        thread.start()

        total_tokens = sum(len(item.get("tokens", [])) for item in token_list)
        logger.info(f"[WebSocket] Connecting for {total_tokens} symbols in Mode {mode.name}...")

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[WebSocket] Failed to initialize SmartWebSocketV2: {e}")
        raise


def restart_websocket() -> None:
    """Restart the existing websocket connection (used by supervisor upon staleness)."""
    logger.warning("[WebSocket] Restart requested by watchdog.")
    stop_websocket()
    time.sleep(1)
    start_websocket(_token_list, mode=_active_mode)


def stop_websocket() -> None:
    """Gracefully close WebSocket connection and prevent auto-reconnect."""
    global _sws, _stop_requested
    _stop_requested = True
    if _sws is not None:
        try:
            _sws.close_connection()
            logger.info("[WebSocket] Disconnected cleanly (stop requested)")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[WebSocket] Error during close: {e}")


def get_live_price(token: str) -> Optional[float]:

    with _prices_lock:
        return live_prices.get(token.strip())

    with _prices_lock:
        return live_volumes.get(token.strip())


def get_live_oi(token: str) -> Optional[int]:
    """Get real-time Open Interest for an F&O token."""
    with _prices_lock:
        return live_oi.get(token.strip())

    with _prices_lock:
        return live_day_low.get(token.strip())
