@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SectorPerformance:
    """Individual Sector Index Performance Snapshot."""
    sector: SectorIndex
    token: str
    ltp: float
    prev_close: float
    change_pct: float
    is_advancing: bool
    timestamp: datetime

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "sector": self.sector.value,
            "token": self.token,
            "ltp": self.ltp,
            "prev_close": self.prev_close,
            "change_pct": round(self.change_pct, 4),
            "is_advancing": self.is_advancing,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp.isoformat(),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SectorBreadthSnapshot:
    """
    Immutable Broad Market Sectoral Breadth Assessment.
    """
    timestamp: datetime
    breadth_pct: float               # Percentage of advancing sectors (0.0 to 1.0)
    advancing_count: int             # Number of advancing sectors
    declining_count: int             # Number of declining sectors
    unchanged_count: int             # Number of flat sectors
    total_sectors: int               # Total tracked sectors evaluated
    top_sector: Optional[str]        # Strongest outperforming sector name
    top_change_pct: Optional[float]  # Gain of strongest sector
    lag_sector: Optional[str]        # Weakest underperforming sector name
    lag_change_pct: Optional[float]  # Loss of weakest sector
    is_strong_bull: bool             # breadth_pct >= 0.60 (60% sectors green)
    is_strong_bear: bool             # breadth_pct <= 0.40 (40% sectors green)
    provenance_reason: str           # Human-readable quantitative audit trail
    sector_details: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "timestamp": self.timestamp.isoformat(),
            "breadth_pct": round(self.breadth_pct, 4),
            "advancing_count": self.advancing_count,
            "declining_count": self.declining_count,
            "unchanged_count": self.unchanged_count,
            "total_sectors": self.total_sectors,
            "top_sector": self.top_sector,
            "top_change_pct": round(self.top_change_pct, 4) if self.top_change_pct is not None else None,
            "lag_sector": self.lag_sector,
            "lag_change_pct": round(self.lag_change_pct, 4) if self.lag_change_pct is not None else None,
            "is_strong_bull": self.is_strong_bull,
            "is_strong_bear": self.is_strong_bear,
            "provenance_reason": self.provenance_reason,
            "sector_details": self.sector_details,
        }


# â”€â”€ 2. IN-MEMORY SECTOR STATE STORE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

_live_sector_prices: Dict[SectorIndex, Tuple[float, float, datetime]] = {}  # (ltp, prev_close, ts)
_sector_lock = threading.RLock()


def update_sector_price(sector: Union[SectorIndex, str], ltp: float, prev_close: float) -> None:
    """
    Ingest real-time tick for a sectoral index.
    """
    sec = SectorIndex(sector) if isinstance(sector, str) else sector
    if ltp <= 0.0 or prev_close <= 0.0:
        return
    with _sector_lock:
        _live_sector_prices[sec] = (ltp, prev_close, now_ist())


def clear_sector_prices() -> None:
    """Reset sector prices in memory."""
    with _sector_lock:
        _live_sector_prices.clear()


# â”€â”€ 3. BREADTH CALCULATION ENGINE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def calculate_sector_breadth(
    custom_returns: Optional[Union[Mapping[SectorIndex, float], Mapping[str, float], Mapping[Any, float]]] = None
) -> SectorBreadthSnapshot:
    """
    Calculate broad sectoral market breadth ratio and intermarket leaders/laggards.

    Args:
        custom_returns: Optional mapping of sector names/enums to percentage returns (e.g. {"NIFTY BANK": 0.012})
                        Used for simulations, backtesting, and unit test injection.

    Returns:
        SectorBreadthSnapshot: Typed immutable breadth snapshot.
    """
    now = now_ist()
    details: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    advancing = 0
    declining = 0
    unchanged = 0

    sorted_sectors: List[Tuple[str, float]] = []

    # 1. Path A: Custom Returns Injection
    if custom_returns is not None and len(custom_returns) > 0:
        for sec_key, chg in custom_returns.items():
            sec_name = sec_key.value if isinstance(sec_key, SectorIndex) else str(sec_key)
            is_adv = chg > 0.0001
            is_dec = chg < -0.0001
            if is_adv:
                advancing += 1
            elif is_dec:
                declining += 1
            else:
                unchanged += 1

            sorted_sectors.append((sec_name, chg))
            details[sec_name] = {
                "change_pct": round(chg, 4),
                "is_advancing": is_adv,
            }

    # 2. Path B: Live In-Memory Ticks
    else:
        with _sector_lock:
            for sec, (ltp, prev_close, _) in _live_sector_prices.items():
                chg = (ltp - prev_close) / prev_close if prev_close > 0 else 0.0
                is_adv = chg > 0.0001
                is_dec = chg < -0.0001
                if is_adv:
                    advancing += 1
                elif is_dec:
                    declining += 1
                else:
                    unchanged += 1

                sorted_sectors.append((sec.value, chg))
                details[sec.value] = {
                    "ltp": ltp,
                    "prev_close": prev_close,
                    "change_pct": round(chg, 4),
                    "is_advancing": is_adv,
                }

    total = len(sorted_sectors)

    # 3. Fallback: Zero active ticks available
    if total == 0:
        return SectorBreadthSnapshot(
            timestamp=now,
            breadth_pct=0.50,
            advancing_count=0,
            declining_count=0,
            unchanged_count=0,
            total_sectors=0,
            top_sector=None,
            top_change_pct=None,
            lag_sector=None,
            lag_change_pct=None,
            is_strong_bull=False,
            is_strong_bear=False,
            provenance_reason="Sector Breadth: Offline Baseline (50% Neutral)",
            sector_details={},
        )

    # Calculate metrics
    breadth_pct = advancing / total if total > 0 else 0.50
    sorted_sectors.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

    top_sec, top_chg = sorted_sectors[0]
    lag_sec, lag_chg = sorted_sectors[-1]

    is_strong_bull = breadth_pct >= 0.60
    is_strong_bear = breadth_pct <= 0.40

    if is_strong_bull:
        reason = f"Sector Breadth Strong ({breadth_pct*100:.0f}% Green: {advancing}/{total} sectors | Leader: {top_sec} {top_chg*100:+.2f}%)"
    elif is_strong_bear:
        reason = f"Sector Breadth Weak ({breadth_pct*100:.0f}% Green: {advancing}/{total} sectors | Laggard: {lag_sec} {lag_chg*100:+.2f}%)"
    else:
        reason = f"Sector Breadth Neutral ({breadth_pct*100:.0f}% Green: {advancing}/{total} sectors)"

    return SectorBreadthSnapshot(
        timestamp=now,
        breadth_pct=breadth_pct,
        advancing_count=advancing,
        declining_count=declining,
        unchanged_count=unchanged,
        total_sectors=total,
        top_sector=top_sec,
        top_change_pct=top_chg,
        lag_sector=lag_sec,
        lag_change_pct=lag_chg,
        is_strong_bull=is_strong_bull,
        is_strong_bear=is_strong_bear,
        provenance_reason=reason,
        sector_details=details,
    )


# â”€â”€ 4. ADVANCE / DECLINE & SECTOR RELATIVE STRENGTH ENGINES â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AdvanceDeclineSnapshot:
    """
    Immutable Broad Market Advance/Decline Participation Assessment.
    """
    advances: int
    declines: int
    unchanged: int
    ad_ratio: float
    ad_spread: int
    is_bullish: bool
    is_bearish: bool
    timestamp: datetime
    message: str

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "advances": self.advances,
            "declines": self.declines,
            "unchanged": self.unchanged,
            "ad_ratio": round(self.ad_ratio, 4),
            "ad_spread": self.ad_spread,
            "is_bullish": self.is_bullish,
            "is_bearish": self.is_bearish,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp.isoformat(),
            "message": self.message,
        }


def calculate_advance_decline_ratio(
    advances: int,
    declines: int,
    unchanged: int = 0
) -> AdvanceDeclineSnapshot:
    """
    Calculate market-wide Advance/Decline (A/D) participation ratio and net spread.
    """
    now = now_ist()
    safe_dec = max(1, declines)
    ad_ratio = advances / safe_dec
    spread = advances - declines

    is_bull = ad_ratio >= 1.5 and spread > 0
    is_bear = ad_ratio <= 0.65 or spread < 0

    if is_bull:
        msg = f"A/D Ratio Bullish Accumulation ({ad_ratio:.2f}x | Net +{spread} advances)"
    elif is_bear:
        msg = f"A/D Ratio Bearish Liquidation ({ad_ratio:.2f}x | Net {spread} declines)"
    else:
        msg = f"A/D Ratio Neutral ({ad_ratio:.2f}x | Spread: {spread:+d})"

    return AdvanceDeclineSnapshot(
        advances=advances,
        declines=declines,
        unchanged=unchanged,
        ad_ratio=ad_ratio,
        ad_spread=spread,
        is_bullish=is_bull,
        is_bearish=is_bear,
        timestamp=now,
        message=msg,
    )


def get_sector_relative_strength(
    nifty_change_pct: float,
    custom_returns: Optional[Union[Mapping[SectorIndex, float], Mapping[str, float], Mapping[Any, float]]] = None
) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """
    Calculate Sector Alpha / Relative Strength against Benchmark NIFTY 50.
    Returns dictionary mapping sector name -> relative alpha (sector_pct - nifty_pct).
    """
    rel_strength: Dict[str, float] = {}

    if custom_returns is not None and len(custom_returns) > 0:
        for sec_key, chg in custom_returns.items():
            sec_name = sec_key.value if isinstance(sec_key, SectorIndex) else str(sec_key)
            rel_strength[sec_name] = round(chg - nifty_change_pct, 4)
    else:
        with _sector_lock:
            for sec, (ltp, prev_close, _) in _live_sector_prices.items():
                chg = (ltp - prev_close) / prev_close if prev_close > 0 else 0.0
                rel_strength[sec.value] = round(chg - nifty_change_pct, 4)

    return rel_strength

"""
Module: data/token_resolver.py
Purpose: Universal Multi-Broker Instrument & Security Token Resolver Gateway.
         Decouples trading strategies, risk engines, and execution routers from
         broker-specific token formats and symbology conventions.
         Supports primary broker (AngelOne), failover brokers (Shoonya / Finvasia, Zerodha, Dhan, Fyers, IBKR),
         and simulated Paper trading environments (TD-013).

Architectural Principles:
  1. Universal Abstraction: Strategies call `TokenResolver.get_token("RELIANCE")` without broker lock-in.
  2. Multi-Broker Failover Ready (TD-013): Pluggable broker adapter registry for seamless runtime switching.
  3. High-Throughput Vector Resolution: `get_tokens_bulk()` for universe breadth and sector scanning.
  4. Rich Instrument Contract Metadata: Type-safe `InstrumentContract` representation across all asset classes.
  5. Multi-Exchange Option Chains: Native resolution for NSE, NFO, BSE, BFO (Sensex), MCX, and CDS.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import threading
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

# Ensure workspace root is in sys.path

if str(_root_dir) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_root_dir))

    INDEX_TOKEN_MAP,

# â”€â”€ 1. ENUMS & DATA CONTRACTS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class BrokerType(str, Enum):
    """Supported Broker Environments & Adapters."""
    ANGELONE            = "ANGELONE"
    SHOONYA             = "SHOONYA"              # Finvasia backup broker (TD-013)
    ZERODHA             = "ZERODHA"              # Kite Connect adapter
    DHAN                = "DHAN"                 # DhanHQ API adapter
    FYERS               = "FYERS"                # Fyers Data & Order API
    INTERACTIVE_BROKERS = "INTERACTIVE_BROKERS"  # Global Multi-Asset & US Equities
    PAPER               = "PAPER"                # Local In-Memory Paper Execution


class InstrumentType(str, Enum):
    """Institutional Instrument Asset Class Classification."""
    EQUITY    = "EQUITY"
    INDEX     = "INDEX"
    OPTION    = "OPTION"
    FUTURE    = "FUTURE"
    COMMODITY = "COMMODITY"
    CURRENCY  = "CURRENCY"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InstrumentContract:
    """
    Unified immutable instrument contract specification.
    Provides complete execution metadata across all brokers and exchanges.
    """
    symbol: str
    token: str
    exchange: str = "NSE"
    broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE
    instrument_type: InstrumentType = InstrumentType.EQUITY
    lot_size: int = 1
    tick_size: float = 0.05
    strike_price: Optional[float] = None
    expiry_date: Optional[str] = None
    option_type: Optional[str] = None  # "CE" or "PE"
    freeze_limit: Optional[int] = None
    is_tradable: bool = True

    def __getitem__(self, item: str) -> Any:
        return getattr(self, item)

    def get(self, item: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        return getattr(self, item, default)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert instrument contract to dictionary."""
        return {
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "token": self.token,
            "exchange": self.exchange,
            "broker": self.broker.value,
            "instrument_type": self.instrument_type.value,
            "lot_size": self.lot_size,
            "tick_size": self.tick_size,
            "strike_price": self.strike_price,
            "expiry_date": self.expiry_date,
            "option_type": self.option_type,
            "freeze_limit": self.freeze_limit,
            "is_tradable": self.is_tradable,
        }


# â”€â”€ 2. PLUGGABLE MULTI-BROKER ADAPTER REGISTRY â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

_CUSTOM_TOKEN_RESOLVERS: Dict[BrokerType, Callable[[str, str], Optional[str]]] = {}
_CUSTOM_SYMBOL_RESOLVERS: Dict[BrokerType, Callable[[str, str], Optional[str]]] = {}
_CUSTOM_CONTRACT_RESOLVERS: Dict[BrokerType, Callable[[str, str], Optional[InstrumentContract]]] = {}
_registry_lock = threading.Lock()


def register_broker_token_resolver(
    broker: BrokerType,
    resolver_fn: Callable[[str, str], Optional[str]]
) -> None:
    """Register custom symbol-to-token resolver function for a secondary broker."""
    with _registry_lock:
        _CUSTOM_TOKEN_RESOLVERS[broker] = resolver_fn
    logger.info(f"[token_resolver] Registered custom token resolver for broker: {broker.value}")


def register_broker_symbol_resolver(
    broker: BrokerType,
    resolver_fn: Callable[[str, str], Optional[str]]
) -> None:
    """Register custom token-to-symbol reverse resolver function for a secondary broker."""
    with _registry_lock:
        _CUSTOM_SYMBOL_RESOLVERS[broker] = resolver_fn
    logger.info(f"[token_resolver] Registered custom symbol resolver for broker: {broker.value}")


def register_broker_contract_resolver(
    broker: BrokerType,
    resolver_fn: Callable[[str, str], Optional[InstrumentContract]]
) -> None:
    """Register custom full contract resolver function for a secondary broker."""
    with _registry_lock:
        _CUSTOM_CONTRACT_RESOLVERS[broker] = resolver_fn
    logger.info(f"[token_resolver] Registered custom contract resolver for broker: {broker.value}")


def reset_custom_resolvers() -> None:
    """Clear all dynamically registered custom broker resolvers (useful for test teardowns)."""
    with _registry_lock:
        _CUSTOM_TOKEN_RESOLVERS.clear()
        _CUSTOM_SYMBOL_RESOLVERS.clear()
        _CUSTOM_CONTRACT_RESOLVERS.clear()


# â”€â”€ 3. UNIVERSAL TOKEN RESOLVER GATEWAY â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class TokenResolver:
    """
    Universal Instrument Token Resolver Gateway.
    Strategies and execution routers query this gateway to resolve security tokens and contract specs.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def get_token(
        symbol: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE,
        exchange: str = "NSE"
    ) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Resolve security token for a given symbol, broker, and exchange.
        Pass-through: If an integer token string is passed, returns it directly.
        """
        if not symbol:
            return None

        clean_sym = symbol.strip()
        if clean_sym.isdigit():
            return clean_sym

        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            return _angel_get_token(clean_sym, exchange=exchange)

        with _registry_lock:
            resolver = _CUSTOM_TOKEN_RESOLVERS.get(broker)

        if resolver:
            try:
                return resolver(clean_sym, exchange)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"[token_resolver] Custom resolver failed for {broker.value}:{clean_sym}: {e}")
                return None

        logger.warning(f"[token_resolver] No token resolver registered for broker: {broker.value}")
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def get_tokens_bulk(
        symbols: List[str],
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE,
        exchange: str = "NSE"
    ) -> Dict[str, Optional[str]]:
        """
        High-throughput batch resolution of security tokens for a list of symbols.
        Essential for market breadth, index constituents, and sector momentum scanners.
        """
        results: Dict[str, Optional[str]] = {}
        for sym in symbols:
            results[sym] = TokenResolver.get_token(sym, broker=broker, exchange=exchange)
        return results

    @staticmethod
    def get_symbol(
        token: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE,
        exchange: str = "NSE"
    ) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Reverse lookup: resolve canonical symbol name from broker instrument token.
        """
        if not token:
            return None

        clean_token = token.strip()
        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            return _angel_get_symbol(clean_token, exchange=exchange)

        with _registry_lock:
            resolver = _CUSTOM_SYMBOL_RESOLVERS.get(broker)

        if resolver:
            try:
                return resolver(clean_token, exchange)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"[token_resolver] Custom reverse resolver failed for {broker.value}:{clean_token}: {e}")
                return None

        return None

    @staticmethod
    def get_index_token(
        index_name: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE
    ) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Resolve spot index token (e.g. 'NIFTY', 'BANKNIFTY', 'FINNIFTY', 'MIDCPNIFTY', 'SENSEX', 'INDIAVIX').
        """
        if not index_name:
            return None

        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            return _angel_get_index_token(index_name)

        return TokenResolver.get_token(index_name, broker=broker, exchange="NSE")

    @staticmethod
    def get_option_token(
        underlying: str,
        expiry_str: str,
        strike_price: float,
        option_type: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE,
        exchange: str = "NFO"
    ) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Resolve live option contract strike token across NFO, BFO (Sensex), and MCX options.
        """
        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            return _angel_get_option_token(underlying, expiry_str, strike_price, option_type)

        return None

    @staticmethod
    def get_atm_strike(
        underlying: str,
        spot_price: float,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE
    ) -> float:
        """
        Calculate mathematical At-The-Money (ATM) strike price rounded to instrument step size.
        """
        return _angel_get_atm_strike(underlying, spot_price)

    @staticmethod
    def get_option_chain_tokens(
        underlying: str,
        expiry_str: str,
        spot_price: float,
        num_strikes: int = 5,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        High-throughput multi-strike ladder generation (ITM, ATM, OTM strikes).
        Returns a dictionary containing underlying, atm_strike, strikes ladder, and tokens list.
        """
        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            return _angel_get_option_chain_tokens(underlying, expiry_str, spot_price, num_strikes=num_strikes)
        return {}

    @staticmethod
    def translate_symbol(
        symbol: str,
        from_broker: BrokerType,
        to_broker: BrokerType,
        exchange: str = "NSE"
    ) -> str:
        """
        Translate symbol notation between broker conventions during failover execution.
        """
        if from_broker == to_broker:
            return symbol

        # Canonical normalization
        clean = symbol.strip().upper()
        clean = clean.replace("NSE:", "").replace("BSE:", "").replace("-EQ", "").replace(".NS", "").replace(".BO", "")
        return clean

    @staticmethod
    def get_lot_size(
        symbol: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE
    ) -> int:
        """
        Resolve live market lot size for an instrument. Defaults to 1 for cash equity.
        """
        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            lot = _angel_get_lot_size(symbol)
            return lot if lot is not None and lot > 0 else 1

        return 1

    @staticmethod
    def get_tick_size(
        symbol: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE
    ) -> float:
        """
        Resolve minimum tick size for an instrument. Defaults to 0.05.
        """
        if broker in (BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.PAPER):
            tick = _angel_get_tick_size(symbol)
            return tick if tick is not None and tick > 0 else 0.05

        return 0.05

    @staticmethod
    def get_contract(
        symbol_or_token: str,
        broker: BrokerType = BrokerType.ANGELONE,
        exchange: str = "NSE"
    ) -> Optional[InstrumentContract]:
        """
        Resolve full type-safe InstrumentContract metadata representation.
        """
        if not symbol_or_token:
            return None

        clean_input = symbol_or_token.strip()

        # 1. Check custom broker contract resolver
        with _registry_lock:
            custom_resolver = _CUSTOM_CONTRACT_RESOLVERS.get(broker)
        if custom_resolver:
            contract = custom_resolver(clean_input, exchange)
            if contract:
                return contract

        # 2. Standard AngelOne / Paper resolution path
        if clean_input.isdigit():
            token = clean_input
            symbol = TokenResolver.get_symbol(token, broker=broker, exchange=exchange) or token
        else:
            symbol = clean_input
            token = TokenResolver.get_token(symbol, broker=broker, exchange=exchange)

        if not token:
            return None

        # Determine instrument type
        upper_sym = symbol.upper()
        if upper_sym in INDEX_TOKEN_MAP or "NIFTY" in upper_sym or "SENSEX" in upper_sym:
            inst_type = InstrumentType.INDEX
        elif exchange.upper() in ("NFO", "BFO"):
            inst_type = InstrumentType.OPTION if ("CE" in upper_sym or "PE" in upper_sym) else InstrumentType.FUTURE
        elif exchange.upper() == "MCX":
            inst_type = InstrumentType.COMMODITY
        elif exchange.upper() == "CDS":
            inst_type = InstrumentType.CURRENCY
        else:
            inst_type = InstrumentType.EQUITY

        lot = TokenResolver.get_lot_size(symbol, broker=broker)
        tick = TokenResolver.get_tick_size(symbol, broker=broker)

        return InstrumentContract(
            symbol=symbol,
            token=token,
            exchange=exchange.upper(),
            broker=broker,
            instrument_type=inst_type,
            lot_size=lot,
            tick_size=tick,
            is_tradable=True,
        )

# â”€â”€ 2. DEFENSIVE SANITIZATION & CONVERTERS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _sanitize_payload(data: Any) -> Any:
    """Recursively sanitize dictionaries/lists converting NaN/Inf floats to None."""
    if isinstance(data, float):
        if math.isnan(data) or math.isinf(data):
            return None
        return data
    elif isinstance(data, dict):
        return {k: _sanitize_payload(v) for k, v in data.items()}
    elif isinstance(data, (list, tuple)):
        return [_sanitize_payload(v) for v in data]
    return data


def _safe_int(val: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    """Safely convert any JSON/database value to int."""
    try:
        if val is None or isinstance(val, (list, dict, tuple)):
            return default
        return int(val)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return default


def _safe_float(val: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    """Safely convert any JSON/database value to float."""
    try:
        if val is None or isinstance(val, (list, dict, tuple)):
            return default
        f = float(val)
        return default if math.isnan(f) or math.isinf(f) else f
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return default


def _safe_list(val: Any) -> List[str]:
    """Safely convert any JSON/database value to a list of strings."""
    if isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
        return [str(item) for item in val if item is not None]
    return []


# â”€â”€ 3. LOCAL DURABLE WAL JOURNAL â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _append_agent_journal(event_type: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Durable local WAL journal for agent logs during network disconnects."""
    try:
        _STORAGE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = {
            "event_type": event_type,
            "payload": payload,
            "timestamp_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        }
        with open(_AGENT_JOURNAL_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] Failed to write local journal: {e}")


def replay_agent_journal() -> int:
    """
    Automated WAL Journal Replay Protocol for Agent Logs.
    Flushes buffered offline records to Supabase.
    """
    if not _AGENT_JOURNAL_FILE.exists() or not is_db_connected():
        return 0

    replayed_count = 0
    remaining_records = []

    try:
        with open(_AGENT_JOURNAL_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()

        for line in lines:
            line_str = line.strip()
            if not line_str:
                continue
            try:
                entry = json.loads(line_str)
                event_type = entry.get("event_type")
                payload = entry.get("payload", {})

                if event_type == "INSERT_AGENT_LOG":
                    sb.table("agent_logs").insert(payload).execute()
                    replayed_count += 1
                elif event_type == "UPDATE_AGENT_OUTCOME":
                    log_id = payload.get("id")
                    if log_id:
                        up_payload = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "id"}
                        sb.table("agent_logs").update(up_payload).eq("id", log_id).execute()
                        replayed_count += 1
                else:
                    remaining_records.append(line)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"[db.agents] Replay item failed, keeping in WAL: {e}")
                remaining_records.append(line)

        if not remaining_records:
            _AGENT_JOURNAL_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            logger.info(f"[db.agents] Replayed {replayed_count} buffered records from local WAL.")
        else:
            with open(_AGENT_JOURNAL_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.writelines(remaining_records)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] Error during agent WAL replay: {e}")

    return replayed_count


# â”€â”€ 4. CORE AGENT LOGGING OPERATIONS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def insert_agent_log(log: Union[dict, AgentLogRecord]) -> dict:
    """
    Insert a single agent call record into agent_logs.
    Called after every LLM evaluation.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    raw_dict = log.to_dict() if isinstance(log, AgentLogRecord) else log
    if not isinstance(raw_dict, dict) or not raw_dict:
        return {}

    sanitized = _sanitize_payload(raw_dict)
    now_str = now_ist().isoformat()
    record = {
        **sanitized,
        "called_at": sanitized.get("called_at", now_str),
        "updated_at": now_str,
    }

    try:
        def _execute():
            return sb.table("agent_logs").insert(record).execute()

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        return result.data[0] if result.data else record
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] insert_agent_log failed: {e} -> Buffering to WAL.")
        _append_agent_journal("INSERT_AGENT_LOG", record)
        return record


def insert_agent_logs_bulk(logs: Sequence[Union[dict, AgentLogRecord]]) -> List[dict]:
    """
    High-throughput batch insertion for full AI committee debates.
    Reduces N sequential network roundtrips into a single vectorized query.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    if not logs:
        return []

    now_str = now_ist().isoformat()
    sanitized_records = []

    for l in logs:
        raw_dict = l.to_dict() if isinstance(l, AgentLogRecord) else l
        if isinstance(raw_dict, dict) and raw_dict:
            clean = _sanitize_payload(raw_dict)
            if "called_at" not in clean:
                clean["called_at"] = now_str
            clean["updated_at"] = now_str
            sanitized_records.append(clean)

    if not sanitized_records:
        return []

    try:
        def _execute():
            return sb.table("agent_logs").insert(sanitized_records).execute()

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        return result.data or sanitized_records
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] insert_agent_logs_bulk failed for {len(sanitized_records)} items: {e}")
        for rec in sanitized_records:
            _append_agent_journal("INSERT_AGENT_LOG", rec)
        return sanitized_records


# â”€â”€ 5. OUTCOME ATTRIBUTION & MULTI-ROLE EVALUATION â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def evaluate_verdict_accuracy(agent_name: str, verdict: str, outcome: str) -> Optional[bool]:
    """
    Directional accuracy evaluator accounting for specialized committee roles.
    BULL / SUPERVISOR: BUY/APPROVE + WIN = True, REJECT/SELL + LOSS = True
    BEAR / DEVIL:      WARN/REJECT/SELL + LOSS = True, BUY/APPROVE + WIN = True
    """
    v_clean = str(verdict).strip().upper()
    o_clean = str(outcome).strip().upper()
    a_clean = str(agent_name).strip().upper()

    if o_clean == "BREAKEVEN":
        return None

    is_bullish = v_clean in ("BUY", "STRONG_BUY", "APPROVE", "BULLISH")
    is_bearish = v_clean in ("SELL", "REJECT", "BEARISH", "HIGH_RISK", "VETO")

    if o_clean == "WIN":
        if is_bullish:
            return True
        elif is_bearish:
            return False
    elif o_clean == "LOSS":
        if is_bearish:
            return True
        elif is_bullish:
            return False

    return None


def update_agent_log_outcome(
    signal_id: str,
    actual_outcome: str,
    actual_rr: Optional[float] = None,
) -> bool:
    """
    Update all agent_log rows for a signal with trade outcome.
    Evaluates was_correct based on directional role intelligence.
    """
    if not signal_id:
        return False
    from core.time_utils import now_ist

    try:
        def _fetch_rows():
            return (
                sb.table("agent_logs")
                .select("id, agent_name, raw_verdict")
                .eq("signal_id", signal_id)
                .execute()
            )

        fetch_res = _execute_with_retry(_fetch_rows, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        rows = fetch_res.data or []
        if not rows:
            return False

        now_str = now_ist().isoformat()
        clean_rr = round(actual_rr, 4) if actual_rr is not None and not math.isnan(actual_rr) else None
        success = True

        for row in rows:
            agent_name = str(row.get("agent_name") or "")
            verdict = str(row.get("raw_verdict") or "")
            was_correct = evaluate_verdict_accuracy(agent_name, verdict, actual_outcome)

            update_payload = {
                "actual_outcome": str(actual_outcome).upper(),
                "actual_rr": clean_rr,
                "was_correct": was_correct,
                "updated_at": now_str,
            }
            sanitized = _sanitize_payload(update_payload)

            try:
                def _execute_update(log_id=row["id"], p=sanitized):
                    return sb.table("agent_logs").update(p).eq("id", log_id).execute()

                _execute_with_retry(_execute_update, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"[db.agents] Failed updating agent row {row.get('id')}: {e}")
                _append_agent_journal("UPDATE_AGENT_OUTCOME", {"id": row.get("id"), **sanitized})
                success = False

        return success
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] update_agent_log_outcome failed for signal {signal_id}: {e}")
        return False


# â”€â”€ 6. STATISTICAL ACCURACY & TELEMETRY SCORING â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_agent_accuracy(
    agent_name: str,
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH",
    lookback_days: int = 30,
) -> dict:
    """
    Return rolling accuracy statistics and Laplace-smoothed confidence for a given agent.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    clean_agent = agent_name.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()

    try:
        since = (now_ist() - timedelta(days=lookback_days)).isoformat()

        def _execute_query():
            return (
                sb.table("agent_logs")
                .select("was_correct, raw_verdict, actual_outcome")
                .eq("agent_name", clean_agent)
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .gte("called_at", since)
                .not_.is_("was_correct", "null")
                .execute()
            )

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute_query, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        rows = result.data or []
        if not rows:
            return {
                "agent_name": clean_agent,
                "total_calls": 0,
                "correct_calls": 0,
                "accuracy_pct": None,
                "laplace_accuracy_pct": None,
                "lookback_days": lookback_days,
                "system_mode": sys_mode,
            }

        total = len(rows)
        correct = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("was_correct") is True)
        accuracy_pct = round((correct / total) * 100.0, 1) if total > 0 else None
        laplace_accuracy_pct = round(((correct + 1) / (total + 2)) * 100.0, 1)

        return {
            "agent_name": clean_agent,
            "total_calls": total,
            "correct_calls": correct,
            "accuracy_pct": accuracy_pct,
            "laplace_accuracy_pct": laplace_accuracy_pct,
            "lookback_days": lookback_days,
            "system_mode": sys_mode,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] get_agent_accuracy failed for {clean_agent}: {e}")
        return {
            "agent_name": clean_agent,
            "total_calls": 0,
            "correct_calls": 0,
            "accuracy_pct": None,
            "laplace_accuracy_pct": None,
            "lookback_days": lookback_days,
            "system_mode": sys_mode,
        }


def get_all_agents_accuracy_summary(
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH",
    lookback_days: int = 30,
) -> List[dict]:
    """
    Return comprehensive committee scoreboard in a single aggregated query.
    Dynamically discovers all active agents (Bull, Bear, Devil, Economist, Supervisor,
    Sentiment, Fundamentals, etc.) to support open-ended multi-agent expansion.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()
    standard_agents = ["BULL", "BEAR", "DEVIL", "ECONOMIST", "SUPERVISOR"]

    try:
        since = (now_ist() - timedelta(days=lookback_days)).isoformat()

        def _execute_query():
            return (
                sb.table("agent_logs")
                .select("agent_name, was_correct")
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .gte("called_at", since)
                .not_.is_("was_correct", "null")
                .execute()
            )

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute_query, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        rows = result.data or []

        # Group stats by agent dynamically
        agent_stats: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {a: {"total": 0, "correct": 0} for a in standard_agents}
        for r in rows:
            name = str(r.get("agent_name") or "").strip().upper()
            if not name:
                continue
            if name not in agent_stats:
                agent_stats[name] = {"total": 0, "correct": 0}
            agent_stats[name]["total"] += 1
            if r.get("was_correct") is True:
                agent_stats[name]["correct"] += 1

        summary = []
        for name, stats in agent_stats.items():
            tot = stats["total"]
            cor = stats["correct"]
            summary.append({
                "agent_name": name,
                "total_calls": tot,
                "correct_calls": cor,
                "accuracy_pct": round((cor / tot) * 100.0, 1) if tot > 0 else None,
                "laplace_accuracy_pct": round(((cor + 1) / (tot + 2)) * 100.0, 1),
                "lookback_days": lookback_days,
                "system_mode": sys_mode,
            })
        return summary
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] get_all_agents_accuracy_summary failed: {e}")
        return [
            {
                "agent_name": a,
                "total_calls": 0,
                "correct_calls": 0,
                "accuracy_pct": None,
                "laplace_accuracy_pct": None,
                "lookback_days": lookback_days,
                "system_mode": sys_mode,
            }
            for a in standard_agents
        ]


def get_agent_telemetry_summary(
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH",
    lookback_days: int = 30,
) -> dict:
    """
    Aggregate token consumption, latency, and estimated cost across all LLMs.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()

    try:
        since = (now_ist() - timedelta(days=lookback_days)).isoformat()

        def _execute_query():
            return (
                sb.table("agent_logs")
                .select("agent_name, agent_model, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens")
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .gte("called_at", since)
                .execute()
            )

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute_query, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        rows = result.data or []
        if not rows:
            return {
                "total_calls": 0,
                "total_prompt_tokens": 0,
                "total_completion_tokens": 0,
                "avg_latency_ms": 0.0,
                "estimated_cost_usd": 0.0,
                "lookback_days": lookback_days,
                "system_mode": sys_mode,
            }

        total_calls = len(rows)
        total_p_tokens = sum(_safe_int(r.get("prompt_tokens")) for r in rows)
        total_c_tokens = sum(_safe_int(r.get("completion_tokens")) for r in rows)
        latencies = [_safe_float(r.get("latency_ms")) for r in rows if r.get("latency_ms") is not None]
        avg_latency = round(sum(latencies) / len(latencies), 1) if latencies else 0.0

        # Estimated cost model: ~$5 per 1M prompt tokens, ~$15 per 1M completion tokens
        est_cost = round(((total_p_tokens / 1_000_000) * 5.0) + ((total_c_tokens / 1_000_000) * 15.0), 4)

        return {
            "total_calls": total_calls,
            "total_prompt_tokens": total_p_tokens,
            "total_completion_tokens": total_c_tokens,
            "avg_latency_ms": avg_latency,
            "estimated_cost_usd": est_cost,
            "lookback_days": lookback_days,
            "system_mode": sys_mode,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.agents] get_agent_telemetry_summary failed: {e}")
        return {
            "total_calls": 0,
            "total_prompt_tokens": 0,
            "total_completion_tokens": 0,
            "avg_latency_ms": 0.0,
            "estimated_cost_usd": 0.0,
            "lookback_days": lookback_days,
            "system_mode": sys_mode,
        }

"""
Module: db/client.py

Purpose: Centralized Database Connection, Supabase Client Lifecycle,
         Thread-Safe Lazy Proxy, Connection Health Management, Network Ping Probes,
         Exponential Backoff Resilience, and Query Performance Metrics.

Architectural Principles:
  1. Single Connection Provider shared across all db submodules.
  2. Thread-Safe Mutex Initialization (Double-checked locking pattern).
  3. Enterprise Connection Pooling & Strict Timeout Protection (httpx limits & timeouts).
  4. Non-Throwing Connection Health Probes (is_db_connected) & Active Round-Trip Ping (ping_db).
  5. Transient Network Failure Resilience with Jittered Exponential Backoff (execute_with_retry).
  6. Live Query Metrics & Latency Profiling (get_db_metrics, reset_db_metrics).
  7. Automated Self-Healing & Reconnection Hooks (reset_db_client).
  8. 100% Backwards-Compatible Public API (sb.table(...)).
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import logging
import os
import random
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Optional, TypeVar

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
    load_dotenv()
except ImportError:
    pass

_client_instance = None
_init_lock = threading.Lock()

# â”€â”€ 1. REAL-TIME QUERY METRICS & TELEMETRY â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
_metrics_lock = threading.Lock()
_METRICS = {
    "total_queries": 0,
    "successful_queries": 0,
    "failed_queries": 0,
    "retried_queries": 0,
    "last_latency_ms": 0.0,
    "total_latency_ms": 0.0,
    "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
}


def _record_metric(latency_ms: float, success: bool = True, retried: bool = False) -> None:
    """Thread-safe recording of database query telemetry."""
    with _metrics_lock:
        _METRICS["total_queries"] += 1
        if success:
            _METRICS["successful_queries"] += 1
        else:
            _METRICS["failed_queries"] += 1
        if retried:
            _METRICS["retried_queries"] += 1
        _METRICS["last_latency_ms"] = round(latency_ms, 2)
        _METRICS["total_latency_ms"] += latency_ms


def get_db_metrics() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Return thread-safe snapshot of database query metrics, throughput, and latency.
    Used by Health Monitors and System Observability Dashboards.
    """
    with _metrics_lock:
        total = _METRICS["total_queries"]
        avg_lat = (_METRICS["total_latency_ms"] / total) if total > 0 else 0.0
        return {
            "total_queries": total,
            "successful_queries": _METRICS["successful_queries"],
            "failed_queries": _METRICS["failed_queries"],
            "retried_queries": _METRICS["retried_queries"],
            "success_rate_pct": round((_METRICS["successful_queries"] / total * 100.0), 2) if total > 0 else 100.0,
            "last_latency_ms": _METRICS["last_latency_ms"],
            "avg_latency_ms": round(avg_lat, 2),
            "started_at_utc": _METRICS["started_at_utc"],
        }


def reset_db_metrics() -> None:
    """Reset query metrics (used for daily session rollover & test isolation)."""
    with _metrics_lock:
        _METRICS["total_queries"] = 0
        _METRICS["successful_queries"] = 0
        _METRICS["failed_queries"] = 0
        _METRICS["retried_queries"] = 0
        _METRICS["last_latency_ms"] = 0.0
        _METRICS["total_latency_ms"] = 0.0
        _METRICS["started_at_utc"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


# â”€â”€ 2. SUPABASE CLIENT SINGLETON â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_supabase_client():
    """
    Thread-safe lazy initialization of Supabase client instance.
    Uses double-checked locking to prevent initialization race conditions.
    Configures connection pooling and strict socket timeouts via ClientOptions.
    """
    global _client_instance
    if _client_instance is None:
        with _init_lock:
            if _client_instance is None:
                try:
                    import httpx
                    from supabase import create_client, ClientOptions

                    url = os.getenv("SUPABASE_URL")
                    key = os.getenv("SUPABASE_KEY")
                    if url and key:
                        # Configure resilient HTTP connection pool with explicit timeouts
                        custom_http_client = httpx.Client(
                            timeout=httpx.Timeout(10.0, connect=5.0),
                            limits=httpx.Limits(max_keepalive_connections=20, max_connections=50)
                        )
                        options = ClientOptions(httpx_client=custom_http_client)
                        _client_instance = create_client(url.strip(), key.strip(), options=options)
                        logger.info("[db.client] Supabase client initialized with connection pooling.")
                    else:
                        logger.warning("[db.client] SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_KEY not set in environment.")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"[db.client] Failed to create Supabase client: {e}")
    return _client_instance


def is_db_connected() -> bool:
    """
    Non-throwing passive health probe inspecting whether the client instance is instantiated.
    Used by Health Monitors, Startup Guards, and Pre-Trade Risk Gates.
    """
    client = get_supabase_client()
    return client is not None


def ping_db(timeout_seconds: float = 3.0) -> bool:
    """
    Active round-trip network probe to verify database server responsiveness.
    Executes a minimal non-blocking query to distinguish between client instantiation vs real network reachability.
    """
    client = get_supabase_client()
    if client is None:
        return False
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        _ = client.table("system_logs").select("id").limit(1).execute()
        latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0
        _record_metric(latency_ms, success=True)
        logger.debug(f"[db.client] Database ping successful ({latency_ms:.1f}ms)")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0
        _record_metric(latency_ms, success=False)
        logger.warning(f"[db.client] Database ping probe failed: {e}")
        return False


def reset_db_client():
    """
    Reset client instance to force clean re-initialization on next access.
    Used for automated recovery after network reconnections or token refreshes.
    """
    global _client_instance
    with _init_lock:
        _client_instance = None
        logger.info("[db.client] Database client instance reset.")


# â”€â”€ 3. RESILIENT EXPONENTIAL BACKOFF RETRY WRAPPER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

T = TypeVar("T")


def execute_with_retry(
    query_fn: Callable[[], T],
    max_retries: int = 3,
    initial_delay: float = 0.2,
    backoff_factor: float = 2.0,
    retry_on_exceptions: tuple = (Exception,)
) -> T:
    """
    Execute a database query with jittered exponential backoff for transient network glitches (429/502/503).
    Logs telemetry metrics and gracefully propagates non-retryable errors.
    """
    last_exception: Optional[Exception] = None
    delay = initial_delay

    for attempt in range(1, max_retries + 1):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            result = query_fn()
            latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0
            _record_metric(latency_ms, success=True, retried=(attempt > 1))
            return result
        except retry_on_exceptions as exc:
            latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0
            last_exception = exc
            is_last_attempt = (attempt == max_retries)

            if is_last_attempt:
                _record_metric(latency_ms, success=False, retried=(attempt > 1))
                logger.error(f"[db.client] Query failed permanently after {max_retries} attempts: {exc}")
                raise exc

            # Calculate jittered exponential backoff
            jitter = random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)
            sleep_time = delay * jitter
            logger.warning(f"[db.client] Transient query error (attempt {attempt}/{max_retries}): {exc}. Retrying in {sleep_time:.2f}s...")
            time.sleep(sleep_time)
            delay *= backoff_factor

    if last_exception:
        raise last_exception
    raise RuntimeError("[db.client] execute_with_retry failed with unknown state")


# â”€â”€ 4. TRANSPARENT LAZY PROXY â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class _SupabaseClientProxy:
    """
    Proxy object providing transparent, backward-compatible access to the Supabase client.
    Defers client connection until first attribute access (e.g. sb.table(...)).
    """
    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
        client = get_supabase_client()
        if client is not None:
            return getattr(client, name)
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"[db.client] Cannot access '{name}': Supabase client not initialized. "
            "Please verify SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_KEY in your environment (.env)."
        )

    def is_connected(self) -> bool:
        """Helper to check passive connection status directly via proxy."""
        return is_db_connected()

    def ping(self, timeout_seconds: float = 3.0) -> bool:
        """Helper to check active network reachability directly via proxy."""
        return ping_db(timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds)

    def metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Helper to inspect live query telemetry via proxy."""
        return get_db_metrics()

    def execute_with_retry(self, query_fn: Callable[[], T], max_retries: int = 3) -> T:
        """Helper to run queries with automatic exponential backoff."""
        return execute_with_retry(query_fn, max_retries=max_retries)


# Shared singleton proxy instance (backwards-compatible with sb.table(...))
sb = _SupabaseClientProxy()

"""
Module: db/patterns.py

Purpose: Institutional Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Failure Learning,
         Deterministic Fingerprinting, Statistical Expectancy, Streak Detection,
         and Microsecond In-Memory Hot-Path Caching.

Architectural Principles:
  1. Deterministic Multi-Factor Fingerprinting (generate_setup_hash).
  2. Bayesian Statistical Rigor (Laplace-smoothed win rates, Mathematical Expectancy, Profit Factor).
  3. Toxic Streak Detection (get_consecutive_losses on rolling last_10_outcomes).
  4. Microsecond Hot-Path LRU Cache (< 10us pre-trade latency for devil_checks).
  5. Thread-Safe Concurrency Protection (Lock-guarded atomic outcome updates).
  6. Strict Environment Isolation (system_mode partitioning across LIVE, PAPER, RESEARCH).
  7. Offline Durable WAL Journaling & Replay Protocol (replay_pattern_journal).
  8. Pattern Lifecycle Management (quarantine, reactivate, soft_delete).
  9. Recursive Float Sanitization (NaN/Inf -> None conversion to prevent PostgreSQL aborts).
 10. 100% Backwards-Compatible Public API for all existing callers.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import json
import logging
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from db.client import sb, is_db_connected, execute_with_retry as _execute_with_retry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Local durable journal & storage
_STORAGE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "storage"
_PATTERNS_JOURNAL_FILE = _STORAGE_DIR / "patterns_journal.jsonl"

# Thread-safe in-memory hot-path cache: key -> (PatternMemoryRecord or dict, expiration_timestamp)
_PATTERN_CACHE: Dict[str, Tuple[Dict[str, Any], float]] = {}
_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 60.0
_PATTERN_LOCK = threading.RLock()


# â”€â”€ 1. DETERMINISTIC SETUP HASH GENERATION â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def generate_setup_hash(
    symbol: str,
    strategy_id: str,
    sl_method: str = "STRUCTURE",
    market_state: str = "NEUTRAL",
    vix_range: str = "NORMAL",
    candle_pattern: str = "NONE",
) -> str:
    """
    Generate canonical deterministic setup fingerprint.
    Format: {SYMBOL}_{STRATEGY_ID}_{SL_METHOD}_{MARKET_STATE}_{VIX_RANGE}_{CANDLE_PATTERN}
    Example: RELIANCE_S01_STRUCTURE_BULL_LOW_HAMMER
    """
    clean_sym = str(symbol).strip().upper().replace(" ", "")
    clean_strat = str(strategy_id).strip().upper().replace(" ", "")
    clean_sl = str(sl_method).strip().upper().replace(" ", "")
    clean_ms = str(market_state).strip().upper().replace(" ", "")
    clean_vix = str(vix_range).strip().upper().replace(" ", "")
    clean_pat = str(candle_pattern).strip().upper().replace(" ", "")

    return f"{clean_sym}_{clean_strat}_{clean_sl}_{clean_ms}_{clean_vix}_{clean_pat}"


# â”€â”€ 2. TYPE-SAFE IMMUTABLE DATA CONTRACT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PatternMemoryRecord:
    """
    Immutable representation of a multi-factor pattern memory record.
    Captures Bayesian historical performance and risk metrics.
    """
    setup_hash: str
    symbol: str
    strategy_id: str
    sl_method: str = "STRUCTURE"
    market_state: str = "NEUTRAL"
    vix_range: str = "NORMAL"
    candle_pattern: str = "NONE"
    occurrences: int = 0
    wins: int = 0
    losses: int = 0
    breakevens: int = 0
    win_rate: Optional[float] = None
    laplace_win_rate: Optional[float] = None
    avg_rr_achieved: Optional[float] = None
    expectancy_rr: Optional[float] = None
    profit_factor: Optional[float] = None
    last_10_outcomes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    last_outcome: Optional[str] = None
    is_quarantined: bool = False
    is_deleted: bool = False
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH"
    first_seen: Optional[str] = None
    last_seen: Optional[str] = None
    updated_at: Optional[str] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert dataclass to clean dictionary omitting None fields."""
        d = asdict(self)
        return {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v is not None}


# â”€â”€ 3. FINANCIAL PAYLOAD SANITIZATION & WAL JOURNAL â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def _sanitize_payload(data: Any) -> Any:
    """
    Recursively sanitize dictionaries/lists.
    Converts NaN, Inf, -Inf floats to None (SQL NULL) to prevent PostgreSQL numeric syntax errors.
    """
    if isinstance(data, float):
        if math.isnan(data) or math.isinf(data):
            return None
        return data
    elif isinstance(data, dict):
        return {k: _sanitize_payload(v) for k, v in data.items()}
    elif isinstance(data, (list, tuple)):
        return [_sanitize_payload(v) for v in data]
    return data


def _safe_int(val: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    """Safely convert any JSON/database value to int, handling lists/dicts/None defensively."""
    try:
        if val is None or isinstance(val, (list, dict, tuple)):
            return default
        return int(val)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return default


def _safe_float(val: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    """Safely convert any JSON/database value to float, handling NaN/Inf defensively."""
    try:
        if val is None or isinstance(val, (list, dict, tuple)):
            return default
        f = float(val)
        return default if math.isnan(f) or math.isinf(f) else f
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return default


def _safe_list(val: Any) -> List[str]:
    """Safely convert any JSON/database value to a list of strings."""
    if isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
        return [str(item) for item in val if item is not None]
    return []


def _append_pattern_journal(event_type: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Durable local WAL journal for pattern updates during network disconnects."""
    try:
        _STORAGE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = {
            "event_type": event_type,
            "payload": payload,
            "timestamp_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        }
        with open(_PATTERNS_JOURNAL_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] Failed to write local journal: {e}")


def replay_pattern_journal() -> int:
    """
    Automated WAL Journal Replay Protocol for Pattern Memory.
    Flushes buffered offline records to Supabase.
    """
    if not _PATTERNS_JOURNAL_FILE.exists() or not is_db_connected():
        return 0

    replayed_count = 0
    remaining_records = []

    with _PATTERN_LOCK:
        try:
            with open(_PATTERNS_JOURNAL_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                lines = f.readlines()

            for line in lines:
                line_str = line.strip()
                if not line_str:
                    continue
                try:
                    entry = json.loads(line_str)
                    event_type = entry.get("event_type")
                    payload = entry.get("payload", {})

                    if event_type == "UPSERT_PATTERN":
                        sb.table("pattern_memory").upsert(payload, on_conflict="setup_hash").execute()
                        replayed_count += 1
                    elif event_type == "UPDATE_PATTERN_OUTCOME":
                        setup_hash = payload.get("setup_hash")
                        if setup_hash:
                            up_payload = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "setup_hash"}
                            sb.table("pattern_memory").update(up_payload).eq("setup_hash", setup_hash).execute()
                            replayed_count += 1
                    else:
                        remaining_records.append(line)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"[db.patterns] Replay item failed, keeping in WAL: {e}")
                    remaining_records.append(line)

            if not remaining_records:
                _PATTERNS_JOURNAL_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                logger.info(f"[db.patterns] Replayed {replayed_count} buffered records from local WAL.")
            else:
                with open(_PATTERNS_JOURNAL_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.writelines(remaining_records)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[db.patterns] Error during pattern WAL replay: {e}")

    return replayed_count


# â”€â”€ 4. IN-MEMORY HOT-PATH CACHE MANAGEMENT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def clear_pattern_cache() -> None:
    """Clear hot-path in-memory pattern cache (used in tests and session reloads)."""
    with _PATTERN_LOCK:
        _PATTERN_CACHE.clear()


def _get_from_cache(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    cache_key = f"{system_mode.upper()}::{setup_hash}"
    with _PATTERN_LOCK:
        if cache_key in _PATTERN_CACHE:
            data, exp = _PATTERN_CACHE[cache_key]
            if time.time() < exp:
                return data
            del _PATTERN_CACHE[cache_key]
    return None


def _put_into_cache(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    cache_key = f"{system_mode.upper()}::{setup_hash}"
    with _PATTERN_LOCK:
        _PATTERN_CACHE[cache_key] = (data, time.time() + _CACHE_TTL_SECONDS)


def _invalidate_cache(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str) -> None:
    cache_key = f"{system_mode.upper()}::{setup_hash}"
    with _PATTERN_LOCK:
        _PATTERN_CACHE.pop(cache_key, None)


# â”€â”€ 5. CORE PATTERN MEMORY OPERATIONS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_pattern(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str = "RESEARCH", use_cache: bool = True) -> Optional[dict]:
    """
    Return pattern memory record for a given setup hash with microsecond caching.
    Called by devil_checks.py check_pattern_memory() on pre-trade execution paths.
    """
    if not setup_hash:
        return None

    clean_hash = setup_hash.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()

    if use_cache:
        cached = _get_from_cache(clean_hash, sys_mode)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

    try:
        def _execute():
            return (
                sb.table("pattern_memory")
                .select("*")
                .eq("setup_hash", clean_hash)
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .eq("is_deleted", False)
                .limit(1)
                .execute()
            )

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        data = result.data or []
        record = data[0] if data else None

        if record and use_cache:
            _put_into_cache(clean_hash, sys_mode, record)

        return record
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] get_pattern failed for {clean_hash}: {e}")
        return None


def upsert_pattern(pattern: Union[dict, PatternMemoryRecord]) -> dict:
    """
    Insert or update a pattern memory record.
    Called when a new trade opens (first seen or update).
    setup_hash is UNIQUE â€” upsert updates existing row.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist, today_ist
    raw_dict = pattern.to_dict() if isinstance(pattern, PatternMemoryRecord) else pattern
    if not isinstance(raw_dict, dict) or not raw_dict:
        return {}

    sanitized = _sanitize_payload(raw_dict)
    setup_hash = str(sanitized.get("setup_hash", "")).strip().upper()
    if not setup_hash:
        logger.error("[db.patterns] upsert_pattern missing mandatory 'setup_hash'.")
        return {}

    system_mode = str(sanitized.get("system_mode", "RESEARCH")).upper()
    today_str = str(today_ist())

    record = {
        **sanitized,
        "setup_hash": setup_hash,
        "system_mode": system_mode,
        "updated_at": now_ist().isoformat(),
    }
    if "first_seen" not in record or not record["first_seen"]:
        record["first_seen"] = today_str
    record["last_seen"] = today_str

    try:
        def _execute():
            return sb.table("pattern_memory").upsert(record, on_conflict="setup_hash").execute()

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        res_data = result.data[0] if result.data else record

        _put_into_cache(setup_hash, system_mode, res_data)
        return res_data
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] upsert_pattern failed for {setup_hash}: {e} -> Buffering to WAL.")
        _append_pattern_journal("UPSERT_PATTERN", record)
        _put_into_cache(setup_hash, system_mode, record)
        return record


def update_pattern_outcome(
    setup_hash: str,
    outcome: str,
    actual_rr: Optional[float] = None,
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH",
) -> bool:
    """
    Thread-safe update of pattern statistics when a trade closes.
    Computes Bayesian Laplace win rate, Mathematical Expectancy, and rolling last_10_outcomes.
    """
    if not setup_hash:
        return False

    from core.time_utils import now_ist, today_ist
    clean_hash = setup_hash.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()
    outcome_clean = str(outcome).upper()

    with _PATTERN_LOCK:
        try:
            existing = get_pattern(clean_hash, system_mode=sys_mode, use_cache=False)
            if not existing:
                # First time seen on trade close: initialize record
                existing = {
                    "setup_hash": clean_hash,
                    "symbol": clean_hash.split("_")[0] if "_" in clean_hash else "UNKNOWN",
                    "strategy_id": clean_hash.split("_")[1] if len(clean_hash.split("_")) > 1 else "UNKNOWN",
                    "occurrences": 0,
                    "wins": 0,
                    "losses": 0,
                    "breakevens": 0,
                    "last_10_outcomes": [],
                    "system_mode": sys_mode,
                    "first_seen": str(today_ist()),
                }

            occurrences = _safe_int(existing.get("occurrences")) + 1
            wins = _safe_int(existing.get("wins"))
            losses = _safe_int(existing.get("losses"))
            breakevens = _safe_int(existing.get("breakevens"))

            if outcome_clean == "WIN":
                wins += 1
            elif outcome_clean == "LOSS":
                losses += 1
            else:
                breakevens += 1

            # Standard Win Rate (%)
            win_rate = round((wins / occurrences) * 100.0, 1) if occurrences > 0 else None

            # Bayesian Laplace-smoothed Win Rate (%)
            laplace_win_rate = round(((wins + 1) / (occurrences + 2)) * 100.0, 1)

            # Rolling and Average R:R Achieved
            old_avg_rr = _safe_float(existing.get("avg_rr_achieved"))
            valid_rr = actual_rr if (actual_rr is not None and not math.isnan(actual_rr)) else 0.0

            if occurrences > 1:
                new_avg_rr = round(((old_avg_rr * (occurrences - 1)) + valid_rr) / occurrences, 4)
            else:
                new_avg_rr = round(valid_rr, 4)

            # Mathematical Expectancy (in R units)
            win_pct = wins / occurrences if occurrences > 0 else 0.0
            loss_pct = losses / occurrences if occurrences > 0 else 0.0
            expectancy_rr = round((win_pct * new_avg_rr) - (loss_pct * 1.0), 4)

            # Profit Factor
            profit_factor = round((wins * max(0.1, new_avg_rr)) / max(1, losses), 2)

            # Rolling last 10 outcomes window
            last_10 = _safe_list(existing.get("last_10_outcomes"))
            last_10.append(outcome_clean)
            if len(last_10) > 10:
                last_10 = last_10[-10:]

            update_payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
                "setup_hash": clean_hash,
                "occurrences": occurrences,
                "wins": wins,
                "losses": losses,
                "breakevens": breakevens,
                "win_rate": win_rate,
                "laplace_win_rate": laplace_win_rate,
                "avg_rr_achieved": new_avg_rr,
                "expectancy_rr": expectancy_rr,
                "profit_factor": profit_factor,
                "last_10_outcomes": last_10,
                "last_seen": str(today_ist()),
                "last_outcome": outcome_clean,
                "system_mode": sys_mode,
                "updated_at": now_ist().isoformat(),
            }
            sanitized = _sanitize_payload(update_payload)

            def _execute():
                return sb.table("pattern_memory").upsert(sanitized, on_conflict="setup_hash").execute()

            result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
            _put_into_cache(clean_hash, sys_mode, sanitized)
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[db.patterns] update_pattern_outcome failed for {clean_hash}: {e} -> Buffering to WAL.")
            _append_pattern_journal("UPDATE_PATTERN_OUTCOME", {"setup_hash": clean_hash, "outcome": outcome_clean})
            return False


# â”€â”€ 6. STATISTICAL & STREAK RISK SENTRIES â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_consecutive_losses(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str = "RESEARCH") -> int:
    """
    Return the current consecutive loss streak from rolling last_10_outcomes.
    Detects toxic regime shifts before historical win rates degrade.
    """
    pattern = get_pattern(setup_hash, system_mode=system_mode)
    if not pattern:
        return 0

    last_10 = _safe_list(pattern.get("last_10_outcomes"))
    streak = 0
    for outcome in reversed(last_10):
        if str(outcome).upper() == "LOSS":
            streak += 1
        else:
            break
    return streak


def get_pattern_failures(
    setup_hash: str,
    lookback_days: int = 90,
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH",
) -> int:
    """
    Return the number of losses for a specific setup hash within lookback_days.
    Called by devil_checks.check_pattern_memory().
    Returns 0 if pattern never seen (first occurrence = safe).
    """
    if not setup_hash:
        return 0
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    clean_hash = setup_hash.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()

    try:
        since = (now_ist() - timedelta(days=lookback_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        def _execute():
            return (
                sb.table("pattern_memory")
                .select("losses, last_seen")
                .eq("setup_hash", clean_hash)
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .eq("is_deleted", False)
                .gte("last_seen", since)
                .limit(1)
                .execute()
            )

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        data = result.data or []
        if not data:
            return 0
        return _safe_int(data[0].get("losses"))
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] get_pattern_failures failed for {clean_hash}: {e}")
        return 0


def get_failing_patterns(
    min_failures: int = 3,
    lookback_days: int = 90,
    system_mode: str = "RESEARCH",
) -> list:
    """
    Return patterns that have failed min_failures or more times within lookback_days.
    Used by devil_checks.py to veto toxic setups.
    """
    from core.time_utils import now_ist
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()
    try:
        since = (now_ist() - timedelta(days=lookback_days)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        def _execute():
            return (
                sb.table("pattern_memory")
                .select("setup_hash, symbol, strategy_id, losses, win_rate, laplace_win_rate, last_10_outcomes, expectancy_rr, is_quarantined")
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .eq("is_deleted", False)
                .gte("last_seen", since)
                .gte("losses", min_failures)
                .execute()
            )

        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        return result.data or []
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] get_failing_patterns failed: {e}")
        return []


# â”€â”€ 7. PATTERN LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def quarantine_pattern(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str = "RESEARCH") -> bool:
    """Explicitly quarantine a pathological setup hash to block execution."""
    if not setup_hash:
        return False
    clean_hash = setup_hash.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()
    _invalidate_cache(clean_hash, sys_mode)

    try:
        def _execute():
            return (
                sb.table("pattern_memory")
                .update({"is_quarantined": True})
                .eq("setup_hash", clean_hash)
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .execute()
            )
        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        return bool(result.data)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] quarantine_pattern failed for {clean_hash}: {e}")
        return False


def reactivate_pattern(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str = "RESEARCH") -> bool:
    """Remove quarantine from a pattern after regime recalibration."""
    if not setup_hash:
        return False
    clean_hash = setup_hash.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()
    _invalidate_cache(clean_hash, sys_mode)

    try:
        def _execute():
            return (
                sb.table("pattern_memory")
                .update({"is_quarantined": False})
                .eq("setup_hash", clean_hash)
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .execute()
            )
        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        return bool(result.data)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] reactivate_pattern failed for {clean_hash}: {e}")
        return False


def soft_delete_pattern(setup_hash: str, system_mode: str = "RESEARCH") -> bool:
    """Soft delete a pattern record."""
    if not setup_hash:
        return False
    clean_hash = setup_hash.strip().upper()
    sys_mode = system_mode.upper()
    _invalidate_cache(clean_hash, sys_mode)

    try:
        def _execute():
            return (
                sb.table("pattern_memory")
                .update({"is_deleted": True})
                .eq("setup_hash", clean_hash)
                .eq("system_mode", sys_mode)
                .execute()
            )
        result = _execute_with_retry(_execute, max_retries=2, initial_delay=0.1)
        return bool(result.data)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[db.patterns] soft_delete_pattern failed for {clean_hash}: {e}")
        return False

# â”€â”€ 2. LIGHTWEIGHT REPOSITORY HEALTH PROBE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def get_repository_health(deep_check: bool = False) -> _Dict[str, _Any]:
    """
    Lightweight, non-throwing repository health and connectivity check.
    Used by Health Monitors, Startup Guards, and Pre-Trade Risk Gates.
    - Default (deep_check=False): Fast sub-millisecond passive connection check.
    - Deep (deep_check=True): Active round-trip network ping via ping_db().
    """
    start_time = _time.perf_counter()
    connected = is_db_connected()
    ping_ok = None

    if deep_check and connected:
        ping_ok = ping_db()

    latency_ms = round((_time.perf_counter() - start_time) * 1000, 2)
    is_healthy = connected and (ping_ok is True if deep_check else True)

    payload: _Dict[str, _Any] = {
        "status": "HEALTHY" if is_healthy else ("DEGRADED" if connected and deep_check and not ping_ok else "DISCONNECTED"),
        "is_connected": connected,
        "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        "submodules_loaded": 6,
        "facade_version": "2.0.0",
        "timestamp_utc": _datetime.now(_timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }
    if deep_check:
        payload["ping_ok"] = ping_ok

    return payload

-- Master Parent Trades Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trades (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    symbol VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    direction VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BUY',
    entry_price NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL,
    decision_price NUMERIC(12, 4),
    slippage_bps NUMERIC(8, 2) DEFAULT 0.0,
    initial_sl NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL,
    current_sl NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL,
    trailing_sl NUMERIC(12, 4),
    sl_stage VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INITIAL',
    target_price NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity_remaining INTEGER,
    strategy_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    signal_id UUID,
    asset_class VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EQUITY',
    uses_partial_exit BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    system_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RESEARCH',
    -- Exit & P&L Attribution
    exit_price NUMERIC(12, 4),
    gross_pnl NUMERIC(14, 4),
    net_pnl NUMERIC(14, 4),
    stt_tax NUMERIC(10, 4),
    exchange_turnover_fee NUMERIC(10, 4),
    brokerage NUMERIC(10, 4),
    exit_reason VARCHAR(64),
    actual_rr NUMERIC(8, 2),
    -- Excursion Analytics
    price_low_since_entry NUMERIC(12, 4),
    price_high_since_entry NUMERIC(12, 4),
    mae_pct NUMERIC(8, 2),
    mfe_pct NUMERIC(8, 2),
    giveback_pct NUMERIC(8, 2),
    -- Research Fields
    market_state VARCHAR(32),
    mqi_level VARCHAR(32),
    vix_at_entry NUMERIC(8, 2),
    sector VARCHAR(64),
    research_valid BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    is_deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    -- Timestamps
    entry_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    exit_time TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_status_mode ON trades(status, system_mode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_symbol_mode ON trades(symbol, system_mode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_created_at ON trades(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_exit_time ON trades(exit_time DESC);

-- Child Tranches Table (3-Tranche Scaling)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade_tranches (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    trade_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tranche_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    target_price NUMERIC(12, 4),
    target_rr NUMERIC(8, 2),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    exit_price NUMERIC(12, 4),
    gross_pnl NUMERIC(14, 4),
    net_pnl NUMERIC(14, 4),
    exit_time TIMESTAMPTZ,
    is_deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tranches_trade_id ON trade_tranches(trade_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tranches_status ON trade_tranches(status);
