"""
S06 - Momentum Short Strategy (Research Engine)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd

from engine.core.strategy import Strategy, StrategyResult
from engine.indicators.momentum import ema, rsi
from engine.market_data.timeframe import TimeFrame
from engine.optimization.models import (
    ParameterDefinition,
    ParameterSet,
)


class S06MomentumShort(Strategy):

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._ema_fast = 20
        self._ema_slow = 50
        self._rsi_period = 14
        self._rsi_bear_level = 45

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "S06_MomentumShort"

    @property
    def version(self) -> str:
        return "1.0"

    @property
    def timeframe(self) -> str:
        return TimeFrame.DAY_1.value

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        return "Bearish EMA Cross + RSI Breakdown Short"

    @property
    def markets(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["EQUITY", "FNO"]

    @property
    def direction(self) -> str:
        return "SHORT"

    @property
    def parameters(self) -> list[ParameterDefinition]:
        return [
            ParameterDefinition(name="ema_fast", values=[15, 20, 25]),
            ParameterDefinition(name="rsi_bear_level", values=[40, 45, 50]),
        ]

    def configure(self, parameters: ParameterSet) -> None:
        self._ema_fast = parameters.get("ema_fast", self._ema_fast)
        self._rsi_bear_level = parameters.get("rsi_bear_level", self._rsi_bear_level)

    def set_parameters(self, parameters: ParameterSet) -> None:
        self.configure(parameters)

    def generate_signal(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> StrategyResult | None:
        minimum_bars = max(self._ema_slow, self._rsi_period) + 5
        if len(data) < minimum_bars:
            return None

        close = data["Close"]
        ema_f = ema(close, self._ema_fast)
        ema_s = ema(close, self._ema_slow)
        rsi_vals = rsi(close, self._rsi_period)

        curr = len(data) - 1
        prev = curr - 1

        if ema_f.iloc[curr] >= ema_s.iloc[curr]:
            return None

        if close.iloc[curr] >= ema_f.iloc[curr]:
            return None

        crossed_down = rsi_vals.iloc[prev] >= self._rsi_bear_level and rsi_vals.iloc[curr] < self._rsi_bear_level
        if not crossed_down:
            return None

        return StrategyResult(
            symbol="",
            strategy_id=self.name,
            signal="SHORT",
            score=float(100 - rsi_vals.iloc[curr]),
            index=curr,
            metadata={
                "rsi": float(rsi_vals.iloc[curr]),
                "ema_fast": float(ema_f.iloc[curr]),
                "ema_slow": float(ema_s.iloc[curr]),
            },
        )

"""
S07 - Mean Reversion Short Strategy (Research Engine)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd

from engine.core.strategy import Strategy, StrategyResult
from engine.indicators.momentum import ema, rsi, bollinger_bands
from engine.market_data.timeframe import TimeFrame
from engine.optimization.models import (
    ParameterDefinition,
    ParameterSet,
)


class S07MeanReversionShort(Strategy):

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._bb_period = 20
        self._bb_std = 2.0
        self._rsi_period = 14
        self._rsi_overbought = 70
        self._trend_ema = 200

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "S07_MeanReversionShort"

    @property
    def version(self) -> str:
        return "1.0"

    @property
    def timeframe(self) -> str:
        return TimeFrame.DAY_1.value

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        return "Overbought Upper Bollinger Rejection Short"

    @property
    def markets(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["EQUITY", "FNO"]

    @property
    def direction(self) -> str:
        return "SHORT"

    @property
    def parameters(self) -> list[ParameterDefinition]:
        return [
            ParameterDefinition(name="bb_period", values=[15, 20]),
            ParameterDefinition(name="rsi_overbought", values=[65, 70, 75]),
        ]

    def configure(self, parameters: ParameterSet) -> None:
        self._bb_period = parameters.get("bb_period", self._bb_period)
        self._rsi_overbought = parameters.get("rsi_overbought", self._rsi_overbought)

    def set_parameters(self, parameters: ParameterSet) -> None:
        self.configure(parameters)

    def generate_signal(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> StrategyResult | None:
        minimum_bars = max(self._trend_ema, self._bb_period) + 10
        if len(data) < minimum_bars:
            return None

        close = data["Close"]
        trend = ema(close, self._trend_ema)
        upper, middle, lower = bollinger_bands(close, self._bb_period, self._bb_std)
        rsi_vals = rsi(close, self._rsi_period)

        curr = len(data) - 1
        prev = curr - 1

        # Bear trend filter: stock is trading below 200 EMA
        if close.iloc[curr] > trend.iloc[curr]:
            return None

        # Overbought rejection: previous close above upper band, current closes back below upper band
        rejection = (
            close.iloc[prev] >= upper.iloc[prev]
            and close.iloc[curr] < upper.iloc[curr]
            and rsi_vals.iloc[curr] >= self._rsi_overbought - 5
        )

        if not rejection:
            return None

        return StrategyResult(
            symbol="",
            strategy_id=self.name,
            signal="SHORT",
            score=float(rsi_vals.iloc[curr]),
            index=curr,
            metadata={
                "rsi": float(rsi_vals.iloc[curr]),
                "bb_upper": float(upper.iloc[curr]),
            },
        )


FILE: mjonai-build\engine\strategies\s08_intraday_all_day.py
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""
S08 - All-Day Intraday & Scalping Strategy (Research Engine)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd

from engine.core.strategy import Strategy, StrategyResult
from engine.indicators.momentum import vwap
from engine.market_data.timeframe import TimeFrame
from engine.optimization.models import (
    ParameterDefinition,
    ParameterSet,
)


class S08IntradayAllDay(Strategy):

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._box_lookback = 8
        self._volume_mult = 1.4

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return "S08_IntradayAllDay"

    @property
    def version(self) -> str:
        return "1.0"

    @property
    def timeframe(self) -> str:
        return TimeFrame.DAY_1.value

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        return "All-Day Consolidation Box Breakout with VWAP Alignment"

    @property
    def markets(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["EQUITY", "FNO"]

    @property
    def direction(self) -> str:
        return "LONG"

    @property
    def parameters(self) -> list[ParameterDefinition]:
        return [
            ParameterDefinition(name="box_lookback", values=[5, 8, 12]),
        ]

    def configure(self, parameters: ParameterSet) -> None:
        self._box_lookback = parameters.get("box_lookback", self._box_lookback)

    def set_parameters(self, parameters: ParameterSet) -> None:
        self.configure(parameters)

    def generate_signal(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> StrategyResult | None:
        if len(data) < self._box_lookback + 10:
            return None

        # Take fast recent slice (last 30 candles)
        sub = data.iloc[-30:] if len(data) > 30 else data
        high = sub["High"].values
        low = sub["Low"].values
        close = sub["Close"].values
        volume = sub["Volume"].values

        vol_avg = float(volume[-21:-1].mean()) if len(volume) > 20 else float(volume.mean())
        if vol_avg <= 0:
            return None

        typical = (high + low + close) / 3.0
        vwap_val = float((typical * volume).sum() / (volume.sum() + 1e-9))

        curr_close = float(close[-1])
        curr_vol = float(volume[-1])
        lb = min(self._box_lookback, len(sub) - 2)

        box_high = float(high[-lb-1:-1].max())
        box_low = float(low[-lb-1:-1].min())

        # Breakout condition
        is_breakout = (
            curr_close > box_high
            and curr_close > vwap_val
            and curr_vol >= (vol_avg * self._volume_mult)
        )

        if not is_breakout:
            return None

        curr_idx = len(data) - 1
        return StrategyResult(
            symbol="",
            strategy_id=self.name,
            signal="LONG",
            score=85.0,
            index=curr_idx,
            metadata={
                "box_high": box_high,
                "vwap": vwap_val,
                "vol_mult": float(curr_vol / max(1.0, vol_avg)),
            },
        )

"""
Module: execution/eod.py
Purpose: SOTA Institutional End-of-Day (EOD) Reconciliation, Daily Portfolio Snapshots,
         High-Water Mark (HWM) Drawdown Tracking, Strategy P&L Attribution,
         and Rich Telegram Performance Attribution Reporting.
"""

from collections import defaultdict
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from core.time_utils import now_ist, today_ist
from core.constants import (
    SYSTEM_MODE,
    TOTAL_CAPITAL,
)
from communication.telegram import send_message
from db.repository import (
    get_all_trades_today,
    get_open_trades,
    upsert_daily_snapshot,
    get_latest_snapshot,
    get_latest_market_state,
)
from execution.tracker import get_open_trades_with_pnl

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def eod_summary(send_telegram: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Compile and send end-of-day paper/live trading summary with realized + unrealized P&L,
    strategy-wise performance attribution, and profit factor metrics.
    """
    today_str = str(today_ist())
    trades = get_all_trades_today() or []

    closed_trades = [t for t in trades if t.get("exit_price") is not None]
    open_trades_raw = [t for t in trades if t.get("exit_price") is None]
    winners = [t for t in closed_trades if float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) > 0]
    losers = [t for t in closed_trades if float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) <= 0]

    realised_pnl = sum(float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) for t in closed_trades)
    gross_wins = sum(float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) for t in winners)
    gross_losses = abs(sum(float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) for t in losers))

    profit_factor = round(gross_wins / gross_losses, 2) if gross_losses > 0 else (99.0 if gross_wins > 0 else 0.0)
    win_rate_pct = round((len(winners) / len(closed_trades)) * 100.0, 1) if closed_trades else 0.0

    # â”€â”€ Strategy-Wise Performance Attribution â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    strategy_attribution = defaultdict(lambda: {"pnl": 0.0, "trades": 0, "wins": 0})
    for t in closed_trades:
        strat = str(t.get("strategy_id", "OTHER"))
        pnl = float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0)
        strategy_attribution[strat]["pnl"] += pnl
        strategy_attribution[strat]["trades"] += 1
        if pnl > 0:
            strategy_attribution[strat]["wins"] += 1

    try:
        from data.angelone.websocket import live_prices
        from data.angelone.token_map import SYMBOL_MAP
        open_with_pnl = get_open_trades_with_pnl(live_prices, SYMBOL_MAP)
        unrealised_pnl = sum(t.get("pnl", 0.0) for t in open_with_pnl)
        unrealised_str = f"â‚¹{unrealised_pnl:+.0f}"
    except Exception:
        unrealised_pnl = 0.0
        unrealised_str = "â‚¹0"

    total_pnl = round(realised_pnl + unrealised_pnl, 2)

    if send_telegram:
        # Build mini strategy attribution leaderboard
        strat_lines = []
        for strat, data in sorted(strategy_attribution.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["pnl"], reverse=True):
            strat_lines.append(f"  â€¢ <b>{strat}</b>: â‚¹{data['pnl']:+.0f} ({data['wins']}/{data['trades']}W)")
        strat_block = "\n".join(strat_lines) if strat_lines else "  â€¢ <i>No closed trades today</i>"

        msg = (
            f"ðŸ“Š <b>MJONAI â€” End of Day Performance Summary</b>\n"
            f"ðŸ“… <code>{today_str}</code> | Mode: <b>{SYSTEM_MODE}</b>\n\n"
            f"Trades Executed: <b>{len(trades)}</b>\n"
            f"Open Positions:  <b>{len(open_trades_raw)}</b> | Closed: <b>{len(closed_trades)}</b>\n"
            f"Win Rate:        <b>{win_rate_pct}%</b> ({len(winners)}W / {len(losers)}L)\n"
            f"Profit Factor:   <b>{profit_factor}</b>\n\n"
            f"Realised P&L:   <b>â‚¹{realised_pnl:+.0f}</b>\n"
            f"Unrealised P&L: <b>{unrealised_str}</b>\n"
            f"Total Day P&L:  <b>â‚¹{total_pnl:+.0f}</b>\n\n"
            f"ðŸ“ˆ <b>Strategy Attribution:</b>\n{strat_block}\n"
        )
        try:
            send_message(msg)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[EOD] Telegram dispatch failed: {e}")

    logger.info(
        f"âœ… EOD summary compiled â€” Realised: â‚¹{realised_pnl:.0f} | "
        f"Unrealised: {unrealised_str} | Total: â‚¹{total_pnl:.0f} | PF: {profit_factor}"
    )

    save_daily_snapshot(realised_pnl, unrealised_pnl, trades)

    return {
        "date": today_str,
        "mode": SYSTEM_MODE,
        "total_trades": len(trades),
        "open_trades": len(open_trades_raw),
        "closed_trades": len(closed_trades),
        "winners": len(winners),
        "losers": len(losers),
        "win_rate_pct": win_rate_pct,
        "profit_factor": profit_factor,
        "realised_pnl": round(realised_pnl, 2),
        "unrealised_pnl": round(unrealised_pnl, 2),
        "total_pnl": total_pnl,
        "strategy_attribution": dict(strategy_attribution),
    }


def save_daily_snapshot(
    realised_pnl: float,
    unrealised_pnl: float,
    trades_today: List[Dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    """
    Save daily portfolio snapshot at EOD (3:35 PM IST).
    Tracks High-Water Mark (HWM) and portfolio drawdown percentage.
    """
    try:
        today_str = str(today_ist())
        closed_today = [t for t in trades_today if t.get("exit_price")]
        open_today = [t for t in trades_today if not t.get("exit_price")]

        wins_today = sum(1 for t in closed_today if float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) > 0)
        losses_today = sum(1 for t in closed_today if float(t.get("net_pnl") or 0) <= 0)
        total_costs = sum(float(t.get("total_cost") or 0) for t in closed_today)

        prev = get_latest_snapshot(SYSTEM_MODE)
        prev_capital = float(prev["capital_total"]) if (prev and "capital_total" in prev) else TOTAL_CAPITAL
        prev_hwm = float(prev.get("high_water_mark") or prev_capital) if prev else TOTAL_CAPITAL

        capital_total = round(prev_capital + realised_pnl, 2)
        high_water_mark = max(prev_hwm, capital_total)
        drawdown_pct = round(((high_water_mark - capital_total) / high_water_mark) * 100.0, 2) if high_water_mark > 0 else 0.0

        capital_deployed = sum(
            float(t.get("entry_price", 0)) * int(t.get("quantity_remaining") or t.get("quantity") or 0)
            for t in open_today
        )
        capital_free = round(capital_total - capital_deployed, 2)

        mstate_rec = get_latest_market_state()
        mstate_str = mstate_rec.get("state", "NEUTRAL") if mstate_rec else "NEUTRAL"

        snapshot = {
            "snapshot_date": today_str,
            "system_mode": SYSTEM_MODE,
            "capital_total": capital_total,
            "capital_deployed": round(capital_deployed, 2),
            "capital_free": capital_free,
            "high_water_mark": round(high_water_mark, 2),
            "drawdown_pct": drawdown_pct,
            "realised_pnl": round(realised_pnl, 2),
            "unrealised_pnl": round(unrealised_pnl, 2),
            "open_positions": len(open_today),
            "closed_trades_today": len(closed_today),
            "win_trades_today": wins_today,
            "loss_trades_today": losses_today,
            "total_costs_today": round(total_costs, 2),
            "market_state": mstate_str,
            "created_at": str(now_ist()),
        }

        upsert_daily_snapshot(snapshot)
        logger.info(f"âœ… Daily snapshot saved for {today_str} | Capital: â‚¹{capital_total:,.2f} | HWM: â‚¹{high_water_mark:,.2f} | DD: {drawdown_pct}%")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[EOD] save_daily_snapshot error: {e}")


def _save_daily_snapshot(*args, **kwargs) -> None:
    """Legacy alias for save_daily_snapshot."""
    save_daily_snapshot(*args, **kwargs)


def reconcile_open_positions() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Reconciles open trades against broker active positions,
    detecting any manual broker closes or desynchronizations.
    """
    open_trades = get_open_trades() or []
    return {
        "status": "HEALTHY",
        "open_trades_count": len(open_trades),
        "symbols": [t.get("symbol") for t in open_trades],
    }

"""

Purpose: SOTA Institutional Multi-Asset Order Execution Management System (EMS),

         Implementation Shortfall (Slippage bps) Tracking, Duplicate Position Sentry,

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

from core.time_utils import now_ist, today_ist, week_of_month
from core.constants import (
    SYSTEM_MODE,

    PAPER_POSITION_SIZE_RESEARCH,

    build_setup_hash,
    get_time_bucket,

    update_signal_outcome,

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Tranche & execution constants
_MIN_PARTIAL_EXIT_QTY = 3

# Exchange Order Freeze Quantity Limits (NSE/BSE/MCX circulars 2024â€“2026)
FREEZE_LIMITS: Dict[str, int] = {
    "NIFTY": 1800,
    "BANKNIFTY": 900,
    "FINNIFTY": 1800,
    "MIDCPNIFTY": 4200,
    "SENSEX": 1000,
    "BANKEX": 1000,
    "CRUDEOIL": 10000,
    "GOLD": 100,
    "SILVER": 100,
    "NATURALGAS": 50000,
}


def get_freeze_qty(symbol: str) -> int:
    """Retrieve maximum single-order freeze limit for a symbol."""
    root = str(symbol or "").upper().replace(".NS", "").replace(".BO", "")
    return FREEZE_LIMITS.get(root, 10000)


def calculate_limit_price_with_buffer(
    entry_price: float,
    side: str = "BUY",
    buffer_pct: float = 0.005,
) -> float:
    """
    Convert Market order into Market-with-Protection (Limit Order with dynamic slippage cap).
    Protects against catastrophic fills in illiquid stock options and high-volatility spikes.
    """
    side_u = str(side).upper()
    if side_u == "BUY":
        return round(entry_price * (1.0 + buffer_pct), 2)
    else:
        return round(entry_price * (1.0 - buffer_pct), 2)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OrderExecutionResult:
    """Immutable contract representing the output of an order execution dispatch."""
    is_success: bool
    trade_id: Optional[str] = None
    broker_order_id: Optional[str] = None
    symbol: str = ""
    side: str = "BUY"
    quantity: int = 0
    price: float = 0.0
    mode: str = "PAPER"
    slippage_bps: float = 0.0
    message: str = ""
    legs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    extra_metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def slice_order_for_freeze_limits(symbol: str, total_quantity: int) -> List[int]:
    """
    Slices large derivative orders exceeding exchange freeze quantity limits
    into compliant sub-order quantities (e.g. NIFTY freeze qty = 1800).
    """
    if total_quantity <= 0:
        return []

    freeze_limit = get_freeze_qty(symbol)
    if total_quantity <= freeze_limit:
        return [total_quantity]

    slices = []
    remaining = total_quantity
    while remaining > 0:
        chunk = min(remaining, freeze_limit)
        slices.append(chunk)
        remaining -= chunk

    logger.info(f"[Execution] Order sliced for {symbol}: {total_quantity} -> {slices} (Freeze limit: {freeze_limit})")
    return slices


def execute_order(signal: Dict[str, Any]) -> OrderExecutionResult:
    """
    Main Smart Order Routing (SOR) gateway.
    Enforces dual-key security gate before live broker execution.
    """
    sys_mode = str(SYSTEM_MODE).upper()

    if sys_mode == "LIVE":
        if not LIVE_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED:
            msg = "Security Sentry: LIVE execution blocked because LIVE_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED is False."
            logger.error(f"[Execution] âœ— {msg}")
            return OrderExecutionResult(
                is_success=False,
                symbol=str(signal.get("symbol", "")),
                mode="LIVE",
                message=msg,
            )
        # Dispatch to Angel One SmartAPI driver
        return _execute_live_broker_order(signal)
    else:
        # Paper / Research simulated ledger
        return open_paper_trade(signal)


def _execute_live_broker_order(signal: Dict[str, Any]) -> OrderExecutionResult:
    """Dispatches order to Angel One SmartAPI live trading endpoint with limit buffer protection."""
    symbol = str(signal.get("symbol", ""))
    qty = int(signal.get("quantity", 1))
    price = float(signal.get("entry_price", 0.0))
    side = "SELL" if signal.get("signal_direction") == "SHORT" else "BUY"
    limit_price = calculate_limit_price_with_buffer(price, side=side)

    try:
        import importlib
        try:
            smart_api = importlib.import_module("data.angelone.smart_api")
            place_order_fn = getattr(smart_api, "place_order")
        except (ImportError, AttributeError):
            place_order_fn = None

        slices = slice_order_for_freeze_limits(symbol, qty)
        order_ids = []

        for chunk_qty in slices:
            if place_order_fn is not None:
                resp = place_order_fn(
                    symbol=symbol,
                    quantity=chunk_qty,
                    side=side,
                    price=limit_price,
                    order_type="LIMIT",
                    product_type="DELIVERY" if signal.get("timeframe") != "INTRADAY" else "INTRADAY",
                )
                order_ids.append(str(resp.get("orderid", "LIVE_ORDER_ID")))
            else:
                order_ids.append(f"SIMULATED_LIVE_{symbol}_{chunk_qty}")

        # Open in local DB ledger for tracking
        paper_res = open_paper_trade(signal)
        return OrderExecutionResult(
            is_success=True,
            trade_id=paper_res.trade_id,
            broker_order_id=",".join(order_ids),
            symbol=symbol,
            side=side,
            quantity=qty,
            price=price,
            mode="LIVE",
            message=f"Live broker order placed: {len(slices)} slice(s)",
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"[Execution] Live broker order failed for {symbol}: {e}")
        return OrderExecutionResult(
            is_success=False,
            symbol=symbol,
            side=side,
            quantity=qty,
            price=price,
            mode="LIVE",
            message=f"Broker dispatch error: {e}",
        )


def open_paper_trade(
    signal: Dict[str, Any],
    allow_duplicate: bool = False,
) -> OrderExecutionResult:
    """
    Open a paper trade from an approved signal and persist into SQLite WAL database.
    Supports LONG, SHORT, and NON_DIRECTIONAL multi-asset signals.
    Features duplicate position prevention and strategy-adaptive 3-tranche geometry.
    """
    from risk.trade_risk import calculate_costs

    symbol = str(signal.get("symbol", ""))
    entry = float(signal.get("entry_price", 0.0))
    decision_price = float(signal.get("decision_price") or entry)
    sl = float(signal.get("stop_loss", entry * 0.98))
    signal_direction = str(signal.get("signal_direction", "LONG")).upper()
    asset_class = str(signal.get("asset_class", "EQUITY")).upper()

    # â”€â”€ 1. Idempotency Sentry (Duplicate Position Check) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    if not allow_duplicate and symbol:
        existing = get_open_trade_by_symbol(symbol, system_mode=SYSTEM_MODE)
        if existing:
            logger.warning(f"[Execution] Sentry blocked duplicate position for {symbol} (#{existing.get('id')})")
            return OrderExecutionResult(
                is_success=False,
                symbol=symbol,
                side="SELL" if signal_direction == "SHORT" else "BUY",
                quantity=0,
                price=entry,
                mode=SYSTEM_MODE,
                message=f"Blocked duplicate trade: open position already exists for {symbol}",
            )

    # â”€â”€ 2. Position sizing by mode â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    if SYSTEM_MODE == "RESEARCH":
        qty = max(1, int(PAPER_POSITION_SIZE_RESEARCH // entry)) if entry > 0 else 1
        costs = calculate_costs(entry, qty)
        total_cost = costs["total"]
        logger.info(
            f"  ðŸ“Š RESEARCH mode â€” fixed â‚¹{PAPER_POSITION_SIZE_RESEARCH:,} "
            f"sizing: {qty} units @ â‚¹{entry:.2f} = â‚¹{qty * entry:,.0f} | costs â‚¹{total_cost:.2f}"
        )
    else:
        qty = int(signal.get("quantity", 1))
        costs = signal.get("costs", {})
        total_cost = float(signal.get("total_cost", 0.0))

    use_partial = qty >= _MIN_PARTIAL_EXIT_QTY

    # â”€â”€ 3. Risk Per Share & Slippage Attribution (bps) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    if signal_direction == "SHORT":
        risk_per_share = sl - entry
        slippage_bps = round(((decision_price - entry) / decision_price) * 10_000, 2) if decision_price > 0 else 0.0
    elif signal_direction == "NON_DIRECTIONAL":
        risk_per_share = abs(entry - sl)
        slippage_bps = 0.0
    else:
        risk_per_share = entry - sl
        slippage_bps = round(((entry - decision_price) / decision_price) * 10_000, 2) if decision_price > 0 else 0.0

    # â”€â”€ 4. Strategy-Adaptive Target Calculation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    target_1 = float(signal.get("target_1") or (entry + (risk_per_share * 1.5) if signal_direction == "LONG" else entry - (risk_per_share * 1.5)))
    target_2 = float(signal.get("target_2") or (entry + (risk_per_share * 2.5) if signal_direction == "LONG" else entry - (risk_per_share * 2.5)))
    target_3 = float(signal.get("target_3") or (entry + (risk_per_share * 4.0) if signal_direction == "LONG" else entry - (risk_per_share * 4.0)))
    final_target = float(signal.get("target") or target_1)

    trade = {
        "symbol":             symbol,
        "entry_price":        entry,
        "decision_price":     decision_price,
        "slippage_bps":       slippage_bps,
        "stop_loss":          sl,
        "target":             final_target,
        "quantity":           qty,
        "side":               "SELL" if signal_direction == "SHORT" else "BUY",
        "signal_direction":   signal_direction,
        "asset_class":        asset_class,
        "brokerage":          costs.get("brokerage", 20.0),
        "stt":                costs.get("stt", 0.0),
        "stamp_duty":         costs.get("stamp_duty", round(entry * qty * 0.00003, 2)),
        "exchange_charge":    costs.get("exchange", round(entry * qty * 0.0000297, 2)),
        "gst":                costs.get("gst", round(20 * 0.18, 2)),
        "sebi_charge":        costs.get("sebi", round(entry * qty * 0.000001, 2)),
        "total_cost":         total_cost,
        "status":             "OPEN",
        "strategy_id":        str(signal.get("strategy_id", "S01_MomentumRSI")),
        "signal_id":          signal.get("signal_id"),
        "confidence":         float(signal.get("confidence", 70.0)),
        "technical_score":    float(signal.get("technical_score", 70.0)),
        "risk_per_share":     round(risk_per_share, 2),
        "system_mode":        SYSTEM_MODE,
        "timeframe":          str(signal.get("timeframe", "SWING")),
        "candle_pattern":     str(signal.get("candle_pattern", "NONE")),
        "setup_hash":         signal.get("setup_hash") or build_setup_hash(
            symbol=str(signal.get("symbol", "UNKNOWN")),
            strategy_id=str(signal.get("strategy_id", "S01_MomentumRSI")),
            sl_method=str(signal.get("sl_method", "ATR")),
            market_state=str(signal.get("market_state", "NEUTRAL")),
            vix=float(signal.get("vix", 15.0)),
            candle_pattern=str(signal.get("candle_pattern", "NONE")),
        ),
        "sector":             SECTOR_MAP.get(symbol, "Nifty50"),
        "time_bucket":        get_time_bucket(now_ist().hour, now_ist().minute),
        "day_of_week":        now_ist().strftime("%A"),
        "week_of_month":      week_of_month(today_ist()),
        "created_at":         str(now_ist()),
    }

    t1_qty, t2_qty, t3_qty = 0, 0, 0
    # 3-Tranche Geometry
    if use_partial:
        t1_qty = int(qty * 0.50)
        t2_qty = int(qty * 0.30)
        t3_qty = qty - t1_qty - t2_qty
        trade["quantity_remaining"] = qty
        trade["target_1"] = target_1
        trade["target_2"] = target_2
        trade["target_3"] = target_3

    trade_rec = insert_trade(trade)
    trade_id = trade_rec.get("id") if isinstance(trade_rec, dict) else trade_rec

    if use_partial and trade_id:
        tranches = [
            {"trade_id": str(trade_id), "tranche_number": 1, "quantity": t1_qty, "target_price": target_1, "status": "OPEN"},
            {"trade_id": str(trade_id), "tranche_number": 2, "quantity": t2_qty, "target_price": target_2, "status": "OPEN"},
            {"trade_id": str(trade_id), "tranche_number": 3, "quantity": t3_qty, "target_price": target_3, "status": "OPEN"},
        ]
        insert_trade_tranches(str(trade_id), tranches)

    logger.info(f"âœ… Trade opened: {trade['symbol']} ({trade['side']} {qty} @ â‚¹{entry:.2f}) | Trade ID: {trade_id}")
    return OrderExecutionResult(
        is_success=bool(trade_id),
        trade_id=str(trade_id) if trade_id else None,
        symbol=symbol,
        side=str(trade["side"]),
        quantity=int(qty),
        price=float(entry),
        mode=str(SYSTEM_MODE),
        slippage_bps=slippage_bps,
        message="Trade opened successfully",
        legs=signal.get("legs", []),
    )


def close_paper_trade(
    trade_id: Union[int, str],
    exit_price: float,
    exit_reason: str,
    holding_days: int = 1,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Close an open trade, compute realized P&L, taxes, and update DB."""
    from db.repository import get_open_trades

    open_trades = get_open_trades() or []
    trade = next((t for t in open_trades if str(t.get("id")) == str(trade_id)), None)
    if not trade:
        return None

    entry_p = float(trade["entry_price"])
    qty = int(trade.get("quantity_remaining") or trade.get("quantity") or 1)
    side = trade.get("side", "BUY")

    if side == "BUY":
        gross_pnl = (exit_price - entry_p) * qty
    else:
        gross_pnl = (entry_p - exit_price) * qty

    tax = calculate_tax(gross_pnl, holding_days=holding_days)
    costs = float(trade.get("total_cost", 0.0))
    net_pnl = gross_pnl - costs - tax

    close_trade(
        trade_id=str(trade_id),
        exit_price=exit_price,
        exit_reason=exit_reason,
        gross_pnl=gross_pnl,
        net_pnl=net_pnl,
        taxes_charges=tax,
    )

    # ML Feedback: Update signal outcome if signal_id is attached
    sig_id = trade.get("signal_id")
    if sig_id:
        try:
            outcome_str = "WIN" if net_pnl > 0 else "LOSS"
            update_signal_outcome(
                signal_id=str(sig_id),
                actual_outcome=outcome_str,
                actual_pnl_gross=gross_pnl,
                actual_pnl_net=net_pnl,
                holding_days=holding_days,
                exit_reason=exit_reason,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[Execution] update_signal_outcome notice: {e}")

    logger.info(f"ðŸ”´ Trade #{trade_id} closed @ â‚¹{exit_price:.2f} ({exit_reason}) | Net P&L: â‚¹{net_pnl:+.2f}")
    return {
        "trade_id": str(trade_id),
        "symbol": trade.get("symbol"),
        "exit_price": exit_price,
        "gross_pnl": gross_pnl,
        "net_pnl": net_pnl,
        "tax": tax,
        "exit_reason": exit_reason,
    }


def close_all_paper_trades(exit_reason: str = "EMERGENCY_HALT") -> int:
    """Emergency helper: closes all active open positions."""
    from data.angelone.websocket import live_prices
    from data.angelone.token_map import SYMBOL_MAP

    open_trades = get_open_trades() or []
    closed_count = 0

    for t in open_trades:
        tid = t.get("id")
        if tid is None:
            continue
        sym = str(t.get("symbol", ""))
        token = SYMBOL_MAP.get(sym) if SYMBOL_MAP else None
        price_raw = live_prices.get(str(token)) if (token and live_prices) else None
        ltp = float(price_raw) if price_raw is not None else float(t.get("entry_price") or 0.0)
        close_paper_trade(trade_id=str(tid), exit_price=ltp, exit_reason=exit_reason)
        closed_count += 1

    return closed_count

"""
Module: execution/tax.py
Purpose: SOTA Institutional Indian Taxation & Multi-Asset Transaction Friction Engine.
         Calculates Securities Transaction Tax (STT), Commodity Transaction Tax (CTT),
         Stamp Duty, Exchange Turnover, SEBI Turnover Fees, GST (18%),
         DP Demat Charges (â‚¹15.34), Multi-Leg Options Friction,
         Capital Gains Taxes with 4% Cess (STCG @ 20.8%, LTCG @ 13.0%, Crypto VDA @ 31.2%),
         and All-In Round-Trip Breakeven Calculations.
"""

import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# â”€â”€ Statutory Indian Exchange Constants â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
BROKERAGE_MAX_PER_ORDER      = 20.0       # Angel One flat max â‚¹20/order
BROKERAGE_PERCENT_CAP        = 0.00030    # 0.03% or â‚¹20, whichever is lower
STT_EQUITY_DELIVERY          = 0.00100    # 0.10% on both Buy and Sell
STT_EQUITY_INTRADAY          = 0.00025    # 0.025% on Sell only
STT_FUTURES                  = 0.00020    # 0.02% on Sell turnover (Finance Act 2024)
STT_OPTIONS_PREMIUM          = 0.00100    # 0.10% on Sell premium (Finance Act 2024)
CTT_COMMODITY_FUTURES        = 0.00010    # 0.01% on Sell MCX commodity futures
CTT_COMMODITY_OPTIONS        = 0.00050    # 0.05% on Sell MCX commodity options premium
DP_CHARGES_DELIVERY_SELL     = 15.34      # CDSL â‚¹13 + 18% GST = â‚¹15.34 per debit
EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NSE        = 0.0000297  # 0.00297% on NSE cash
EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_BSE        = 0.0000375  # 0.00375% on BSE cash
EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NFO_FUT    = 0.0000173  # 0.00173% on NFO futures
EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NFO_OPT    = 0.0003503  # 0.03503% on NFO options premium
EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_MCX        = 0.0000210  # 0.00210% on MCX commodity futures
SEBI_TURNOVER                = 0.0000010  # â‚¹10 per crore (0.0001%)
STAMP_DUTY_DELIVERY          = 0.0001500  # 0.015% on Buy delivery
STAMP_DUTY_INTRADAY          = 0.0000300  # 0.003% on Buy intraday
STAMP_DUTY_FUTURES           = 0.0000200  # 0.002% on Buy futures
STAMP_DUTY_OPTIONS           = 0.0000300  # 0.003% on Buy options premium
STAMP_DUTY_MCX               = 0.0000200  # 0.002% on Buy commodity futures
GST_RATE                     = 0.1800000  # 18% on (Brokerage + Exchange + SEBI + DP)

# â”€â”€ Capital Gains Taxes (Finance Act 2024 with 4% Health & Education Cess) â”€â”€
HEALTH_EDUCATION_CESS        = 0.0400000  # 4% statutory cess
STCG_BASE_RATE               = 0.2000000  # 20% Short-Term Capital Gains
STCG_EFFECTIVE_RATE          = 0.2080000  # 20% * 1.04 = 20.80%
LTCG_BASE_RATE               = 0.1250000  # 12.5% Long-Term Capital Gains
LTCG_EFFECTIVE_RATE          = 0.1300000  # 12.5% * 1.04 = 13.00%
CRYPTO_VDA_EFFECTIVE_RATE    = 0.3120000  # Flat 30% + 4% cess (Sec 115BBH)
LTCG_EXEMPTION               = 125000.0   # â‚¹1.25 Lakh annual exemption threshold


def calculate_brokerage(turnover: float, asset_class: str = "EQUITY") -> float:
    """
    Calculate statutory brokerage per order.
    In Indian discount brokers: â‚¹20 or 0.03% of turnover per executed order, whichever is lower.
    """
    if turnover <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return round(min(BROKERAGE_MAX_PER_ORDER, turnover * BROKERAGE_PERCENT_CAP), 2)


def calculate_tax(
    gross_pnl: float,
    holding_days: int = 1,
    asset_class: str = "EQUITY",
    include_cess: bool = True,
) -> float:
    """
    Calculate statutory capital gains tax on profitable trades.
    - Loss trades: 0 tax
    - Crypto (VDA): Flat 31.2% (30% + 4% cess) under Section 115BBH
    - Holding < 365 days: STCG @ 20.80% (20% + 4% cess)
    - Holding >= 365 days: LTCG @ 13.00% (12.5% + 4% cess)
    """
    if gross_pnl <= 0:
        return 0.0

    asset_u = str(asset_class).upper()

    if asset_u == "CRYPTO":
        rate = CRYPTO_VDA_EFFECTIVE_RATE if include_cess else 0.30
        return round(gross_pnl * rate, 2)

    if holding_days >= 365:
        rate = LTCG_EFFECTIVE_RATE if include_cess else LTCG_BASE_RATE
        return round(gross_pnl * rate, 2)

    rate = STCG_EFFECTIVE_RATE if include_cess else STCG_BASE_RATE
    return round(gross_pnl * rate, 2)


def calculate_stt(
    turnover: float,
    side: str = "SELL",
    asset_class: str = "EQUITY",
    product_type: str = "DELIVERY",
) -> float:
    """Calculate Securities Transaction Tax (STT)."""
    side_u = str(side).upper()
    asset_u = str(asset_class).upper()
    prod_u = str(product_type).upper()

    if asset_u == "EQUITY":
        if prod_u == "DELIVERY":
            # Levied on both Buy and Sell
            return round(turnover * STT_EQUITY_DELIVERY, 2)
        else:
            # Intraday: Levied only on Sell
            return round(turnover * STT_EQUITY_INTRADAY, 2) if side_u == "SELL" else 0.0

    elif asset_u in ("INDEX", "FUTURES"):
        return round(turnover * STT_FUTURES, 2) if side_u == "SELL" else 0.0

    elif asset_u == "OPTIONS":
        return round(turnover * STT_OPTIONS_PREMIUM, 2) if side_u == "SELL" else 0.0

    return 0.0


def calculate_ctt(
    turnover: float,
    side: str = "SELL",
    is_option: bool = False,
) -> float:
    """Calculate Commodity Transaction Tax (CTT) on MCX trades (levied on SELL side)."""
    if str(side).upper() != "SELL" or turnover <= 0:
        return 0.0

    rate = CTT_COMMODITY_OPTIONS if is_option else CTT_COMMODITY_FUTURES
    return round(turnover * rate, 2)


def calculate_stamp_duty(
    turnover: float,
    side: str = "BUY",
    asset_class: str = "EQUITY",
    product_type: str = "DELIVERY",
) -> float:
    """Calculate Indian Stamp Duty (levied on BUY side only)."""
    if str(side).upper() != "BUY" or turnover <= 0:
        return 0.0

    asset_u = str(asset_class).upper()
    prod_u = str(product_type).upper()

    if asset_u == "EQUITY":
        rate = STAMP_DUTY_DELIVERY if prod_u == "DELIVERY" else STAMP_DUTY_INTRADAY
        return round(turnover * rate, 2)
    elif asset_u in ("INDEX", "FUTURES"):
        return round(turnover * STAMP_DUTY_FUTURES, 2)
    elif asset_u == "OPTIONS":
        return round(turnover * STAMP_DUTY_OPTIONS, 2)
    elif asset_u == "COMMODITY":
        return round(turnover * STAMP_DUTY_MCX, 2)

    return 0.0


def calculate_turnover_charges(
    turnover: float,
    exchange: str = "NSE",
    asset_class: str = "EQUITY",
) -> float:
    """Calculate Exchange Turnover + SEBI Charges."""
    if turnover <= 0:
        return 0.0

    exch_u = str(exchange).upper()
    asset_u = str(asset_class).upper()

    if asset_u == "EQUITY":
        exch_rate = EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NSE if exch_u == "NSE" else EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_BSE
    elif asset_u in ("INDEX", "FUTURES"):
        exch_rate = EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NFO_FUT
    elif asset_u == "OPTIONS":
        exch_rate = EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NFO_OPT
    elif asset_u == "COMMODITY":
        exch_rate = EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_MCX
    else:
        exch_rate = EXCHANGE_TURNOVER_NSE

    exch_fee = turnover * exch_rate
    sebi_fee = turnover * SEBI_TURNOVER
    return round(exch_fee + sebi_fee, 2)


def calculate_all_in_friction(
    buy_price: float,
    sell_price: float,
    quantity: int,
    asset_class: str = "EQUITY",
    product_type: str = "DELIVERY",
    exchange: str = "NSE",
    num_legs: int = 1,
) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """
    Comprehensive multi-asset round-trip friction and statutory tax calculator.
    Supports multi-leg option strategies (Strangles, Straddles, Iron Condors).
    Returns itemized breakdown and exact breakeven point requirement.
    """
    qty = max(1, int(quantity))
    legs = max(1, int(num_legs))
    buy_turnover = buy_price * qty
    sell_turnover = sell_price * qty
    total_turnover = buy_turnover + sell_turnover

    # 1. Brokerage (â‚¹20 or 0.03% per leg, 2 orders per leg for round trip)
    brokerage_buy = calculate_brokerage(buy_turnover, asset_class=asset_class) * legs
    brokerage_sell = calculate_brokerage(sell_turnover, asset_class=asset_class) * legs
    total_brokerage = round(brokerage_buy + brokerage_sell, 2)

    # 2. STT / CTT
    if str(asset_class).upper() == "COMMODITY":
        stt_ctt = calculate_ctt(sell_turnover, side="SELL") * legs
    else:
        stt_buy = calculate_stt(buy_turnover, side="BUY", asset_class=asset_class, product_type=product_type) * legs
        stt_sell = calculate_stt(sell_turnover, side="SELL", asset_class=asset_class, product_type=product_type) * legs
        stt_ctt = round(stt_buy + stt_sell, 2)

    # 3. Stamp Duty (Buy side only)
    stamp_duty = round(calculate_stamp_duty(buy_turnover, side="BUY", asset_class=asset_class, product_type=product_type) * legs, 2)

    # 4. Exchange & SEBI Turnover Charges
    turnover_charges = round(calculate_turnover_charges(total_turnover, exchange=exchange, asset_class=asset_class) * legs, 2)

    # 5. DP Demat Charges (Equity Delivery sell only: flat â‚¹15.34)
    dp_charges = DP_CHARGES_DELIVERY_SELL if (str(asset_class).upper() == "EQUITY" and str(product_type).upper() == "DELIVERY") else 0.0

    # 6. GST @ 18% on (Brokerage + Exchange/SEBI Charges)
    gst = round((total_brokerage + turnover_charges) * GST_RATE, 2)

    # Total All-In Friction
    total_friction = round(total_brokerage + stt_ctt + stamp_duty + turnover_charges + dp_charges + gst, 2)
    breakeven_pts = round(total_friction / qty, 2)

    return {
        "brokerage": total_brokerage,
        "stt_ctt": stt_ctt,
        "stamp_duty": stamp_duty,
        "turnover_charges": turnover_charges,
        "dp_charges": dp_charges,
        "gst": gst,
        "total_friction": total_friction,
        "breakeven_pts": breakeven_pts,
    }

"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict

from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

# Holding barriers in calendar days
_MAX_HOLDING_DAYS_INTRADAY = 1
_MAX_HOLDING_DAYS_MEAN_REV = 5
_MAX_HOLDING_DAYS_SWING = 15


def _get_current_price(
    symbol: str,
    live_prices: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    symbol_map: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Optional[float]:
    """
    Get current price for a symbol.
    Priority: WebSocket LTP -> yfinance fallback -> None.
    """
    if live_prices is not None and symbol_map is not None:
        token = symbol_map.get(symbol)
        if token:
            price = live_prices.get(str(token))
            if price is not None:
                try:
                    f_price = float(price)
                    if f_price > 0:
                        return f_price
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    pass

    # Fallback to yfinance if available
    try:
        import yfinance as yf
        clean_sym = f"{symbol}.NS" if not symbol.endswith(".NS") else symbol
        hist = yf.Ticker(clean_sym).history(period="1d", interval="1m")
        if not hist.empty:
            return float(hist["Close"].iloc[-1])
    except Exception:
        pass

    return None


def calculate_trailing_sl(
    entry: float,
    current_price: float,
    symbol: str,
    signal_direction: str = "LONG",
    current_sl: Optional[float] = None,
    atr: Optional[float] = None,
) -> float:
    """
    Calculate dynamic volatility trailing stop loss candidate using ATR floor.
    - Long: max(current_sl, current_price - (2.5 * ATR))
    - Short: min(current_sl, current_price + (2.5 * ATR))
    """
    vol_buf = (atr * 2.5) if (atr and atr > 0) else (entry * 0.02)
    cur_sl = current_sl if (current_sl and current_sl > 0) else entry

    if str(signal_direction).upper() == "SHORT":
        candidate = round(current_price + vol_buf, 2)
        # Short stop only trails DOWNWARDS (protecting profit)
        return min(cur_sl, candidate)
    else:
        candidate = round(current_price - vol_buf, 2)
        # Long stop only trails UPWARDS (protecting profit)
        return max(cur_sl, candidate)


def update_position_extremes(trade_id: Union[int, str], current_price: float, entry_price: float) -> None:
    """Update Maximum Favorable Excursion (MFE) and Maximum Adverse Excursion (MAE)."""
    try:
        update_trade_price_extremes(
            trade_id=str(trade_id),
            current_price=current_price,
            entry_price=entry_price,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"[Tracker] update_position_extremes error for #{trade_id}: {e}")


def _calculate_holding_days(entry_time_raw: Optional[str]) -> int:
    """Calculate days held since trade entry."""
    if not entry_time_raw:
        return 1
    try:
        entry_dt = localize_ist(entry_time_raw)
        now_dt = now_ist()
        diff = (now_dt.date() - entry_dt.date()).days
        return max(1, diff)
    except Exception:
        return 1


def evaluate_tranche_exits(
    trade: Dict[str, Any],
    current_price: float,
    send_alerts: bool = True,
) -> bool:
    """
    Evaluates 3-tranche scaling exits:
      Tranche 1 (50%): Exits on Target 1, ratchets SL to entry (risk-free).
      Tranche 2 (30%): Exits on Target 2, ratchets SL to Target 1.
      Tranche 3 (20%): Runner trailing with dynamic ATR ratchet stop.
    """
    trade_id = trade.get("id")
    if not trade_id:
        return False

    open_tranches = get_open_tranches_by_trade(str(trade_id)) or []
    if not open_tranches:
        return False

    entry_p = float(trade["entry_price"])
    symbol = str(trade.get("symbol", ""))
    direction = str(trade.get("signal_direction", "LONG")).upper()

    for tr in open_tranches:
        t_num = tr.get("tranche_number")
        t_target = float(tr.get("target_price", 0.0))
        t_qty = int(tr.get("quantity", 0))

        is_target_hit = (current_price >= t_target) if direction == "LONG" else (current_price <= t_target)

        if is_target_hit and t_qty > 0:
            gross_pnl = (current_price - entry_p) * t_qty if direction == "LONG" else (entry_p - current_price) * t_qty
            tax = calculate_tax(gross_pnl)
            net_pnl = gross_pnl - tax

            close_tranche(
                tranche_id=str(tr["id"]),
                exit_price=current_price,
                gross_pnl=gross_pnl,
                net_pnl=net_pnl,
            )

            # Ratchet SL after Tranche 1 or 2 hit
            if t_num == 1:
                new_sl = entry_p  # Breakeven SL (100% Risk-Free)
                update_trade_sl(
                    trade_id=str(trade_id),
                    sl_stage="BREAKEVEN",
                    current_sl=new_sl,
                )
                msg = f"ðŸŽ¯ <b>Tranche 1 Hit</b>: <code>{symbol}</code> @ â‚¹{current_price:.2f} (50% closed) â€” SL moved to Cost (â‚¹{new_sl:.2f}, Risk-Free!)"
                logger.info(f"[Tracker] {msg}")
                if send_alerts:
                    try:
                        send_message(msg)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            elif t_num == 2:
                new_sl = float(trade.get("target_1", entry_p))
                update_trade_sl(
                    trade_id=str(trade_id),
                    sl_stage="1R_LOCKED",
                    current_sl=new_sl,
                )
                msg = f"ðŸŽ¯ <b>Tranche 2 Hit</b>: <code>{symbol}</code> @ â‚¹{current_price:.2f} (30% closed) â€” SL locked at Target 1 (â‚¹{new_sl:.2f})"
                logger.info(f"[Tracker] {msg}")
                if send_alerts:
                    try:
                        send_message(msg)
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            return True

    return False


def check_paper_trades(
    live_prices: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    symbol_map: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    send_alerts: bool = True,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Main active position monitoring loop.
    Checks:
      1. MAE / MFE Extremes
      2. 03:15 PM Intraday MIS Square-Off
      3. Stale Trade Time Barriers (5-day Mean Rev / 15-day Swing)
      4. Stop Loss Breach
      5. 3-Tranche Scaling Exits & SL Ratchets
      6. Runner Dynamic ATR Trailing Stops
      7. Final Target Hit
    """
    open_trades = get_open_trades() or []
    if not open_trades:
        return []

    closed_results = []
    current_time_ist = now_ist()
    is_eod_squareoff_time = current_time_ist.hour == 15 and current_time_ist.minute >= 15

    for trade in open_trades:
        trade_id = trade.get("id")
        if not trade_id:
            continue
        symbol = str(trade.get("symbol", ""))
        direction = str(trade.get("signal_direction", "LONG")).upper()
        timeframe = str(trade.get("timeframe", "SWING")).upper()
        strategy_id = str(trade.get("strategy_id", "")).upper()
        entry_p = float(trade["entry_price"])
        cur_sl = float(trade.get("current_sl") or trade.get("stop_loss") or (entry_p * 0.98))
        target = float(trade.get("target") or (entry_p * 1.05))
        holding_days = _calculate_holding_days(trade.get("entry_time") or trade.get("created_at"))

        ltp = _get_current_price(symbol, live_prices, symbol_map)
        if ltp is None or ltp <= 0:
            continue

        # 1. Update MAE/MFE extremes
        update_position_extremes(trade_id, ltp, entry_p)

        # 2. Intraday EOD Square-Off (03:15 PM IST)
        if (timeframe == "INTRADAY" or "S08" in strategy_id) and is_eod_squareoff_time:
            from execution.orders import close_paper_trade
            res = close_paper_trade(str(trade_id), exit_price=ltp, exit_reason="INTRADAY_EOD_SQUAREOFF", holding_days=1)
            if res:
                closed_results.append(res)
                if send_alerts:
                    send_message(f"â° <b>Intraday Auto-Exit (03:15 PM)</b>: <code>{symbol}</code> closed @ â‚¹{ltp:.2f}")
            continue

        # 3. Time-Barrier Stale Trade Exit
        max_days = _MAX_HOLDING_DAYS_MEAN_REV if ("S02" in strategy_id or "S06" in strategy_id) else _MAX_HOLDING_DAYS_SWING
        if holding_days > max_days:
            from execution.orders import close_paper_trade
            res = close_paper_trade(str(trade_id), exit_price=ltp, exit_reason="TIME_BARRIER_EXPIRED", holding_days=holding_days)
            if res:
                closed_results.append(res)
                if send_alerts:
                    send_message(f"âŒ› <b>Time Barrier Exited ({holding_days}d)</b>: <code>{symbol}</code> closed @ â‚¹{ltp:.2f}")
            continue

        # 4. Check Stop Loss Hit
        is_sl_hit = (ltp <= cur_sl) if direction == "LONG" else (ltp >= cur_sl)
        if is_sl_hit:
            from execution.orders import close_paper_trade
            res = close_paper_trade(str(trade_id), exit_price=ltp, exit_reason="STOP_LOSS_HIT", holding_days=holding_days)
            if res:
                closed_results.append(res)
                if send_alerts:
                    send_message(f"ðŸ”´ <b>Stop Loss Hit</b>: <code>{symbol}</code> closed @ â‚¹{ltp:.2f} (SL: â‚¹{cur_sl:.2f})")
            continue

        # 5. Check Tranche Scaling Exits
        evaluate_tranche_exits(trade, ltp, send_alerts=send_alerts)

        # 6. Active Runner Volatility Trailing Stop Ratchet
        open_tranches = get_open_tranches_by_trade(str(trade_id)) or []
        if open_tranches and all(t.get("tranche_number") == 3 for t in open_tranches):
            # Only Runner (Tranche 3) remains open -> trail SL dynamically
            new_trailing_sl = calculate_trailing_sl(
                entry=entry_p,
                current_price=ltp,
                symbol=symbol,
                signal_direction=direction,
                current_sl=cur_sl,
            )
            if (direction == "LONG" and new_trailing_sl > cur_sl) or (direction == "SHORT" and new_trailing_sl < cur_sl):
                update_trade_sl(
                    trade_id=str(trade_id),
                    sl_stage="TRAILING",
                    current_sl=new_trailing_sl,
                    trailing_sl=new_trailing_sl,
                )
                logger.info(f"[Tracker] ðŸƒ Runner Trailing SL Ratcheted for {symbol}: â‚¹{cur_sl:.2f} -> â‚¹{new_trailing_sl:.2f}")

        # 7. Check Final Target Hit
        is_target_hit = (ltp >= target) if direction == "LONG" else (ltp <= target)
        if is_target_hit:
            from execution.orders import close_paper_trade
            res = close_paper_trade(str(trade_id), exit_price=ltp, exit_reason="TARGET_HIT", holding_days=holding_days)
            if res:
                closed_results.append(res)
                if send_alerts:
                    send_message(f"ðŸŽ‰ <b>Final Target Hit</b>: <code>{symbol}</code> closed @ â‚¹{ltp:.2f} (Target: â‚¹{target:.2f})")
            continue

    return closed_results


def get_open_trades_with_pnl(
    live_prices: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    symbol_map: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Enriches all open trades with real-time unrealized P&L and ROI percentage."""
    open_trades = get_open_trades() or []
    enriched = []

    for trade in open_trades:
        sym = str(trade.get("symbol", ""))
        entry_p = float(trade["entry_price"])
        qty = int(trade.get("quantity_remaining") or trade.get("quantity") or 1)
        direction = str(trade.get("signal_direction", "LONG")).upper()

        ltp = _get_current_price(sym, live_prices, symbol_map) or entry_p
        pnl = (ltp - entry_p) * qty if direction == "LONG" else (entry_p - ltp) * qty
        roi_pct = (pnl / (entry_p * qty)) * 100.0 if (entry_p * qty) > 0 else 0.0

        t_copy = dict(trade)
        t_copy["current_price"] = ltp
        t_copy["pnl"] = round(pnl, 2)
        t_copy["roi_pct"] = round(roi_pct, 2)
        enriched.append(t_copy)

    return enriched

"""
Module: intelligence/fii_dii.py
Purpose: SOTA Institutional FII / DII Net Flow Intelligence Engine.
         Analyzes Foreign & Domestic institutional participation in Indian equities,
         FII Index Futures Long/Short Squeeze Ratios, Participant-Wise Derivatives Matrix,
         and 5-Day Cumulative Cash Velocity to determine macro liquidity bias.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List, Union

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def calculate_fii_long_short_ratio(
    fii_long_contracts: int,
    fii_short_contracts: int,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Calculate FII Index Futures Long-Short Ratio from Participant-Wise Open Interest.
    - Ratio < 0.20 (<20% Longs): Extreme Bearish Positioning -> Imminent Short Squeeze Alert.
    - Ratio > 0.75 (>75% Longs): Extreme Bullish Overheating -> Long Unwinding Correction Alert.
    - Ratio 0.35 - 0.65: Normal balanced institutional stance.
    """
    total = max(1, fii_long_contracts + fii_short_contracts)
    long_pct = round((fii_long_contracts / total) * 100.0, 1)
    short_pct = round((fii_short_contracts / total) * 100.0, 1)
    ratio = round(fii_long_contracts / max(1, fii_short_contracts), 2)

    if long_pct <= 20.0:
        positioning = "EXTREME_OVERSOLD_SQUEEZE_ALERT"
        interpretation = "FIIs heavily short on Index Futures (<=20% Longs). Historically marks explosive short-squeeze bottoms."
    elif long_pct >= 75.0:
        positioning = "OVERBOUGHT_PULLBACK_ALERT"
        interpretation = "FIIs overextended on Index Futures (>=75% Longs). Vulnerable to institutional profit-taking pullbacks."
    elif long_pct >= 55.0:
        positioning = "MODERATELY_BULLISH"
        interpretation = "FIIs holding net long bias on Index Futures."
    elif long_pct <= 40.0:
        positioning = "MODERATELY_BEARISH"
        interpretation = "FIIs holding net short bias on Index Futures."
    else:
        positioning = "BALANCED"
        interpretation = "FIIs neutral on Index Futures positioning."

    return {
        "fii_long_contracts": fii_long_contracts,
        "fii_short_contracts": fii_short_contracts,
        "long_percentage": long_pct,
        "short_percentage": short_pct,
        "long_short_ratio": ratio,
        "positioning": positioning,
        "interpretation": interpretation,
    }


def calculate_cumulative_flow_velocity(
    daily_flows: List[Dict[str, float]],
    window_days: int = 5,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes multi-day cumulative FII & DII cash flow momentum in â‚¹ Crores.
    """
    if not daily_flows:
        return {"fii_5d_net_cr": 0.0, "dii_5d_net_cr": 0.0, "total_5d_net_cr": 0.0, "trend": "NEUTRAL", "window_days": 0}

    recent = daily_flows[-window_days:]
    fii_sum = sum(float(x.get("fii_net_cr", 0.0)) for x in recent)
    dii_sum = sum(float(x.get("dii_net_cr", 0.0)) for x in recent)
    total_sum = round(fii_sum + dii_sum, 2)

    if fii_sum > 5000:
        trend = "STRONG_GLOBAL_ACCUMULATION"
    elif total_sum > 3000:
        trend = "INSTITUTIONAL_ACCUMULATION"
    elif fii_sum < -5000 and dii_sum > 5000:
        trend = "DII_ABSORPTION_OF_FII_OUTFLOW"
    elif total_sum < -3000:
        trend = "INSTITUTIONAL_LIQUIDATION"
    else:
        trend = "BALANCED_CHOP"

    return {
        "fii_5d_net_cr": round(fii_sum, 2),
        "dii_5d_net_cr": round(dii_sum, 2),
        "total_5d_net_cr": total_sum,
        "trend": trend,
        "window_days": len(recent),
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FIIDIIFlowResult:
    """Immutable contract representing comprehensive FII/DII institutional intelligence."""
    fii_net_cr: float
    dii_net_cr: float
    total_institutional_net_cr: float
    flow_regime: str  # MEGA_BULLISH, GLOBAL_BULLISH, DOMESTIC_ABSORPTION, SEVERE_DRAIN, NEUTRAL
    confidence: int
    recommendation: str
    fii_long_short_ratio: float = 1.0
    fii_long_pct: float = 50.0
    fii_positioning_regime: str = "BALANCED"
    fii_5d_cumulative_cr: float = 0.0
    dii_5d_cumulative_cr: float = 0.0
    reasons: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def analyze_fii_dii_flow(
    fii_cash_net_cr: float = 0.0,
    dii_cash_net_cr: float = 0.0,
    fii_index_futures_longs: int = 0,
    fii_index_futures_shorts: int = 0,
    historical_daily_flows: Optional[List[Dict[str, float]]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Evaluate institutional net flows, futures long/short ratios, and multi-day velocity.

    Args:
        fii_cash_net_cr: FII net cash purchase (+) or sale (-) in â‚¹ Crores
        dii_cash_net_cr: DII net cash purchase (+) or sale (-) in â‚¹ Crores
        fii_index_futures_longs: Number of FII Long contracts on Index Futures
        fii_index_futures_shorts: Number of FII Short contracts on Index Futures
        historical_daily_flows: Past daily net flows for trend calculation

    Returns:
        Dictionary contract containing flow regime, confidence, squeeze alert, and recommendations.
    """
    total_net = round(fii_cash_net_cr + dii_cash_net_cr, 2)
    reasons = []

    # 1. Evaluate FII Futures Long-Short Squeeze Ratio
    futures_intel = calculate_fii_long_short_ratio(fii_index_futures_longs, fii_index_futures_shorts)
    if fii_index_futures_longs > 0 or fii_index_futures_shorts > 0:
        reasons.append(f"FII Index Futures: {futures_intel['long_percentage']:.1f}% Long ({futures_intel['long_short_ratio']:.2f} L/S Ratio) -> {futures_intel['positioning']}")

    # 2. Multi-Day Velocity
    velocity = calculate_cumulative_flow_velocity(historical_daily_flows or [])
    if velocity["window_days"] > 1:
        reasons.append(f"5-Day Trend: {velocity['trend']} (FII 5D: â‚¹{velocity['fii_5d_net_cr']:+,.0f} Cr | DII 5D: â‚¹{velocity['dii_5d_net_cr']:+,.0f} Cr)")

    # 3. Cash Flow Regime Classification
    # Regime 1: Both Institutional groups buying heavily
    if fii_cash_net_cr > 500 and dii_cash_net_cr > 500:
        regime = "MEGA_BULLISH"
        confidence = 90
        recommendation = f"Both FII & DII deploying heavy capital (+â‚¹{total_net:,.0f} Cr). Aggressive Long bias."
        reasons.append(f"FII Net: +â‚¹{fii_cash_net_cr:,.0f} Cr | DII Net: +â‚¹{dii_cash_net_cr:,.0f} Cr")

    # Regime 2: Global money leading
    elif fii_cash_net_cr > 1000:
        regime = "GLOBAL_BULLISH"
        confidence = 80
        recommendation = f"Heavy FII institutional accumulation (+â‚¹{fii_cash_net_cr:,.0f} Cr). Favour high-beta & large-cap momentum."
        reasons.append(f"FII inflows dominant (+â‚¹{fii_cash_net_cr:,.0f} Cr)")

    # Regime 3: DII absorbing FII selling (Classic Indian market pattern)
    elif fii_cash_net_cr < -1000 and dii_cash_net_cr > 1000:
        regime = "DOMESTIC_ABSORPTION"
        confidence = 70
        recommendation = "DIIs providing strong floor against FII selling. Market likely rangebound/defensive; trade stock-specific."
        reasons.append(f"FII Outflow: -â‚¹{abs(fii_cash_net_cr):,.0f} Cr absorbed by DII Inflow: +â‚¹{dii_cash_net_cr:,.0f} Cr")

    # Regime 4: Both institutional groups dumping shares
    elif fii_cash_net_cr < -500 and dii_cash_net_cr < -500:
        regime = "SEVERE_DRAIN"
        confidence = 85
        recommendation = f"Both FII & DII exiting cash (-â‚¹{abs(total_net):,.0f} Cr). High liquidity risk â€” tighten stops or stay in cash."
        reasons.append(f"Institutional liquidity drain (-â‚¹{abs(total_net):,.0f} Cr total)")

    else:
        regime = "NEUTRAL"
        confidence = 55
        recommendation = "Moderate institutional flows. Let technical chart signals govern position entries."
        reasons.append(f"FII: â‚¹{fii_cash_net_cr:+,.0f} Cr | DII: â‚¹{dii_cash_net_cr:+,.0f} Cr")

    # Squeeze Alert Confidence Booster
    if futures_intel["positioning"] == "EXTREME_OVERSOLD_SQUEEZE_ALERT" and regime in ("DOMESTIC_ABSORPTION", "NEUTRAL"):
        confidence = min(95, confidence + 15)
        recommendation += " âš¡ HIGH SHORT-SQUEEZE PROBABILITY (FII <=20% Longs)."

    result = FIIDIIFlowResult(
        fii_net_cr=fii_cash_net_cr,
        dii_net_cr=dii_cash_net_cr,
        total_institutional_net_cr=total_net,
        flow_regime=regime,
        confidence=confidence,
        recommendation=recommendation,
        fii_long_short_ratio=futures_intel["long_short_ratio"],
        fii_long_pct=futures_intel["long_percentage"],
        fii_positioning_regime=futures_intel["positioning"],
        fii_5d_cumulative_cr=velocity["fii_5d_net_cr"],
        dii_5d_cumulative_cr=velocity["dii_5d_net_cr"],
        reasons=reasons,
    )
    return result.to_dict()

"""
Module: intelligence/gift_nifty.py
Purpose: SOTA Pre-Market Gift Nifty Gap, Opening Sentiment,
         Breakaway vs Exhaustion Gap Classifier, and Global Macro Confluence Engine.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List, Union

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def classify_gap_type(
    gap_pct: float,
    prev_close: float,
    prev_high: float = 0.0,
    prev_low: float = 0.0,
    is_multi_day_breakout: bool = False,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Classify opening gap behavior and probability of gap fill in the first 60 minutes:
      - BREAKAWAY_GAP: Opening outside multi-day range with momentum (Low fill prob: ~25%, High Trend Day prob: ~75%).
      - EXHAUSTION_GAP: Massive opening gap (>1.2%) after extended trend (High fill prob: ~70%, Trap risk).
      - COMMON_GAP: Minor gap within previous day's trading range (Random walk / Chop).
    """
    abs_gap = abs(gap_pct)

    if abs_gap >= 1.20:
        gap_type = "EXHAUSTION_GAP"
        fill_probability = 70.0
        tactical_rule = "FADE_OR_WAIT: Extended gap prone to opening profit-taking & mean-reversion trap."
    elif is_multi_day_breakout or abs_gap >= 0.40:
        gap_type = "BREAKAWAY_GAP"
        fill_probability = 25.0
        tactical_rule = "TREND_CONTINUATION: High probability of one-way trend day; look for opening range breakout continuation."
    elif abs_gap <= 0.20:
        gap_type = "COMMON_GAP"
        fill_probability = 50.0
        tactical_rule = "RANGEBOUND_CHOP: Trade pure stock-specific technical levels."
    else:
        gap_type = "MILD_PROBING_GAP"
        fill_probability = 45.0
        tactical_rule = "NORMAL_OPEN: Check opening 15-minute high/low before initiating directional momentum."

    return {
        "gap_type": gap_type,
        "gap_magnitude_pct": round(gap_pct, 2),
        "fill_probability_pct": fill_probability,
        "tactical_rule": tactical_rule,
    }


def calculate_global_confluence_score(
    us_futures_pct: float = 0.0,
    crude_oil_change_pct: float = 0.0,
    dxy_dollar_change_pct: float = 0.0,
    asian_indices_pct: float = 0.0,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Compute Global Macro Sentiment Score (0 to 100):
      - US Tech / S&P Futures (+) -> Bullish (+weight)
      - Asian Markets (+) -> Bullish (+weight)
      - Brent Crude Oil (+) -> Bearish for India (-weight)
      - US Dollar Index (+) -> Bearish for Emerging Markets (-weight)
    """
    # Base score = 50 (Neutral)
    score = 50.0

    # 1. US Futures contribution (weight 35%)
    score += (us_futures_pct * 15.0)

    # 2. Asian Indices contribution (weight 25%)
    score += (asian_indices_pct * 10.0)

    # 3. Crude Oil contribution (Inverse for India: -weight 20%)
    score -= (crude_oil_change_pct * 4.0)

    # 4. Dollar Index DXY contribution (Inverse: -weight 20%)
    score -= (dxy_dollar_change_pct * 10.0)

    score_clamped = round(max(5.0, min(95.0, score)), 1)

    if score_clamped >= 65.0:
        climate = "GLOBAL_RISK_ON"
    elif score_clamped <= 35.0:
        climate = "GLOBAL_RISK_OFF"
    else:
        climate = "GLOBAL_NEUTRAL"

    return {
        "global_macro_score": score_clamped,
        "global_climate": climate,
        "us_futures_pct": us_futures_pct,
        "crude_oil_change_pct": crude_oil_change_pct,
        "dxy_dollar_change_pct": dxy_dollar_change_pct,
        "asian_indices_pct": asian_indices_pct,
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GiftNiftyGapResult:
    """Immutable contract representing the complete pre-market opening intelligence."""
    predicted_gap_pct: float
    predicted_gap_points: float
    opening_bias: str  # STRONG_BULLISH, BULLISH, FLAT, BEARISH, STRONG_BEARISH
    gift_nifty_price: float
    nifty_prev_close: float
    gap_type: str
    fill_probability_pct: float
    global_macro_score: float
    global_climate: str
    recommendation: str
    reasons: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def analyze_pre_market_gap(
    gift_nifty_price: Optional[float] = None,
    nifty_prev_close: Optional[float] = None,
    prev_high: float = 0.0,
    prev_low: float = 0.0,
    is_multi_day_breakout: bool = False,
    us_futures_pct: float = 0.0,
    crude_oil_change_pct: float = 0.0,
    dxy_dollar_change_pct: float = 0.0,
    asian_indices_pct: float = 0.0,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Analyze pre-market opening gap expectations, gap classification, and global macro confluence.

    Args:
        gift_nifty_price: Current Gift Nifty trading price
        nifty_prev_close: Previous NSE Nifty 50 close
        prev_high: Previous day's high
        prev_low: Previous day's low
        is_multi_day_breakout: Whether gap is breaking out of multi-day consolidation
        us_futures_pct: Overnight US Futures change %
        crude_oil_change_pct: Overnight Brent Crude change %
        dxy_dollar_change_pct: Dollar Index change %
        asian_indices_pct: Asian Markets (Nikkei/Hang Seng) average change %

    Returns:
        Dictionary contract containing opening bias, gap classification, and tactical rules.
    """
    # Safe defaults
    if nifty_prev_close is None or nifty_prev_close <= 0:
        nifty_prev_close = 24500.0

    if gift_nifty_price is None or gift_nifty_price <= 0:
        gift_nifty_price = nifty_prev_close

    gap_points = round(gift_nifty_price - nifty_prev_close, 2)
    gap_pct = round((gap_points / nifty_prev_close) * 100.0, 2)

    # 1. Classify Gap Dynamics
    gap_meta = classify_gap_type(
        gap_pct=gap_pct,
        prev_close=nifty_prev_close,
        prev_high=prev_high,
        prev_low=prev_low,
        is_multi_day_breakout=is_multi_day_breakout,
    )

    # 2. Global Macro Confluence
    global_macro = calculate_global_confluence_score(
        us_futures_pct=us_futures_pct,
        crude_oil_change_pct=crude_oil_change_pct,
        dxy_dollar_change_pct=dxy_dollar_change_pct,
        asian_indices_pct=asian_indices_pct,
    )

    reasons = []

    if gap_pct >= 0.75:
        bias = "STRONG_BULLISH"
        recommendation = f"Strong Gap-Up expected (>+0.75%). {gap_meta['tactical_rule']}"
        reasons.append(f"Gift Nifty trading +{gap_points:.1f} pts (+{gap_pct:.2f}%) above previous close")
    elif gap_pct >= 0.25:
        bias = "BULLISH"
        recommendation = f"Mild Gap-Up (+0.25% to +0.75%). {gap_meta['tactical_rule']}"
        reasons.append(f"Positive pre-market momentum (+{gap_points:.1f} pts)")
    elif gap_pct <= -0.75:
        bias = "STRONG_BEARISH"
        recommendation = f"Strong Gap-Down expected (<-0.75%). {gap_meta['tactical_rule']}"
        reasons.append(f"Gift Nifty trading {gap_points:.1f} pts ({gap_pct:.2f}%) below previous close")
    elif gap_pct <= -0.25:
        bias = "BEARISH"
        recommendation = f"Mild Gap-Down (-0.25% to -0.75%). {gap_meta['tactical_rule']}"
        reasons.append(f"Negative pre-market drift ({gap_points:.1f} pts)")
    else:
        bias = "FLAT"
        recommendation = f"Flat open expected. {gap_meta['tactical_rule']}"
        reasons.append(f"Neutral pre-market drift ({gap_points:+.1f} pts / {gap_pct:+.2f}%)")

    reasons.append(f"Gap Structure: {gap_meta['gap_type']} (Fill Probability: {gap_meta['fill_probability_pct']}%)")
    reasons.append(f"Global Macro Score: {global_macro['global_macro_score']}/100 ({global_macro['global_climate']})")

    result = GiftNiftyGapResult(
        predicted_gap_pct=gap_pct,
        predicted_gap_points=gap_points,
        opening_bias=bias,
        gift_nifty_price=gift_nifty_price,
        nifty_prev_close=nifty_prev_close,
        gap_type=gap_meta["gap_type"],
        fill_probability_pct=gap_meta["fill_probability_pct"],
        global_macro_score=global_macro["global_macro_score"],
        global_climate=global_macro["global_climate"],
        recommendation=recommendation,
        reasons=reasons,
    )
    return result.to_dict()

"""
Module: intelligence/macro_calendar.py
Purpose: SOTA High-Impact Macroeconomic Event Sentry & Policy Risk Engine
         (RBI MPC Rate Decisions, Union Budget, India CPI/GDP, US FOMC & NFP).
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import datetime, date, time
import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Tuple, Union

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

HIGH_IMPACT_EVENT_TYPES = {
    "RBI_MPC_RATE_DECISION": {"impact": "CRITICAL", "holding_penalty": "REDUCE_50_PCT", "spread_only": True},
    "UNION_BUDGET": {"impact": "CRITICAL", "holding_penalty": "REDUCE_75_PCT", "spread_only": True},
    "INDIA_CPI_INFLATION": {"impact": "HIGH", "holding_penalty": "REDUCE_25_PCT", "spread_only": False},
    "INDIA_GDP_GROWTH": {"impact": "HIGH", "holding_penalty": "REDUCE_25_PCT", "spread_only": False},
    "US_FED_FOMC_DECISION": {"impact": "HIGH", "holding_penalty": "REDUCE_30_PCT", "spread_only": False},
    "US_NON_FARM_PAYROLLS": {"impact": "MEDIUM", "holding_penalty": "NO_OVERNIGHT_EXP", "spread_only": False},
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MacroEventRiskResult:
    """Immutable contract representing current macroeconomic event risk state."""
    has_event_today: bool
    event_name: Optional[str]
    impact_level: str  # CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, NONE
    risk_action: str   # REDUCE_50_PCT, SPREADS_ONLY, NORMAL_TRADING, NO_OVERNIGHT
    hours_until_event: Optional[float]
    event_description: str
    reasons: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def evaluate_macro_event_risk(
    check_date: Optional[Union[date, datetime, str]] = None,
    custom_events: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Evaluate if high-impact macroeconomic events are scheduled today or imminent.
    """
    today_dt = datetime.now() if check_date is None else (
        datetime.fromisoformat(str(check_date)) if isinstance(check_date, str) else (
            datetime.combine(check_date, time(9, 15)) if isinstance(check_date, date) and not isinstance(check_date, datetime) else check_date
        )
    )
    today_str = today_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    if custom_events is not None:
        events = custom_events
    else:
        events = [
            {"date": today_str, "event": "RBI_MPC_RATE_DECISION", "time": "10:00", "title": "RBI Monetary Policy Committee Rate Decision"}
        ]

    # Find today's events
    matching_events = [e for e in events if e.get("date") == today_str]

    if not matching_events:
        res = MacroEventRiskResult(
            has_event_today=False,
            event_name=None,
            impact_level="NONE",
            risk_action="NORMAL_TRADING",
            hours_until_event=None,
            event_description="No high-impact macroeconomic events scheduled today.",
            reasons=["Normal risk sizing active", "No binary event risk detected"],
        )
        return res.to_dict()

    top_event = matching_events[0]
    evt_type = top_event.get("event", "UNKNOWN_EVENT")
    meta = HIGH_IMPACT_EVENT_TYPES.get(evt_type, {"impact": "MEDIUM", "holding_penalty": "REDUCE_25_PCT", "spread_only": False})

    impact = meta["impact"]
    action = meta["holding_penalty"]
    title: str = str(top_event.get("title") or evt_type)

    reasons = [
        f"High-Impact Event Today: {title} ({impact} Priority)",
        f"Risk Policy: {action} (Defined-Risk Option Spreads Recommended)",
    ]

    res = MacroEventRiskResult(
        has_event_today=True,
        event_name=evt_type,
        impact_level=impact,
        risk_action=action,
        hours_until_event=2.0,
        event_description=title,
        reasons=reasons,
    )
    return res.to_dict()
