import pandas as pd

from strategy.registry.base import BaseStrategy, StrategySignalResult
from strategy.registry import indicators as ind

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MacroCommodityCrypto(BaseStrategy):
    """
    S12: Multi-Asset Global Macro Commodity & Crypto Trend Following Strategy.
    Rides major secular trends across commodities, cryptocurrencies, and global macro assets.
    """

    name: str                        = "S12_MacroCommodityCrypto"
    display_name: str                = "Macro Commodity & Crypto"
    timeframe: str                   = "POSITIONAL"
    asset_class: str                 = "COMMODITY"
    version: str                     = "1.0"
    is_active: bool                  = True
    allowed_asset_classes: Sequence[str] = ("COMMODITY", "CRYPTO", "INDEX", "FOREX", "EQUITY")
    allowed_regimes: Sequence[str]   = ("BULL", "BEAR", "NEUTRAL", "SIDEWAYS")
    min_candles_required: int        = 100
    min_holding_days: int            = 5
    max_holding_days: int            = 30

    EMA_FAST: int                    = 20       # Fast trend EMA

    SUPERTREND_PERIOD: int           = 10
    SUPERTREND_MULT: float           = 3.0
    ATR_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    MIN_SCORE: int                   = 75       # Minimum technical score

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,
        vix: float,
        market_state: str,
        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:
        """
        Generate S12 Macro Commodity & Crypto Trend signal.
        """
        try:

                return None

            close  = np.asarray(df["Close"], dtype=float)
            high   = np.asarray(df["High"], dtype=float)
            low    = np.asarray(df["Low"], dtype=float)
            open_  = np.asarray(df["Open"], dtype=float)
            volume = np.asarray(df["Volume"], dtype=float) if "Volume" in df.columns else np.zeros_like(close)

            latest_close = float(close[-1])
            if np.isnan(latest_close) or latest_close <= 0:

                return None

            score: int = 0
            reasons: List[str] = []

            # â”€â”€ 1. ADX Trend Velocity (HARD SENTRY 1) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("adx", "plus_di", "minus_di")):
                latest_adx      = float(precomputed_indicators["adx"])
                latest_plus_di  = float(precomputed_indicators["plus_di"])
                latest_minus_di = float(precomputed_indicators["minus_di"])
            else:
                adx_vals = ind.ADX(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                p_di     = ind.PLUS_DI(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                m_di     = ind.MINUS_DI(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                latest_adx      = float(adx_vals[-1]) if len(adx_vals) > 0 else 0.0
                latest_plus_di  = float(p_di[-1]) if len(p_di) > 0 else 0.0

            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("ema_short", "ema_mid", "ema_long")):
                ema20  = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_short"])
                ema50  = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_mid"])
                ema200 = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_long"])

                e20  = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_FAST)
                e50  = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_MID)
                e200 = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_SLOW)
                ema20  = float(e20[-1]) if len(e20) > 0 else latest_close
                ema50  = float(e50[-1]) if len(e50) > 0 else latest_close
                ema200 = float(e200[-1]) if len(e200) > 0 else latest_close

                avg_atr  = float(np.nanmean(atr_vals[-self.ATR_PERIOD-1:-1])) if len(atr_vals) > self.ATR_PERIOD else curr_atr

            st_line, st_trend = ind.supertrend(high, low, close, period=self.SUPERTREND_PERIOD, multiplier=self.SUPERTREND_MULT)
            latest_st = float(st_line[-1])
            st_dir    = int(st_trend[-1])

            # â”€â”€ 5. Directional Evaluation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            signal_direction: Optional[str] = None
            signal_type: Optional[str] = None
            candle_pattern = "NONE"

            # ðŸŸ¢ LONG: Secular Bull Trend
            if latest_close > ema50 and latest_plus_di > latest_minus_di and st_dir == 1:
                signal_direction = "LONG"
                signal_type = "BUY"

                # Pillar 1: Moving Average Stack
                if latest_close > ema20 > ema50 > ema200:
                    score += 25
                    reasons.append(f"Triple Macro EMA aligned up (EMA{self.EMA_FAST} > EMA{self.EMA_MID} > EMA{self.EMA_SLOW})")
                elif latest_close > ema20 > ema50:
                    score += 18
                    reasons.append("Fast > Mid EMA uptrend")
                else:
                    score += 10
                    reasons.append("Price above 50-EMA macro support")

                # Pillar 2: ADX Macro Velocity
                if latest_adx >= self.ADX_MIN_VELOCITY:
                    score += 25
                    reasons.append(f"Strong macro trend velocity (ADX: {latest_adx:.1f} >= {self.ADX_MIN_VELOCITY:.0f}, +DI > -DI)")

                    score += 15

                else:
                    score += 15
                    reasons.append("Stable macro volatility")

                # Pillar 4: Supertrend & Volume
                score += 25
                candle_pattern = "MACRO_BULL_TREND"
                reasons.append(f"Supertrend green support confirmed (â‚¹{latest_st:.2f})")

            elif latest_close < ema50 and latest_minus_di > latest_plus_di and st_dir == -1:

            final_score = min(100.0, float(score))
            if final_score < self.MIN_SCORE:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ Construct Strongly Typed Result Contract â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            return StrategySignalResult(
                strategy_id=self.name,
                strategy_version=self.version,
                symbol=symbol,
                signal_direction=signal_direction,
                signal_type=signal_type,
                technical_score=final_score,
                confidence=final_score,
                reasons=reasons,
                entry_price=round(latest_close, 2),

                swing_high=stop_loss if signal_direction == "SHORT" else None,
                sl_method="MACRO_SUPERTREND_ATR",
                timeframe=self.timeframe,
                asset_class=self.asset_class,
                atr=round(curr_atr, 4),
                option_type="FUT" if signal_direction in ("LONG", "SHORT") else None,
                candle_pattern=candle_pattern,
                indicator_values={
                    "adx": round(latest_adx, 2),
                    "plus_di": round(latest_plus_di, 2),
                    "minus_di": round(latest_minus_di, 2),
                    "ema_fast": round(ema20, 2),
                    "ema_mid": round(ema50, 2),
                    "ema_slow": round(ema200, 2),
                    "supertrend": round(latest_st, 2),
                    "atr": round(curr_atr, 4),
                    "stop_loss": stop_loss,
                },
                extra_metadata={
                    "vix": round(float(vix), 2),

                    "mqi_level": mqi_level,
                    "strategy_structure": "GLOBAL_MACRO_COMMODITY_CRYPTO_TREND",
                    "min_holding_days": self.min_holding_days,
                    "max_holding_days": self.max_holding_days,
                },

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[S12] generate_signal exception for {symbol}: {e}")
            return None

"""
Module: strategy/registry/mean_reversion.py
Purpose: S02 â€” SOTA Institutional Multi-Asset Mean Reversion Long Strategy.
         Captures high-probability oversold pullbacks in secularly uptrending assets (Price > EMA200).
         Combines Larry Connors' Dual-Period RSI (RSI14 & Fast RSI2), Consecutive Down-Day Exhaustion,
         Statistical Volatility Displacement (ATR & Bollinger Bands), Capitulation Volume Absorption (RVOL/CMF),
         and Bullish Price Action Rejection triggers.

Pillars of Scoring (Total: 100 Points, Minimum Gate: 70 Points):
  â€¢ HARD SENTRY 1: Price MUST be above EMA200 (No falling knives in secular downtrends)
  â€¢ HARD SENTRY 2: RSI(14) MUST be in oversold pullback territory (RSI14 <= 38.0)
  1. Multi-Period RSI Exhaustion (RSI14 < 30 or Connors Fast RSI2 < 10): +25 Pts
  2. Statistical Volatility Stretch (Close <= BB Lower or Stretch >= 1.8 ATR): +25 Pts
  3. Capitulation Volume Flow & Absorption (RVOL >= 1.30x or CMF > 0.05): +25 Pts
  4. Bullish Price Action Rejection (Lower shadow / Hammer / Green Close): +20 Pts
  * Bonus (+10 Pts): Consecutive Down-Days Exhaustion (>= 3 consecutive red bars into support)

Inherits from BaseStrategy with full multi-asset, multi-timeframe, and precomputed indicator support.
"""

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Union
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from strategy.registry.base import BaseStrategy, StrategySignalResult
from strategy.registry import indicators as ind

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MeanReversion(BaseStrategy):
    """
    S02 â€” Mean Reversion Long Strategy.
    
    Research targets:
        Win rate > 55%
        Best regime: BULL â€” oversold dip in secular bull trend
        Worst regime: BEAR / Crash â€” falling knife risk
        IC target: > 0.05 (Alphalens)
    """

    name: str                        = "S02_MeanReversion"
    display_name: str                = "Mean Reversion"
    timeframe: str                   = "SWING"
    asset_class: str                 = "EQUITY"
    version: str                     = "2.2"
    is_active: bool                  = True
    allowed_asset_classes: Sequence[str] = ("EQUITY", "INDEX", "COMMODITY", "CRYPTO", "FOREX")
    allowed_regimes: Sequence[str]   = ("BULL", "NEUTRAL", "SIDEWAYS")
    min_candles_required: int        = 210
    min_holding_days: int            = 2
    max_holding_days: int            = 7

    # â”€â”€ Parameters (Logged to MLflow / Optuna tunable) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    RSI_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    RSI_FAST_PERIOD: int             = 2        # Larry Connors fast RSI
    RSI_OVERSOLD_DEEP: float         = 30.0     # Deep oversold threshold for RSI(14)
    RSI_OVERSOLD_MAX: float          = 38.0     # Max oversold ceiling for pullbacks in bull markets
    RSI_FAST_OVERSOLD: float         = 10.0     # Extreme fast exhaustion threshold for RSI(2)

    BB_PERIOD: int                   = 20       # Bollinger Band period
    BB_STD: float                    = 2.0      # Standard deviations
    EMA_SHORT: int                   = 20       # Baseline mean period
    EMA_LONG: int                    = 200      # Macro trend sentry (EMA200)

    VOLUME_PERIOD: int               = 20       # Volume average period
    VOLUME_SPIKE: float              = 1.30     # Capitulation volume surge multiplier (1.30x)
    ATR_PERIOD: int                  = 14       # ATR period for stretch and sizing
    ATR_STRETCH_MULT: float          = 1.8      # Minimum ATR stretch from 20-EMA
    CONSECUTIVE_DOWN_DAYS: int       = 3        # Minimum down days for exhaustion bonus

    MIN_SCORE: int                   = 70       # Minimum technical score

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,
        vix: float,
        market_state: str,
        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:
        """
        Generate S02 Mean Reversion signal for given symbol and market conditions.
        """
        try:
            # 1. Validate DataFrame minimum history
            is_valid, reason = self.validate_ohlcv_dataframe(df, min_candles=self.min_candles_required)
            if not is_valid:
                logger.warning(f"[S02] {symbol} â€” {reason}")
                return None

            close  = np.asarray(df["Close"], dtype=float)
            high   = np.asarray(df["High"], dtype=float)
            low    = np.asarray(df["Low"], dtype=float)
            open_  = np.asarray(df["Open"], dtype=float)
            volume = np.asarray(df["Volume"], dtype=float) if "Volume" in df.columns else np.zeros_like(close)

            score: int = 0
            reasons: List[str] = []

            # â”€â”€ 1. EMA200 Macro Trend Filter (HARD SENTRY 1) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "ema_long" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_ema200 = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_long"])
            else:
                ema200 = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_LONG)
                latest_ema200 = float(ema200[-1]) if len(ema200) > 0 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(latest_ema200):
                logger.warning(f"[S02] {symbol} â€” EMA200 is NaN")
                return None

            latest_close = float(close[-1])

            # HARD SENTRY: Cannot buy oversold dips in stocks below 200 EMA
            if latest_close <= latest_ema200:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ 2. Dual-Period RSI (RSI14 & Connors Fast RSI2) (HARD SENTRY 2) 
            if precomputed_indicators and "rsi" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rsi = float(precomputed_indicators["rsi"])
            else:
                rsi14 = ind.RSI(close, timeperiod=self.RSI_PERIOD)
                latest_rsi = float(rsi14[-1]) if len(rsi14) > 0 else float("nan")

            if precomputed_indicators and "rsi_fast" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rsi_fast = float(precomputed_indicators["rsi_fast"])
            else:
                rsi2 = ind.RSI(close, timeperiod=self.RSI_FAST_PERIOD)
                latest_rsi_fast = float(rsi2[-1]) if len(rsi2) > 0 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(latest_rsi):
                logger.warning(f"[S02] {symbol} â€” RSI is NaN")
                return None

            # HARD SENTRY: Must be within oversold pullback ceiling
            if latest_rsi > self.RSI_OVERSOLD_MAX and (np.isnan(latest_rsi_fast) or latest_rsi_fast > self.RSI_FAST_OVERSOLD):
                return None

            # Score RSI exhaustion
            if latest_rsi <= self.RSI_OVERSOLD_DEEP or latest_rsi_fast <= self.RSI_FAST_OVERSOLD:
                score += 25
                reasons.append(f"Deep RSI exhaustion (RSI14: {latest_rsi:.1f}, Fast RSI2: {latest_rsi_fast:.1f})")
            else:
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Bull market pullback RSI (RSI14: {latest_rsi:.1f} <= {self.RSI_OVERSOLD_MAX:.0f})")

            # â”€â”€ 3. ATR Volatility & Statistical Stretch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "atr" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_atr = float(precomputed_indicators["atr"])
            else:
                atr_vals = ind.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ATR_PERIOD)
                latest_atr = float(atr_vals[-1]) if len(atr_vals) > 0 else 0.0

            if np.isnan(latest_atr) or latest_atr <= 0:
                logger.warning(f"[S02] {symbol} â€” NaN or zero ATR")
                return None

            # â”€â”€ 4. Bollinger Bands & ATR Distance Stretch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("bb_upper", "bb_middle", "bb_lower")):
                latest_upper  = float(precomputed_indicators["bb_upper"])
                latest_middle = float(precomputed_indicators["bb_middle"])
                latest_lower  = float(precomputed_indicators["bb_lower"])
            else:
                upper, middle, lower = ind.BBANDS(
                    close,
                    timeperiod=self.BB_PERIOD,
                    nbdevup=self.BB_STD,
                    nbdevdn=self.BB_STD,
                )
                latest_upper  = float(upper[-1])
                latest_middle = float(middle[-1])
                latest_lower  = float(lower[-1])

            bb_range = latest_upper - latest_lower
            bb_pct = round((latest_close - latest_lower) / (bb_range + 1e-10) * 100.0, 1)

            # Measure distance stretch from 20-period baseline in ATR units
            mean_dist = (latest_middle - latest_close) / latest_atr

            if latest_close <= latest_lower or mean_dist >= self.ATR_STRETCH_MULT:
                score += 25
                reasons.append(f"Statistical volatility stretch confirmed (BB%: {bb_pct}%, Stretch: {mean_dist:.1f} ATR)")
            elif latest_close <= latest_middle:
                score += 12
                reasons.append(f"Price below 20-day mean (BB%: {bb_pct}%)")
            else:
                reasons.append("Price above 20-day mean")

            # â”€â”€ 5. Capitulation Volume Flow Surge â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "rvol" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rvol = float(precomputed_indicators["rvol"])
            else:
                rvol_arr = ind.RVOL(volume, timeperiod=self.VOLUME_PERIOD) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.ones_like(close)
                latest_rvol = float(rvol_arr[-1]) if len(rvol_arr) > 0 else 1.0

            if precomputed_indicators and "cmf" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_cmf = float(precomputed_indicators["cmf"])
            else:
                cmf_arr = ind.CMF(high, low, close, volume, timeperiod=20) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.zeros_like(close)
                latest_cmf = float(cmf_arr[-1]) if len(cmf_arr) > 0 else 0.0

            if latest_rvol >= self.VOLUME_SPIKE or latest_cmf > 0.05:
                score += 25
                reasons.append(f"Capitulation volume surge (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x >= {self.VOLUME_SPIKE:.2f}x, CMF: {latest_cmf:.2f})")
            elif latest_rvol >= 1.0:
                score += 12
                reasons.append(f"Standard volume absorption (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")
            else:
                reasons.append(f"Low volume dip (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")

            # â”€â”€ 6. Bullish Price Action Absorption & Rejection Trigger â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            latest_open = float(open_[-1])
            latest_high = float(high[-1])
            latest_low  = float(low[-1])
            body = abs(latest_close - latest_open)
            lower_shadow = min(latest_open, latest_close) - latest_low

            hammer    = ind.CDLHAMMER(open_, high, low, close)
            engulfing = ind.CDLENGULFING(open_, high, low, close)
            doji      = ind.CDLDOJI(open_, high, low, close)

            candle_pattern = "NONE"
            if hammer[-1] != 0:
                score += 20
                candle_pattern = "HAMMER"
                reasons.append("Bullish Hammer rejection candle confirmed")
            elif engulfing[-1] > 0:
                score += 20
                candle_pattern = "BULLISH_ENGULFING"
                reasons.append("Bullish Engulfing reversal confirmed")
            elif doji[-1] != 0:
                score += 15
                candle_pattern = "DOJI"
                reasons.append("Indecision Doji candle at lows")
            elif lower_shadow >= 1.5 * (body + 1e-5) or latest_close > latest_open:
                score += 15
                candle_pattern = "BULLISH_ABSORPTION"
                reasons.append("Bullish lower wick absorption confirmed")
            else:
                reasons.append("No absorption candlestick confirmation")

            # â”€â”€ 7. Consecutive Down-Days Exhaustion Bonus â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            # If stock fell for >= 3 consecutive bars into support, selling pressure is exhausted
            consecutive_down = 0
            for i in range(len(close) - 2, max(0, len(close) - 7), -1):
                if close[i] < close[i - 1]:
                    consecutive_down += 1
                else:
                    break

            if consecutive_down >= self.CONSECUTIVE_DOWN_DAYS:
                score += 10
                reasons.append(f"Selling exhaustion bonus ({consecutive_down} consecutive down days)")

            # â”€â”€ 8. Multi-Timeframe Filter (HTF Trend Alignment) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if higher_tf_df is not None and len(higher_tf_df) >= 50:
                htf_close = np.asarray(higher_tf_df["Close"], dtype=float)
                htf_ema50 = ind.EMA(htf_close, timeperiod=50)
                if htf_close[-1] < htf_ema50[-1]:
                    score = max(0, score - 15)
                    reasons.append("Higher timeframe (Daily) EMA50 resistance penalty applied")

            # â”€â”€ Score Gate Check â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            final_score = min(100.0, float(score))
            if final_score < self.MIN_SCORE:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ Construct Strongly Typed Result Contract â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            return StrategySignalResult(
                strategy_id=self.name,
                strategy_version=self.version,
                symbol=symbol,
                signal_direction="LONG",
                signal_type="BUY",
                technical_score=final_score,
                confidence=final_score,
                reasons=reasons,
                entry_price=round(latest_close, 2),
                timeframe=self.timeframe,
                asset_class=self.asset_class,
                atr=round(latest_atr, 4),
                candle_pattern=candle_pattern,
                indicator_values={
                    "rsi": round(latest_rsi, 2),
                    "rsi_fast": round(latest_rsi_fast, 2) if not np.isnan(latest_rsi_fast) else 0.0,
                    "atr": round(latest_atr, 4),
                    "rvol": round(latest_rvol, 2),
                    "cmf": round(latest_cmf, 4),
                    "bb_pct": bb_pct,
                    "ema_long": round(latest_ema200, 2),
                },
                extra_metadata={
                    "vix": round(float(vix), 2),
                    "market_state": market_state,
                    "mqi_level": mqi_level,
                    "consecutive_down_days": consecutive_down,
                    "min_holding_days": self.min_holding_days,
                    "max_holding_days": self.max_holding_days,
                },
            )

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[S02] generate_signal exception for {symbol}: {e}")
            return None

    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """All S02 parameters for MLflow experiment tracking."""
        return {
            "strategy_id":            self.name,
            "version":                self.version,
            "rsi_period":             self.RSI_PERIOD,
            "rsi_fast_period":        self.RSI_FAST_PERIOD,
            "rsi_oversold_deep":      self.RSI_OVERSOLD_DEEP,
            "rsi_oversold_max":       self.RSI_OVERSOLD_MAX,
            "rsi_fast_oversold":      self.RSI_FAST_OVERSOLD,
            "bb_period":              self.BB_PERIOD,
            "bb_std":                 self.BB_STD,
            "volume_period":          self.VOLUME_PERIOD,
            "volume_spike":           self.VOLUME_SPIKE,
            "ema_long":               self.EMA_LONG,
            "atr_period":             self.ATR_PERIOD,
            "atr_stretch_mult":       self.ATR_STRETCH_MULT,
            "consecutive_down_days":  self.CONSECUTIVE_DOWN_DAYS,
            "min_score":              self.MIN_SCORE,
            "timeframe":              self.timeframe,
            "asset_class":            self.asset_class,
            "allowed_asset_classes":  list(self.allowed_asset_classes),
            "allowed_regimes":        list(self.allowed_regimes),
            "min_holding_days":       self.min_holding_days,
            "max_holding_days":       self.max_holding_days,
        }

    def get_description(self) -> str:
        """Human-readable description for alerts and research reports."""
        return (
            f"S02 Mean Reversion v{self.version} â€” "
            f"Oversold dip in secular bull trend: Dual RSI (RSI14<={self.RSI_OVERSOLD_MAX:.0f} / RSI2<={self.RSI_FAST_OVERSOLD:.0f}), "
            f"at BB lower or >={self.ATR_STRETCH_MULT}x ATR stretch, "
            f"capitulation volume spike >={self.VOLUME_SPIKE:.2f}x, "
            f"above EMA{self.EMA_LONG}. Min score {self.MIN_SCORE}/100. Swing trades {self.min_holding_days}-{self.max_holding_days} days."
        )

    RSI_OVERBOUGHT_MIN: float        = 62.0     # Relief rally overbought floor in bear market
    RSI_FAST_OVERBOUGHT: float       = 90.0     # Extreme fast exhaustion threshold for RSI(2)

    BB_PERIOD: int                   = 20       # Bollinger Band period
    BB_STD: float                    = 2.0      # Standard deviations

    EMA_MID: int                     = 50       # 50-day EMA resistance level
    EMA_LONG: int                    = 200      # Macro trend sentry (EMA200)

        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:

        Generate S07 Mean Reversion Short signal for given symbol and market conditions.
        """

            # 1. Validate DataFrame minimum history
            is_valid, reason = self.validate_ohlcv_dataframe(df, min_candles=self.min_candles_required)
            if not is_valid:
                logger.warning(f"[S07] {symbol} â€” {reason}")
                return None

            high   = np.asarray(df["High"], dtype=float)
            low    = np.asarray(df["Low"], dtype=float)
            open_  = np.asarray(df["Open"], dtype=float)
            volume = np.asarray(df["Volume"], dtype=float) if "Volume" in df.columns else np.zeros_like(close)

            score: int = 0
            reasons: List[str] = []

            # â”€â”€ 1. EMA200 Macro Trend Filter (HARD SENTRY 1) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

                latest_ema200 = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_long"])
            else:
                ema200 = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_LONG)
                latest_ema200 = float(ema200[-1]) if len(ema200) > 0 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(latest_ema200):
                logger.warning(f"[S07] {symbol} â€” EMA200 is NaN")
                return None

            latest_close = float(close[-1])
            if np.isnan(latest_close) or latest_close <= 0:
                logger.warning(f"[S07] {symbol} â€” latest_close is NaN or non-positive")
                return None

            # HARD SENTRY: Cannot short overbought rips in stocks above 200 EMA (bull trends)
            if latest_close >= latest_ema200:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ 2. Dual-Period RSI (RSI14 & Connors Fast RSI2) (HARD SENTRY 2)
            if precomputed_indicators and "rsi" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rsi = float(precomputed_indicators["rsi"])
            else:
                rsi14 = ind.RSI(close, timeperiod=self.RSI_PERIOD)
                latest_rsi = float(rsi14[-1]) if len(rsi14) > 0 else float("nan")

            if precomputed_indicators and "rsi_fast" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rsi_fast = float(precomputed_indicators["rsi_fast"])
            else:
                rsi2 = ind.RSI(close, timeperiod=self.RSI_FAST_PERIOD)
                latest_rsi_fast = float(rsi2[-1]) if len(rsi2) > 0 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(latest_rsi):
                logger.warning(f"[S07] {symbol} â€” RSI is NaN")
                return None

            # HARD SENTRY: Must be within relief rally overbought territory
            if latest_rsi < self.RSI_OVERBOUGHT_MIN and (np.isnan(latest_rsi_fast) or latest_rsi_fast < self.RSI_FAST_OVERBOUGHT):
                return None

            # Score RSI exhaustion
            if latest_rsi >= self.RSI_OVERBOUGHT_DEEP or latest_rsi_fast >= self.RSI_FAST_OVERBOUGHT:
                score += 25
                reasons.append(f"Deep overbought RSI exhaustion (RSI14: {latest_rsi:.1f}, Fast RSI2: {latest_rsi_fast:.1f})")
            else:
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Bear market relief rally RSI (RSI14: {latest_rsi:.1f} >= {self.RSI_OVERBOUGHT_MIN:.0f})")

            # â”€â”€ 3. ATR Volatility & Statistical Stretch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "atr" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_atr = float(precomputed_indicators["atr"])
            else:
                atr_vals = ind.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ATR_PERIOD)
                latest_atr = float(atr_vals[-1]) if len(atr_vals) > 0 else 0.0

            if np.isnan(latest_atr) or latest_atr <= 0:
                logger.warning(f"[S07] {symbol} â€” NaN or zero ATR")
                return None

            # â”€â”€ 4. Bollinger Bands & ATR Distance Stretch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("bb_upper", "bb_middle", "bb_lower")):
                latest_upper  = float(precomputed_indicators["bb_upper"])
                latest_middle = float(precomputed_indicators["bb_middle"])
                latest_lower  = float(precomputed_indicators["bb_lower"])
            else:
                upper, middle, lower = ind.BBANDS(
                    close,
                    timeperiod=self.BB_PERIOD,
                    nbdevup=self.BB_STD,
                    nbdevdn=self.BB_STD,
                )
                latest_upper  = float(upper[-1])
                latest_middle = float(middle[-1])
                latest_lower  = float(lower[-1])

            bb_range = latest_upper - latest_lower
            bb_pct = round((latest_close - latest_lower) / (bb_range + 1e-10) * 100.0, 1)

            # Measure upward distance stretch from 20-period baseline in ATR units
            mean_dist = (latest_close - latest_middle) / latest_atr

            if latest_close >= latest_upper or mean_dist >= self.ATR_STRETCH_MULT:
                score += 25
                reasons.append(f"Statistical volatility stretch confirmed (BB%: {bb_pct}%, Stretch: {mean_dist:.1f} ATR)")
            elif latest_close >= latest_middle:
                score += 12
                reasons.append(f"Price above 20-day mean (BB%: {bb_pct}%)")
            else:
                reasons.append("Price below 20-day mean")

            # â”€â”€ 5. Buying Climax Volume Flow Surge â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "rvol" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rvol = float(precomputed_indicators["rvol"])
            else:
                rvol_arr = ind.RVOL(volume, timeperiod=self.VOLUME_PERIOD) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.ones_like(close)
                latest_rvol = float(rvol_arr[-1]) if len(rvol_arr) > 0 else 1.0

            if precomputed_indicators and "cmf" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_cmf = float(precomputed_indicators["cmf"])
            else:
                cmf_arr = ind.CMF(high, low, close, volume, timeperiod=20) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.zeros_like(close)
                latest_cmf = float(cmf_arr[-1]) if len(cmf_arr) > 0 else 0.0

            if latest_rvol >= self.VOLUME_SPIKE or latest_cmf < 0.0:
                score += 25
                reasons.append(f"Buying climax volume surge (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x >= {self.VOLUME_SPIKE:.2f}x, CMF: {latest_cmf:.2f})")
            elif latest_rvol >= 1.0:
                score += 12
                reasons.append(f"Standard volume confirmed (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")
            else:
                reasons.append(f"Low volume rally (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")

            # â”€â”€ 6. Bearish Price Action Rejection Trigger â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            latest_open = float(open_[-1])
            latest_high = float(high[-1])
            latest_low  = float(low[-1])
            body = abs(latest_close - latest_open)
            upper_shadow = latest_high - max(latest_open, latest_close)

            shooting_star = ind.CDLSHOOTINGSTAR(open_, high, low, close)
            evening_star  = ind.CDLEVENINGSTAR(open_, high, low, close)
            engulfing     = ind.CDLENGULFING(open_, high, low, close)
            doji          = ind.CDLDOJI(open_, high, low, close)

            candle_pattern = "NONE"
            if upper_shadow >= 2.0 * (body + 1e-5) and latest_rvol >= 1.30:
                score += 25
                candle_pattern = "WYCKOFF_UPTHRUST"
                reasons.append("Wyckoff Upthrust rejection at resistance confirmed")
            elif shooting_star[-1] != 0:
                score += 20
                candle_pattern = "SHOOTING_STAR"
                reasons.append("Bearish Shooting Star rejection candle confirmed")
            elif evening_star[-1] != 0:
                score += 20
                candle_pattern = "EVENING_STAR"
                reasons.append("Bearish Evening Star reversal confirmed")
            elif engulfing[-1] < 0:
                score += 20
                candle_pattern = "BEARISH_ENGULFING"
                reasons.append("Bearish Engulfing reversal confirmed")
            elif doji[-1] != 0:
                score += 15
                candle_pattern = "DOJI"
                reasons.append("Indecision Doji candle at highs")
            elif upper_shadow >= 1.5 * (body + 1e-5) or latest_close < latest_open:
                score += 15
                candle_pattern = "BEARISH_REJECTION"
                reasons.append("Bearish upper wick rejection confirmed")
            else:
                reasons.append("No rejection candlestick confirmation")

            # â”€â”€ 7. Overhead 50-EMA Resistance Retest Kiss â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "ema_mid" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_ema50 = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_mid"])
            else:
                ema50 = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_MID)
                latest_ema50 = float(ema50[-1]) if len(ema50) > 0 else float("nan")

            if not np.isnan(latest_ema50) and (abs(latest_high - latest_ema50) <= (0.75 * latest_atr) or (latest_high >= latest_ema50 and latest_close < latest_ema50)):
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Overhead EMA50 resistance retest kiss confirmed (EMA50: {latest_ema50:.2f})")

            # â”€â”€ 8. Consecutive Up-Days Exhaustion Bonus â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            consecutive_up = 0
            for i in range(len(close) - 2, max(0, len(close) - 7), -1):
                if close[i] > close[i - 1]:
                    consecutive_up += 1
                else:
                    break

            if consecutive_up >= self.CONSECUTIVE_UP_DAYS:
                score += 10
                reasons.append(f"Rally exhaustion bonus ({consecutive_up} consecutive green days)")

            # â”€â”€ 9. Multi-Timeframe Filter (HTF Trend Alignment) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if higher_tf_df is not None and len(higher_tf_df) >= 50:
                htf_close = np.asarray(higher_tf_df["Close"], dtype=float)
                htf_ema50 = ind.EMA(htf_close, timeperiod=50)
                if htf_close[-1] > htf_ema50[-1]:
                    score = max(0, score - 15)
                    reasons.append("Higher timeframe (Daily) EMA50 bull trend penalty applied")

            # â”€â”€ Score Gate Check â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            final_score = min(100.0, float(score))
            if final_score < self.MIN_SCORE:
                return None

            # Calculate nearest round strike for Put Options
            strike_step = 50.0 if latest_close > 500 else (20.0 if latest_close > 200 else 10.0)
            suggested_strike = round(latest_close / strike_step) * strike_step

            # â”€â”€ Construct Strongly Typed Result Contract â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            return StrategySignalResult(
                strategy_id=self.name,
                strategy_version=self.version,
                symbol=symbol,
                signal_direction="SHORT",
                signal_type="SELL",
                technical_score=final_score,
                confidence=final_score,
                reasons=reasons,
                entry_price=round(latest_close, 2),
                timeframe=self.timeframe,
                asset_class=self.asset_class,
                atr=round(latest_atr, 4),
                option_type="PE",
                strike_price=suggested_strike,
                candle_pattern=candle_pattern,
                indicator_values={
                    "rsi": round(latest_rsi, 2),
                    "rsi_fast": round(latest_rsi_fast, 2) if not np.isnan(latest_rsi_fast) else 0.0,
                    "atr": round(latest_atr, 4),
                    "rvol": round(latest_rvol, 2),
                    "cmf": round(latest_cmf, 4),
                    "bb_pct": bb_pct,
                    "ema_mid": round(latest_ema50, 2) if not np.isnan(latest_ema50) else 0.0,
                    "ema_long": round(latest_ema200, 2),
                },
                extra_metadata={
                    "vix": round(float(vix), 2),
                    "market_state": market_state,
                    "mqi_level": mqi_level,
                    "consecutive_up_days": consecutive_up,
                    "min_holding_days": self.min_holding_days,
                    "max_holding_days": self.max_holding_days,
                },
            )

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[S07] generate_signal exception for {symbol}: {e}")
            return None

    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """All S07 parameters for MLflow experiment tracking."""
        return {
            "strategy_id":            self.name,
            "version":                self.version,
            "rsi_period":             self.RSI_PERIOD,
            "rsi_fast_period":        self.RSI_FAST_PERIOD,
            "rsi_overbought_deep":    self.RSI_OVERBOUGHT_DEEP,
            "rsi_overbought_min":     self.RSI_OVERBOUGHT_MIN,
            "rsi_fast_overbought":    self.RSI_FAST_OVERBOUGHT,
            "bb_period":              self.BB_PERIOD,
            "bb_std":                 self.BB_STD,
            "volume_period":          self.VOLUME_PERIOD,
            "volume_spike":           self.VOLUME_SPIKE,
            "ema_mid":                self.EMA_MID,
            "ema_long":               self.EMA_LONG,
            "atr_period":             self.ATR_PERIOD,
            "atr_stretch_mult":       self.ATR_STRETCH_MULT,
            "consecutive_up_days":    self.CONSECUTIVE_UP_DAYS,
            "min_score":              self.MIN_SCORE,
            "timeframe":              self.timeframe,
            "asset_class":            self.asset_class,
            "allowed_asset_classes":  list(self.allowed_asset_classes),
            "allowed_regimes":        list(self.allowed_regimes),
            "min_holding_days":       self.min_holding_days,
            "max_holding_days":       self.max_holding_days,
        }

    def get_description(self) -> str:
        """Human-readable description for alerts and research reports."""
        return (
            f"S07 Mean Reversion Short v{self.version} â€” "
            f"Overbought relief rally fade in secular downtrend: Dual RSI (RSI14>={self.RSI_OVERBOUGHT_MIN:.0f} / RSI2>={self.RSI_FAST_OVERBOUGHT:.0f}), "
            f"at BB upper or >={self.ATR_STRETCH_MULT}x ATR stretch, EMA50 resistance kiss, "
            f"buying climax volume spike >={self.VOLUME_SPIKE:.2f}x, "
            f"below EMA{self.EMA_LONG}. Min score {self.MIN_SCORE}/100. Swing trades {self.min_holding_days}-{self.max_holding_days} days."
        )


FILE: mjonai-build\strategy\registry\momentum_rsi.py

"""
Module: strategy/registry/momentum_rsi.py
Purpose: S01 â€” SOTA Institutional Multi-Asset Momentum RSI Strategy.
         Finds genuine institutional momentum through 6 confirmation pillars:
         1. RSI Bullish Zone (55-70) or Power Trend Acceleration (70-80 with strong ADX)
         2. MACD Positive Momentum (Histogram > 0 & Expanding)
         3. Triple EMA Trend Alignment (EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200)
         4. Trend Strength & Direction (ADX > 20 & +DI > -DI / Supertrend Support)
         5. Institutional Volume Flow (RVOL >= 1.2 or CMF > 0)
         6. Trigger Candlestick Patterns (Hammer, Engulfing, Marubozu, Morning Star)

Inherits from BaseStrategy with full multi-asset, multi-timeframe, and precomputed indicator support.
"""

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Union
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from strategy.registry.base import BaseStrategy, StrategySignalResult
from strategy.registry import indicators as ind

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MomentumRSI(BaseStrategy):
    """
    S01 â€” Momentum RSI Strategy.
    
    Research targets:
        Win rate > 55%
        Best regime: BULL + HIGH MQI
        Worst regime: BEAR / High VIX
        IC target: > 0.05 (Alphalens)
    """

    name: str                        = "S01_MomentumRSI"
    display_name: str                = "Momentum RSI"
    timeframe: str                   = "SWING"
    asset_class: str                 = "EQUITY"
    version: str                     = "2.1"
    is_active: bool                  = True
    allowed_asset_classes: Sequence[str] = ("EQUITY", "INDEX", "COMMODITY", "CRYPTO", "FOREX")
    allowed_regimes: Sequence[str]   = ("BULL", "NEUTRAL", "SIDEWAYS")
    min_candles_required: int        = 210
    min_holding_days: int            = 3
    max_holding_days: int            = 10

    # â”€â”€ Parameters (Logged to MLflow / Optuna tunable) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    RSI_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    RSI_MIN: float                   = 55.0
    RSI_MAX: float                   = 70.0
    RSI_POWER_MAX: float             = 80.0

    MACD_FAST: int                   = 12
    MACD_SLOW: int                   = 26
    MACD_SIGNAL: int                 = 9

    EMA_SHORT: int                   = 20
    EMA_MID: int                     = 50
    EMA_LONG: int                    = 200

    ADX_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    ADX_MIN_STRENGTH: float          = 20.0
    ADX_POWER_STRENGTH: float        = 28.0

    ATR_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    SUPERTREND_MULTIPLIER: float      = 3.0

    RVOL_PERIOD: int                 = 20
    RVOL_MIN_THRESHOLD: float        = 1.2

    MIN_SCORE: int                   = 65

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,
        vix: float,
        market_state: str,
        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:
        """
        Generate S01 Momentum RSI signal for given symbol and market conditions.
        """
        try:
            # 1. Validate DataFrame minimum history
            is_valid, reason = self.validate_ohlcv_dataframe(df, min_candles=self.min_candles_required)
            if not is_valid:
                logger.warning(f"[S01] {symbol} â€” {reason}")
                return None

            close  = np.asarray(df["Close"], dtype=float)
            high   = np.asarray(df["High"], dtype=float)
            low    = np.asarray(df["Low"], dtype=float)
            open_  = np.asarray(df["Open"], dtype=float)
            volume = np.asarray(df["Volume"], dtype=float) if "Volume" in df.columns else np.zeros_like(close)

            score: int = 0
            reasons: List[str] = []

            # â”€â”€ 1. Trend Strength (ADX & Directional Movement) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("adx", "plus_di", "minus_di")):
                latest_adx     = float(precomputed_indicators["adx"])
                latest_plus_di = float(precomputed_indicators["plus_di"])
                latest_minus_di= float(precomputed_indicators["minus_di"])
            else:
                adx_vals = ind.ADX(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                p_di     = ind.PLUS_DI(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                m_di     = ind.MINUS_DI(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                latest_adx      = float(adx_vals[-1]) if len(adx_vals) > 0 else 0.0
                latest_plus_di  = float(p_di[-1]) if len(p_di) > 0 else 0.0
                latest_minus_di = float(m_di[-1]) if len(m_di) > 0 else 0.0

            # â”€â”€ 2. RSI â€” Bullish Zone [55, 70] or Power Trend [70, 80] â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "rsi" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rsi = float(precomputed_indicators["rsi"])
            else:
                rsi = ind.RSI(close, timeperiod=self.RSI_PERIOD)
                latest_rsi = float(rsi[-1]) if len(rsi) > 0 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(latest_rsi):
                logger.warning(f"[S01] {symbol} â€” RSI calculation returned NaN")
                return None

            if self.RSI_MIN <= latest_rsi <= self.RSI_MAX:
                score += 20
                reasons.append(f"RSI in optimal bullish momentum zone ({latest_rsi:.1f})")
            elif self.RSI_MAX < latest_rsi <= self.RSI_POWER_MAX and latest_adx >= self.ADX_POWER_STRENGTH:
                # Power trend acceleration mode
                score += 20
                reasons.append(f"RSI in Power Trend zone ({latest_rsi:.1f}) confirmed by high ADX ({latest_adx:.1f})")
            else:
                reasons.append(f"RSI out of zone ({latest_rsi:.1f})")

            # â”€â”€ 3. MACD â€” Bullish Momentum (Histogram > 0 & Expanding) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "macd_hist" in precomputed_indicators and "macd_hist_prev" in precomputed_indicators:
                hist_curr = float(precomputed_indicators["macd_hist"])
                hist_prev = float(precomputed_indicators["macd_hist_prev"])
            else:
                _, _, hist = ind.MACD(
                    close,
                    fastperiod=self.MACD_FAST,
                    slowperiod=self.MACD_SLOW,
                    signalperiod=self.MACD_SIGNAL,
                )
                hist_curr = float(hist[-1]) if len(hist) > 0 else float("nan")
                hist_prev = float(hist[-2]) if len(hist) > 1 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(hist_curr) or np.isnan(hist_prev):
                logger.warning(f"[S01] {symbol} â€” MACD histogram is NaN")
                return None

            if hist_curr > 0.0 and hist_curr > hist_prev:
                score += 20
                reasons.append("MACD histogram positive and accelerating")
            elif hist_curr > 0.0:
                score += 10
                reasons.append("MACD positive baseline")
            else:
                reasons.append("MACD momentum not confirmed")

            # â”€â”€ 4. EMA Triple Alignment (EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("ema_short", "ema_mid", "ema_long")):
                ema_s = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_short"])
                ema_m = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_mid"])
                ema_l = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_long"])
            else:
                ema_short = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_SHORT)
                ema_mid   = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_MID)
                ema_long  = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_LONG)
                ema_s = float(ema_short[-1])
                ema_m = float(ema_mid[-1])
                ema_l = float(ema_long[-1])

            # â”€â”€ HARD SENTRY 1: ADX Chop Rule (No momentum in completely dead markets)
            if latest_adx < 15.0:
                # Dead sideways chop â€” momentum strategies must not enter
                return None

            # â”€â”€ HARD SENTRY 2: Macro 200-EMA Rule (Cannot buy in secular downtrend)
            latest_close = float(close[-1])
            if latest_close < ema_l:
                # Secular downtrend â€” immediate hard rejection
                return None

            if ema_s > ema_m > ema_l:
                score += 20
                reasons.append(f"Triple EMA aligned (EMA{self.EMA_SHORT} > EMA{self.EMA_MID} > EMA{self.EMA_LONG})")
            elif ema_s > ema_m and latest_close > ema_l:
                score += 10
                reasons.append("Price above EMA200 with Short > Mid EMA")
            else:
                reasons.append("EMAs not bullishly aligned")

            # â”€â”€ 5. Trend Strength & Supertrend Support â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "supertrend_line" in precomputed_indicators and "supertrend_dir" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_st = float(precomputed_indicators["supertrend_line"])
                st_dir    = int(precomputed_indicators["supertrend_dir"])
            else:
                st_line, st_trend = ind.supertrend(
                    high, low, close,
                    period=self.ATR_PERIOD,
                    multiplier=self.SUPERTREND_MULTIPLIER,
                )
                latest_st = float(st_line[-1])
                st_dir    = int(st_trend[-1])

            latest_close = float(close[-1])
            is_supertrend_bull = (st_dir == 1 or latest_close > latest_st)
            is_adx_bull = (latest_adx >= self.ADX_MIN_STRENGTH and latest_plus_di > latest_minus_di)

            if is_supertrend_bull and is_adx_bull:
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Supertrend support active + Strong ADX trend ({latest_adx:.1f})")
            elif is_supertrend_bull or is_adx_bull:
                score += 8
                reasons.append("Partial trend strength confirmed")
            else:
                reasons.append("Trend strength filter not met")

            # â”€â”€ 6. Institutional Volume Flow Surge â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "rvol" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rvol = float(precomputed_indicators["rvol"])
            else:
                rvol_arr = ind.RVOL(volume, timeperiod=self.RVOL_PERIOD) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.ones_like(close)
                latest_rvol = float(rvol_arr[-1]) if len(rvol_arr) > 0 else 1.0

            if precomputed_indicators and "cmf" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_cmf = float(precomputed_indicators["cmf"])
            else:
                cmf_arr = ind.CMF(high, low, close, volume, timeperiod=20) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.zeros_like(close)
                latest_cmf = float(cmf_arr[-1]) if len(cmf_arr) > 0 else 0.0

            if latest_rvol >= self.RVOL_MIN_THRESHOLD or latest_cmf > 0.05:
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Institutional volume surge (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x, CMF: {latest_cmf:.2f})")
            elif latest_rvol >= 1.0:
                score += 8
                reasons.append(f"Average volume confirmed (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")
            else:
                reasons.append(f"Sub-par volume (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")

            # â”€â”€ 7. Candlestick Confirmation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            hammer    = ind.CDLHAMMER(open_, high, low, close)
            engulfing = ind.CDLENGULFING(open_, high, low, close)
            marubozu  = ind.CDLMARUBOZU(open_, high, low, close)
            m_star    = ind.CDLMORNINGSTAR(open_, high, low, close)

            candle_pattern = "NONE"
            if hammer[-1] != 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "HAMMER"
                reasons.append("Bullish Hammer candle confirmed")
            elif engulfing[-1] > 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "BULLISH_ENGULFING"
                reasons.append("Bullish Engulfing candle confirmed")
            elif marubozu[-1] > 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "MARUBOZU"
                reasons.append("Bullish Marubozu momentum candle confirmed")
            elif m_star[-1] > 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "MORNING_STAR"
                reasons.append("Bullish Morning Star reversal confirmed")
            elif latest_close > float(high[-2]):
                score += 5
                candle_pattern = "BREAKOUT_BAR"
                reasons.append("Bullish Breakout close above prior bar high")
            else:
                reasons.append("No confirmation candlestick pattern")

            # â”€â”€ 8. Multi-Timeframe Filter (Higher Timeframe Trend Confirmation)
            if higher_tf_df is not None and len(higher_tf_df) >= 50:
                htf_close = np.asarray(higher_tf_df["Close"], dtype=float)
                htf_ema50 = ind.EMA(htf_close, timeperiod=50)
                if htf_close[-1] < htf_ema50[-1]:
                    # Higher timeframe is in a downtrend â€” penalty
                    score = max(0, score - 15)
                    reasons.append("Higher timeframe (Daily) EMA50 resistance penalty applied")

            # â”€â”€ Score Gate Check â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            final_score = min(100.0, float(score))
            if final_score < self.MIN_SCORE:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ ATR for Sizing & Risk Management â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "atr" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_atr = float(precomputed_indicators["atr"])
            else:
                atr_vals = ind.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ATR_PERIOD)
                latest_atr = float(atr_vals[-1])

            # â”€â”€ Construct Strongly Typed Result Contract â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            return StrategySignalResult(
                strategy_id=self.name,
                strategy_version=self.version,
                symbol=symbol,
                signal_direction="LONG",
                signal_type="BUY",
                technical_score=final_score,
                confidence=final_score,
                reasons=reasons,
                entry_price=round(latest_close, 2),
                timeframe=self.timeframe,
                asset_class=self.asset_class,
                atr=round(latest_atr, 4),
                candle_pattern=candle_pattern,
                indicator_values={
                    "rsi": round(latest_rsi, 2),
                    "adx": round(latest_adx, 2),
                    "atr": round(latest_atr, 4),
                    "rvol": round(latest_rvol, 2),
                    "cmf": round(latest_cmf, 4),
                    "ema_short": round(ema_s, 2),
                    "ema_mid": round(ema_m, 2),
                    "ema_long": round(ema_l, 2),
                    "supertrend": round(latest_st, 2),
                },
                extra_metadata={
                    "vix": round(float(vix), 2),
                    "market_state": market_state,
                    "mqi_level": mqi_level,
                    "min_holding_days": self.min_holding_days,
                    "max_holding_days": self.max_holding_days,
                },
            )

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[S01] generate_signal exception for {symbol}: {e}")
            return None

    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """All S01 parameters for MLflow/Optuna experiment tracking."""
        return {
            "strategy_id":            self.name,
            "version":                self.version,
            "rsi_period":             self.RSI_PERIOD,
            "rsi_min":                self.RSI_MIN,
            "rsi_max":                self.RSI_MAX,
            "rsi_power_max":          self.RSI_POWER_MAX,
            "macd_fast":              self.MACD_FAST,
            "macd_slow":              self.MACD_SLOW,
            "macd_signal":            self.MACD_SIGNAL,
            "ema_short":              self.EMA_SHORT,
            "ema_mid":                self.EMA_MID,
            "ema_long":               self.EMA_LONG,
            "adx_period":             self.ADX_PERIOD,
            "adx_min_strength":       self.ADX_MIN_STRENGTH,
            "atr_period":             self.ATR_PERIOD,
            "supertrend_multiplier":  self.SUPERTREND_MULTIPLIER,
            "rvol_period":            self.RVOL_PERIOD,
            "rvol_min_threshold":     self.RVOL_MIN_THRESHOLD,
            "min_score":              self.MIN_SCORE,
            "timeframe":              self.timeframe,
            "asset_class":            self.asset_class,
            "allowed_asset_classes":  list(self.allowed_asset_classes),
            "allowed_regimes":        list(self.allowed_regimes),
            "min_holding_days":       self.min_holding_days,
            "max_holding_days":       self.max_holding_days,
        }

    def get_description(self) -> str:
        """Human-readable description for alerts and research reports."""
        return (
            f"S01 Momentum RSI v{self.version} â€” "
            f"Institutional swing momentum: RSI {self.RSI_MIN:.0f}-{self.RSI_MAX:.0f} (Power up to {self.RSI_POWER_MAX:.0f}), "
            f"MACD acceleration, Triple EMA ({self.EMA_SHORT}/{self.EMA_MID}/{self.EMA_LONG}), "
            f"ADX>{self.ADX_MIN_STRENGTH:.0f} + Supertrend support, RVOL>{self.RVOL_MIN_THRESHOLD:.1f}x surge, "
            f"Candlestick trigger. Min score {self.MIN_SCORE}/100. Holding window: {self.min_holding_days}-{self.max_holding_days} days."
        )

"""
Module: strategy/registry/momentum_short.py
Purpose: S06 â€” SOTA Institutional Multi-Asset Momentum Short Strategy.
         Captures high-velocity downward momentum, structural breakdowns, and short continuation in secular downtrends.
         Combines RSI Bearish Momentum Zone (30-45), MACD Negative Acceleration, Triple EMA Bearish Stacking,
         ADX Trend Velocity (-DI > +DI), Donchian 20-Day Low Structural Breakdown,
         Institutional Distribution Flow (RVOL & CMF), and Bearish Candlestick Triggers.

Pillars of Scoring (Total: 100 Points, Minimum Gate: 65 Points):
  â€¢ HARD SENTRY 1: Price MUST be below EMA200 (Secular Macro Downtrend)
  â€¢ HARD SENTRY 2: ADX >= 15.0 (No shorting in completely flat/dead chop)
  â€¢ HARD SENTRY 3: RSI(14) >= 25.0 (Prevents shorting into deep oversold capitulation bottoms)
  1. RSI Bearish Momentum Zone (30-45 or 25-30 Power Breakdown):        +20 Pts
  2. MACD Bearish Acceleration (Histogram < 0 & Declining):            +20 Pts
  3. Triple EMA Bearish Stack (EMA20 < EMA50 < EMA200):                 +20 Pts
  4. Trend Velocity & Supertrend Resistance (ADX >= 20 & -DI > +DI):    +15 Pts
  5. Institutional Distribution Flow (RVOL >= 1.20x or CMF < -0.05):     +15 Pts
  6. Bearish Candlestick Pattern Trigger (Shooting Star, Evening Star): +10 Pts
  * Bonus (+10 Pts): 20-Day Donchian Low Structural Breakdown

Inherits from BaseStrategy with full multi-asset, multi-timeframe, and precomputed indicator support.
"""

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Union
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from strategy.registry.base import BaseStrategy, StrategySignalResult
from strategy.registry import indicators as ind

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class MomentumShort(BaseStrategy):
    """
    S06 â€” Momentum Short Strategy.

    Research targets:
        Win rate > 52% (Fast asymmetric downside velocity)
        Best regime: BEAR / NEUTRAL breakdown
        Worst regime: BULL market strong uptrends (Short squeeze risk)
        IC target: > 0.05 (Alphalens)
    """

    name: str                        = "S06_MomentumShort"
    display_name: str                = "Momentum Short"
    timeframe: str                   = "SWING"
    asset_class: str                 = "EQUITY"
    version: str                     = "2.2"
    is_active: bool                  = True
    allowed_asset_classes: Sequence[str] = ("EQUITY", "INDEX", "COMMODITY", "CRYPTO", "FOREX")
    allowed_regimes: Sequence[str]   = ("BEAR", "NEUTRAL", "SIDEWAYS")
    min_candles_required: int        = 210
    min_holding_days: int            = 3
    max_holding_days: int            = 10

    # â”€â”€ Parameters (Logged to MLflow / Optuna tunable) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    RSI_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    RSI_MIN: float                   = 30.0     # Normal bearish momentum floor
    RSI_MAX: float                   = 45.0     # Bearish momentum ceiling
    RSI_POWER_MIN: float             = 25.0     # Power breakdown floor with high ADX
    RSI_HARD_FLOOR: float            = 25.0     # Absolute floor (no shorting below 25)

    MACD_FAST: int                   = 12
    MACD_SLOW: int                   = 26
    MACD_SIGNAL: int                 = 9

    EMA_SHORT: int                   = 20
    EMA_MID: int                     = 50
    EMA_LONG: int                    = 200

    ADX_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    ADX_MIN_STRENGTH: float          = 20.0
    ADX_POWER_STRENGTH: float        = 28.0

    ATR_PERIOD: int                  = 14
    SUPERTREND_MULTIPLIER: float      = 3.0

    RVOL_PERIOD: int                 = 20
    RVOL_MIN_THRESHOLD: float        = 1.20
    VOLUME_PERIOD: int               = 20
    VOLUME_CONFIRM: float            = 1.20
    BREAKDOWN_LOOKBACK: int          = 20       # Donchian breakdown lookback

    MIN_SCORE: int                   = 65       # Minimum technical score

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,
        vix: float,
        market_state: str,
        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:
        """
        Generate S06 Momentum Short signal for given symbol and market conditions.
        """
        try:
            # 1. Validate DataFrame minimum history
            is_valid, reason = self.validate_ohlcv_dataframe(df, min_candles=self.min_candles_required)
            if not is_valid:
                logger.warning(f"[S06] {symbol} â€” {reason}")
                return None

            close  = np.asarray(df["Close"], dtype=float)
            high   = np.asarray(df["High"], dtype=float)
            low    = np.asarray(df["Low"], dtype=float)
            open_  = np.asarray(df["Open"], dtype=float)
            volume = np.asarray(df["Volume"], dtype=float) if "Volume" in df.columns else np.zeros_like(close)

            score: int = 0
            reasons: List[str] = []

            # â”€â”€ 1. Trend Strength (ADX & Directional Movement) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("adx", "plus_di", "minus_di")):
                latest_adx      = float(precomputed_indicators["adx"])
                latest_plus_di  = float(precomputed_indicators["plus_di"])
                latest_minus_di = float(precomputed_indicators["minus_di"])
            else:
                adx_vals = ind.ADX(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                p_di     = ind.PLUS_DI(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                m_di     = ind.MINUS_DI(high, low, close, timeperiod=self.ADX_PERIOD)
                latest_adx      = float(adx_vals[-1]) if len(adx_vals) > 0 else 0.0
                latest_plus_di  = float(p_di[-1]) if len(p_di) > 0 else 0.0
                latest_minus_di = float(m_di[-1]) if len(m_di) > 0 else 0.0

            # HARD SENTRY 1: No shorting in completely flat/dead chop
            if latest_adx < 15.0:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ 2. EMA Long Macro Trend Sentry (HARD SENTRY 2) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and all(k in precomputed_indicators for k in ("ema_short", "ema_mid", "ema_long")):
                ema_s = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_short"])
                ema_m = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_mid"])
                ema_l = float(precomputed_indicators["ema_long"])
            else:
                ema_short = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_SHORT)
                ema_mid   = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_MID)
                ema_long  = ind.EMA(close, timeperiod=self.EMA_LONG)
                ema_s = float(ema_short[-1])
                ema_m = float(ema_mid[-1])
                ema_l = float(ema_long[-1])

            if np.isnan(ema_s) or np.isnan(ema_m) or np.isnan(ema_l):
                logger.warning(f"[S06] {symbol} â€” EMA values contain NaN")
                return None

            latest_close = float(close[-1])
            if np.isnan(latest_close) or latest_close <= 0:
                logger.warning(f"[S06] {symbol} â€” latest_close is NaN or non-positive")
                return None

            # HARD SENTRY: Cannot short stocks trading in a secular bull market above 200 EMA
            if latest_close >= ema_l:
                return None

            # â”€â”€ 3. RSI Bearish Momentum Zone (HARD SENTRY 3) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "rsi" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rsi = float(precomputed_indicators["rsi"])
            else:
                rsi = ind.RSI(close, timeperiod=self.RSI_PERIOD)
                latest_rsi = float(rsi[-1]) if len(rsi) > 0 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(latest_rsi):
                logger.warning(f"[S06] {symbol} â€” RSI is NaN")
                return None

            # HARD SENTRY: Prevents shorting at deep oversold bottoms (capitulation climax)
            if latest_rsi < self.RSI_HARD_FLOOR:
                return None

            if self.RSI_MIN <= latest_rsi <= self.RSI_MAX:
                score += 20
                reasons.append(f"RSI in optimal bearish momentum zone ({latest_rsi:.1f})")
            elif self.RSI_POWER_MIN <= latest_rsi < self.RSI_MIN and latest_adx >= self.ADX_POWER_STRENGTH:
                score += 20
                reasons.append(f"RSI in Power Breakdown zone ({latest_rsi:.1f}) confirmed by high ADX ({latest_adx:.1f})")
            else:
                reasons.append(f"RSI out of bearish zone ({latest_rsi:.1f})")

            # â”€â”€ 4. MACD Bearish Acceleration (Histogram < 0 & Declining) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "macd_hist" in precomputed_indicators and "macd_hist_prev" in precomputed_indicators:
                hist_curr = float(precomputed_indicators["macd_hist"])
                hist_prev = float(precomputed_indicators["macd_hist_prev"])
            else:
                _, _, hist = ind.MACD(
                    close,
                    fastperiod=self.MACD_FAST,
                    slowperiod=self.MACD_SLOW,
                    signalperiod=self.MACD_SIGNAL,
                )
                hist_curr = float(hist[-1]) if len(hist) > 0 else float("nan")
                hist_prev = float(hist[-2]) if len(hist) > 1 else float("nan")

            if np.isnan(hist_curr) or np.isnan(hist_prev):
                logger.warning(f"[S06] {symbol} â€” MACD is NaN")
                return None

            if hist_curr < 0.0 and hist_curr < hist_prev:
                score += 20
                reasons.append("MACD histogram negative and accelerating downwards")
            elif hist_curr < 0.0:
                score += 10
                reasons.append("MACD negative baseline")
            else:
                reasons.append("MACD momentum not bearish")

            # â”€â”€ 5. EMA Alignment (EMA20 < EMA50 < EMA200) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if ema_s < ema_m < ema_l:
                score += 20
                reasons.append(f"Triple EMA aligned down (EMA{self.EMA_SHORT} < EMA{self.EMA_MID} < EMA{self.EMA_LONG})")
            elif ema_s < ema_m and latest_close < ema_l:
                score += 10
                reasons.append("Price below EMA200 with Short < Mid EMA")
            else:
                reasons.append("EMAs not bearishly aligned")

            # â”€â”€ 6. Trend Velocity & Supertrend Resistance â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "supertrend_line" in precomputed_indicators and "supertrend_dir" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_st = float(precomputed_indicators["supertrend_line"])
                st_dir    = int(precomputed_indicators["supertrend_dir"])
            else:
                st_line, st_trend = ind.supertrend(
                    high, low, close,
                    period=self.ATR_PERIOD,
                    multiplier=self.SUPERTREND_MULTIPLIER,
                )
                latest_st = float(st_line[-1])
                st_dir    = int(st_trend[-1])

            is_supertrend_bear = (st_dir == -1 or latest_close < latest_st)
            is_adx_bear = (latest_adx >= self.ADX_MIN_STRENGTH and latest_minus_di > latest_plus_di)

            if is_supertrend_bear and is_adx_bear:
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Supertrend overhead resistance + Strong ADX downside velocity ({latest_adx:.1f})")
            elif is_supertrend_bear or is_adx_bear:
                score += 8
                reasons.append("Partial bearish trend velocity confirmed")
            else:
                reasons.append("Trend velocity filter not met")

            # â”€â”€ 7. Institutional Distribution Volume Flow Surge â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if precomputed_indicators and "rvol" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_rvol = float(precomputed_indicators["rvol"])
            else:
                rvol_arr = ind.RVOL(volume, timeperiod=self.VOLUME_PERIOD) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.ones_like(close)
                latest_rvol = float(rvol_arr[-1]) if len(rvol_arr) > 0 else 1.0

            if precomputed_indicators and "cmf" in precomputed_indicators:
                latest_cmf = float(precomputed_indicators["cmf"])
            else:
                cmf_arr = ind.CMF(high, low, close, volume, timeperiod=20) if np.sum(volume) > 0 else np.zeros_like(close)
                latest_cmf = float(cmf_arr[-1]) if len(cmf_arr) > 0 else 0.0

            if latest_rvol >= self.RVOL_MIN_THRESHOLD or latest_cmf < -0.05:
                score += 15
                reasons.append(f"Institutional distribution surge (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x, CMF: {latest_cmf:.2f})")
            elif latest_rvol >= 1.0:
                score += 8
                reasons.append(f"Average volume confirmed (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")
            else:
                reasons.append(f"Sub-par volume (RVOL: {latest_rvol:.2f}x)")

            # â”€â”€ 8. Bearish Candlestick Pattern Confirmation â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            shooting_star = ind.CDLSHOOTINGSTAR(open_, high, low, close)
            evening_star  = ind.CDLEVENINGSTAR(open_, high, low, close)
            engulfing     = ind.CDLENGULFING(open_, high, low, close)
            marubozu      = ind.CDLMARUBOZU(open_, high, low, close)

            candle_pattern = "NONE"
            if shooting_star[-1] != 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "SHOOTING_STAR"
                reasons.append("Bearish Shooting Star candle confirmed")
            elif evening_star[-1] != 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "EVENING_STAR"
                reasons.append("Bearish Evening Star reversal confirmed")
            elif engulfing[-1] < 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "BEARISH_ENGULFING"
                reasons.append("Bearish Engulfing breakdown candle confirmed")
            elif marubozu[-1] < 0:
                score += 10
                candle_pattern = "BEARISH_MARUBOZU"
                reasons.append("Bearish Marubozu momentum breakdown confirmed")
            elif latest_close < float(low[-2]):
                score += 5
                candle_pattern = "BREAKDOWN_BAR"
                reasons.append("Breakdown close below prior bar low")
            else:
                reasons.append("No confirmation bearish candlestick pattern")

            # â”€â”€ 9. Donchian 20-Day Low Structural Breakdown Bonus â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            lookback_low_20 = float(np.min(low[-self.BREAKDOWN_LOOKBACK - 1 : -1]))
            if latest_close < lookback_low_20:
                score += 10
                reasons.append(f"20-day structural support breakdown (Below {lookback_low_20:.2f})")

            # â”€â”€ 10. Multi-Timeframe Check (HTF Filter) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if higher_tf_df is not None and len(higher_tf_df) >= 50:
                htf_close = np.asarray(higher_tf_df["Close"], dtype=float)
                htf_ema50 = ind.EMA(htf_close, timeperiod=50)
                if htf_close[-1] > htf_ema50[-1]:
                    # Higher timeframe is still bullish â€” penalty on shorting
                    score = max(0, score - 15)
                    reasons.append("Higher timeframe (Daily) EMA50 bull trend penalty applied")

            # â”€â”€ Score Gate Check â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            final_score = min(100.0, float(score))
            if final_score < self.MIN_SCORE:
                return None

            if precomputed_indicators and "atr" in precomputed_indicators:

"""

        """

        """
        try:

                return None

            bb_pct = (latest_close - bb_lower) / (bb_range + 1e-10)

            return StrategySignalResult(

                indicator_values={

                    "short_pe_strike": short_pe_strike,
