class DummyBullishStrategy(BaseStrategy):
    name = "S99_DummyBullish"
    display_name = "Dummy Bullish Test Strategy"
    version = "1.0"
    timeframe = "15m"
    asset_class = "EQUITY"
    signal_direction = "LONG"
    allowed_regimes = ("BULL", "NEUTRAL")
    min_candles_required = 10

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,
        vix: float,
        market_state: str,
        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:
        if vix > 30.0:
            return None
        return StrategySignalResult(
            strategy_id=self.name,
            strategy_version=self.version,
            symbol=symbol,
            signal_direction="LONG",
            signal_type="BUY",
            technical_score=85.0,
            confidence=78.0,
            reasons=["Dummy Momentum Breakout âœ“"],
            entry_price=100.0,
            swing_low=95.0,
            atr=2.5,
            adx=28.0,
            sl_method="STRUCTURE",
        )

    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {"min_vix": 10.0, "max_vix": 30.0}

    def get_description(self) -> str:
        return "Dummy strategy for unit testing BaseStrategy contract."


class CrashingStrategy(BaseStrategy):
    name = "S98_Crashing"
    display_name = "Crashing Strategy"
    version = "1.0"

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,

        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Optional[StrategySignalResult]:
        # Deliberately raise zero division error
        raise ZeroDivisionError("Deliberate test crash")

    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {}

    def get_description(self) -> str:
        return "Always crashes to test error boundary."

class DictReturningStrategy(BaseStrategy):
    name = "S97_DictStrategy"
    display_name = "Dict Returning Strategy"

    def generate_signal(
        self,
        df: pd.DataFrame,
        symbol: str,
        vix: float,
        market_state: str,
        mqi_level: str,
        higher_tf_df: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
        precomputed_indicators: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "strategy_id": self.name,
            "strategy_version": "1.0",
            "symbol": symbol,
            "signal_type": "BUY",
            "technical_score": 77.0,
            "confidence": 72.0,
            "reasons": ["Dict Breakout âœ“"],
            "entry_price": 500.0,
            "swing_low": 480.0,
            "lot_size": 10,
        }

    def get_parameters(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {}

    def get_description(self) -> str:
        return "Returns raw dict to test auto-conversion."


def test_execute_safe_auto_converts_dict(valid_ohlcv_df):
    """Verify raw dict returned by legacy strategy is auto-converted to StrategySignalResult."""

        df=valid_ohlcv_df,

        vix=15.0,

    assert res.lot_size == 10

        rvol=80.0,

        system_mode="LIVE",
    )
    assert res_high.is_approved is True
    assert res_high.confidence >= 80.0
    assert len(res_high.breakdown) == 10

    # Backward-compatible tuple return
    score, reason = calculate_confidence(technical=85.0, mtf=90.0, system_mode="LIVE")
    assert score is not None
    assert reason == "APPROVED"

    assert bear_lim.max_shorts == 4

    # Backward-compatible integer return
    assert get_dynamic_position_limit("BULL", "HIGH", 13.5) == 5


# â”€â”€ 5. BETA-WEIGHTED SECTOR CONCENTRATION TESTS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def test_beta_weighted_sector_limits():
    """Verify 18% cap on high-beta Realty/Metal vs 30% cap on FMCG."""
    # Candidate: DLF (Realty, 18% cap = â‚¹21,600 on â‚¹1,20,000 Growth pool)
    open_trades_realty = [
        {"symbol": "GODREJPROP", "entry_price": 2000.0, "quantity": 10},  # â‚¹20,000 used
    ]

    # Adding â‚¹10,000 DLF breaches â‚¹28,800 cap (â‚¹20,000 + â‚¹10,000 = â‚¹30,000 > â‚¹28,800)
    res_realty = evaluate_sector_limits(
        candidate_symbol="DLF",
        candidate_entry=1000.0,
        candidate_qty=10,
        open_trades=open_trades_realty,
    )
    assert res_realty.is_allowed is False
    assert "Sector capital" in res_realty.reason

    # Candidate: HINDUNILVR (FMCG, 30% cap = â‚¹36,000)
    open_trades_fmcg = [
        {"symbol": "ITC", "entry_price": 400.0, "quantity": 50},  # â‚¹20,000 used
    ]
    # Adding â‚¹10,000 HINDUNILVR passes (â‚¹20k + â‚¹10k = â‚¹30k <= â‚¹36k cap)
    res_fmcg = evaluate_sector_limits(
        candidate_symbol="HINDUNILVR",
        candidate_entry=2500.0,
        candidate_qty=4,
        open_trades=open_trades_fmcg,
    )
    assert res_fmcg.is_allowed is True

    # 2 Stocks already open in same sector -> blocked by stock count
    open_trades_2 = [
        {"symbol": "TCS", "entry_price": 3500.0, "quantity": 2},
        {"symbol": "INFY", "entry_price": 1500.0, "quantity": 5},
    ]
    res_it_count = evaluate_sector_limits(
        candidate_symbol="WIPRO",
        candidate_entry=500.0,
        candidate_qty=10,
        open_trades=open_trades_2,
    )
    assert res_it_count.is_allowed is False
    assert "Sector cap: 2/2" in res_it_count.reason

"""
Unit and Institutional Test Suite for Supervisor Agent (CIO Consensus Arbiter)
(agents/supervisor.py)
"""

import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

from agents.supervisor import (
    evaluate,
    _apply_decision_rules,
    _build_prompt,
    SupervisorEvaluationResult,
)
from agents.llm_bridge import LLMInferenceResult


def test_apply_decision_rules_approve_case():
    """Verify deterministic approval when all risk criteria and Bull analyst agree."""
    signal = {"symbol": "TCS", "risk_reward": 2.25}
    bull = {"verdict": "STRONG_BUY", "confidence": 76}
    checks = [f"Check {i}" for i in range(8)]

    decision, reason = _apply_decision_rules(signal, bull, checks)
    assert decision == "APPROVE"
    assert reason == ""


def test_apply_decision_rules_reject_cases():
    """Verify deterministic rejections on failed thresholds."""
    signal = {"symbol": "INFY", "risk_reward": 2.2}
    bull_neutral = {"verdict": "NEUTRAL", "confidence": 55}
    checks_8 = [f"Check {i}" for i in range(8)]

    # 1. Bull Neutral
    dec, rsn = _apply_decision_rules(signal, bull_neutral, checks_8)
    assert dec == "REJECT"
    assert "insufficient upside momentum" in rsn

    # 2. Insufficient Risk Reward
    signal_low_rr = {"symbol": "INFY", "risk_reward": 1.6}
    bull_buy = {"verdict": "BUY", "confidence": 70}
    dec, rsn = _apply_decision_rules(signal_low_rr, bull_buy, checks_8)
    assert dec == "REJECT"
    assert "Real RR" in rsn

    # 3. Insufficient Devil Checks (in LIVE mode)
    checks_5 = [f"Check {i}" for i in range(5)]
    with patch("agents.supervisor.SYSTEM_MODE", "LIVE"):
        dec, rsn = _apply_decision_rules(signal, bull_buy, checks_5)
        assert dec == "REJECT"
        assert "devil checks passed" in rsn


def test_apply_decision_rules_bear_veto_arbitration():
    """Verify Bear agent red flag halts approval unless super-majority high confidence."""
    signal = {"symbol": "ADANIENT", "risk_reward": 2.5}
    bull = {"verdict": "BUY", "confidence": 72}
    checks_8 = [f"Check {i}" for i in range(8)]
    bear_veto = {
        "verdict": "VETO",
        "red_flags": ["Promoter pledge 78% (Distress Alert)"],
    }

    dec, rsn = _apply_decision_rules(signal, bull, checks_8, bear_result=bear_veto)
    assert dec == "REJECT"
    assert "Bear Agent Critical Red Flag Veto" in rsn


def test_supervisor_evaluate_approved_generates_cio_report():
    """Verify Supervisor generates CIO report when signal is approved."""
    mock_llm_res = LLMInferenceResult(
        success=True,
        vendor_used="groq",
        model="llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
        latency_ms=145.0,
        is_fallback=False,
        parsed_payload={
            "summary": "TCS trade cleared for entry based on strong momentum.",
            "deciding_factor": "Multi-timeframe momentum alignment",
            "top_reasons": ["RSI 62 in momentum corridor", "All 8 risk sentry checks passed"],
            "risk_note": "Monitor IT sector breadth",
            "confidence_assessment": "High confidence setup",
        },
        raw_response='{"summary": "TCS trade cleared..."}',
    )

    signal = {"symbol": "TCS", "risk_reward": 2.4, "strategy_id": "S01_MomentumRSI"}
    bull = {"verdict": "STRONG_BUY", "confidence": 80, "key_reasons": ["Momentum breakout"]}
    checks = [f"Check {i}" for i in range(8)]

    with patch("agents.supervisor.query_llm_fast", return_value=mock_llm_res), \
         patch("agents.supervisor._log_agent_call"):

        res = evaluate(signal, bull, devil_checks_passed=checks)
        assert res["approved"] is True
        assert res["final_decision"] == "APPROVE"
        assert res["model_used"] == "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"
        assert len(res["top_reasons"]) >= 1


def test_supervisor_evaluate_rejected_skips_llm():
    """Verify Supervisor skips LLM inference on REJECT to save API quota."""
    signal = {"symbol": "TCS", "risk_reward": 1.5}  # Low RR
    bull = {"verdict": "NEUTRAL", "confidence": 40}

        assert res["approved"] is False
        assert res["final_decision"] == "REJECT"
        assert res["model_used"] == "RULES_ONLY"
        assert res["latency_ms"] == 0.0
        mock_query.assert_not_called()

    mock_table.eq.return_value = mock_table
    mock_table.order.return_value = mock_table
    mock_table.limit.return_value = mock_table

    mock_table.execute.return_value = MagicMock(data=[
        {"agent_name": "BULL", "new_weight": 1.35},
        {"agent_name": "BEAR", "new_weight": 0.75},

    with patch("db.system.sb", mock_sb):

        assert weights["BEAR"] == 0.75
        assert weights["SUPERVISOR"] == 1.0  # Default un-calibrated

"""
Unit and Institutional Test Suite for Indian Statutory Tax & Friction Engine
(execution/tax.py)
"""

import pytest

from execution.tax import (
    calculate_brokerage,
    calculate_tax,
    calculate_stt,
    calculate_ctt,
    calculate_stamp_duty,
    calculate_turnover_charges,
    calculate_all_in_friction,
    DP_CHARGES_DELIVERY_SELL,
)


def test_calculate_brokerage_cap_rule():
    """Verify brokerage rule: â‚¹20 or 0.03% of turnover, whichever is lower."""
    # Small trade: â‚¹10,000 * 0.03% = â‚¹3.00
    brok_small = calculate_brokerage(10000.0)
    assert brok_small == 3.00

    # Large trade: â‚¹1,000,000 * 0.03% = â‚¹300 -> capped at â‚¹20.00
    brok_large = calculate_brokerage(1000000.0)
    assert brok_large == 20.00

    # Zero turnover
    assert calculate_brokerage(0.0) == 0.0


def test_calculate_tax_stcg_ltcg_crypto_with_cess():
    """Verify STCG (20.8%), LTCG (13.0%), and Crypto VDA (31.2%) rates with 4% cess."""
    profit = 10000.0

    # STCG @ 20.80% (< 365 days)
    stcg = calculate_tax(profit, holding_days=5, asset_class="EQUITY")
    assert stcg == 2080.00

    # LTCG @ 13.00% (>= 365 days)
    ltcg = calculate_tax(profit, holding_days=400, asset_class="EQUITY")
    assert ltcg == 1300.00

    # Crypto VDA @ 31.20% (Sec 115BBH)
    crypto_tax = calculate_tax(profit, holding_days=5, asset_class="CRYPTO")
    assert crypto_tax == 3120.00

    # Loss trades incur 0 tax
    loss_tax = calculate_tax(-5000.0, holding_days=10)
    assert loss_tax == 0.0


def test_calculate_stt_across_asset_classes():
    """Verify STT rules across Equity Delivery, Intraday, Futures, and Options."""
    turnover = 100000.0

    # Equity Delivery (0.10% on both Buy and Sell)
    assert calculate_stt(turnover, side="BUY", asset_class="EQUITY", product_type="DELIVERY") == 100.00
    assert calculate_stt(turnover, side="SELL", asset_class="EQUITY", product_type="DELIVERY") == 100.00

    # Equity Intraday (0.025% on Sell only)
    assert calculate_stt(turnover, side="BUY", asset_class="EQUITY", product_type="INTRADAY") == 0.00
    assert calculate_stt(turnover, side="SELL", asset_class="EQUITY", product_type="INTRADAY") == 25.00

    # Futures (0.02% on Sell turnover)
    assert calculate_stt(turnover, side="SELL", asset_class="FUTURES") == 20.00

    # Options Premium (0.10% on Sell premium)
    assert calculate_stt(turnover, side="SELL", asset_class="OPTIONS") == 100.00


def test_calculate_ctt_mcx_commodities():
    """Verify MCX Commodity Transaction Tax (CTT) on Sell side."""
    turnover = 100000.0

    # Commodity Futures (0.01% on Sell)
    assert calculate_ctt(turnover, side="SELL", is_option=False) == 10.00

    # Commodity Options (0.05% on Sell)
    assert calculate_ctt(turnover, side="SELL", is_option=True) == 50.00

    # Buy side is exempt from CTT
    assert calculate_ctt(turnover, side="BUY") == 0.00


def test_calculate_stamp_duty_buy_side_only():
    """Verify Stamp Duty is strictly levied on Buy side only."""
    turnover = 100000.0

    # Delivery Buy (0.015%)
    assert calculate_stamp_duty(turnover, side="BUY", asset_class="EQUITY", product_type="DELIVERY") == 15.00

    # Sell side is 0
    assert calculate_stamp_duty(turnover, side="SELL", asset_class="EQUITY") == 0.00


def test_calculate_all_in_friction_single_and_multi_leg():
    """Verify full all-in friction with DP charges and multi-leg option multipliers."""
    # Equity Delivery Trade: Buy 100 @ 1000, Sell 100 @ 1050
    res_eq = calculate_all_in_friction(
        buy_price=1000.0,
        sell_price=1050.0,
        quantity=100,
        asset_class="EQUITY",
        product_type="DELIVERY",
    )

    assert res_eq["brokerage"] == 40.00  # â‚¹20 buy + â‚¹20 sell
    assert res_eq["stt_ctt"] == (100.00 + 105.00)  # 0.1% buy + 0.1% sell
    assert res_eq["dp_charges"] == DP_CHARGES_DELIVERY_SELL  # â‚¹15.34
    assert res_eq["total_friction"] > 0
    assert res_eq["breakeven_pts"] > 0

    # Multi-Leg Iron Condor (4 legs)
    res_condor = calculate_all_in_friction(
        buy_price=50.0,
        sell_price=60.0,
        quantity=100,
        asset_class="OPTIONS",
        num_legs=4,
    )

    # 4 legs * (â‚¹20 buy + â‚¹20 sell) = â‚¹160 max brokerage
    assert res_condor["brokerage"] > 0
    assert res_condor["total_friction"] > 0

def test_timezone_sanitizer():
    """Verify localize_ist and to_utc handle naive, aware, and string inputs without crashing."""
    # 1. Naive datetime
    naive = datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 30, 0)
    ist_dt = localize_ist(naive)
    assert ist_dt.tzinfo is not None
    assert ist_dt.hour == 10
    assert ist_dt.minute == 30

    # 2. UTC aware datetime
    utc_dt = datetime(2026, 8, 14, 4, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    ist_from_utc = localize_ist(utc_dt)
    assert ist_from_utc.hour == 9
    assert ist_from_utc.minute == 30  # UTC 04:00 is IST 09:30

    # 3. ISO String
    iso_str = "2026-08-14T09:15:00+05:30"
    ist_from_str = localize_ist(iso_str)
    assert ist_from_str.hour == 9
    assert ist_from_str.minute == 15

    # 4. Pure date
    p_date = date(2026, 8, 14)
    ist_from_date = localize_ist(p_date)
    assert ist_from_date.day == 14
    assert ist_from_date.hour == 0


def test_nse_market_boundaries_and_session_state():
    """Verify exact second-level boundary conditions and immutable SessionState for NSE."""
    base_date = date(2026, 8, 14)

    # 1. 08:30 IST -> Pre-Market Active
    dt_pre = datetime.combine(base_date, time(8, 30), tzinfo=IST)
    state_pre = get_session_state(dt_pre, Exchange.NSE)
    assert state_pre.status == MarketStatus.PRE_OPEN
    assert state_pre.is_open is False
    assert "Pre-market" in state_pre.reason
    assert is_pre_market(dt_pre, Exchange.NSE) is True

    # 2. 09:15:00 IST -> Market Open
    dt_open = datetime.combine(base_date, time(9, 15, 0), tzinfo=IST)
    state_open = get_session_state(dt_open, Exchange.NSE)
    assert state_open.status == MarketStatus.OPEN
    assert state_open.is_open is True
    assert state_open.minutes_elapsed == 0
    assert state_open.session_id == f"NSE_{base_date}_REGULAR"

    # 3. 15:12:00 IST -> EOD Decision Window (3:10 PM - 3:15 PM)
    dt_decision = datetime.combine(base_date, time(15, 12, 0), tzinfo=IST)
    assert is_eod_decision_window(dt_decision, Exchange.NSE) is True

    # 4. 15:30:00 IST -> Closing Minute
    dt_close = datetime.combine(base_date, time(15, 30, 0), tzinfo=IST)
    state_close = get_session_state(dt_close, Exchange.NSE)
    assert state_close.status == MarketStatus.OPEN
    assert state_close.minutes_remaining == 0

    # 5. 15:30:01 IST -> Post-Market
    dt_post = datetime.combine(base_date, time(15, 30, 1), tzinfo=IST)
    state_post = get_session_state(dt_post, Exchange.NSE)
    assert state_post.status == MarketStatus.POST_MARKET
    assert state_post.is_open is False
    assert is_post_market(dt_post, Exchange.NSE) is True


def test_special_session_and_halt_overrides():

    assert "Circuit Breaker" in state_halted.reason

    # Clean up halt
    set_exchange_halt(Exchange.NSE, False)

def test_custom_broker_adapter_registration():
    # 1. Custom Shoonya Token Resolver
    def shoonya_token_resolver(symbol: str, exchange: str = "NSE") -> str:
        if symbol == "RELIANCE":
            return "SHOONYA_2885"
        return ""

    register_broker_token_resolver(BrokerType.SHOONYA, shoonya_token_resolver)
    assert TokenResolver.get_token("RELIANCE", broker=BrokerType.SHOONYA) == "SHOONYA_2885"

    # Unregistered broker logs warning and returns None
    assert TokenResolver.get_token("RELIANCE", broker=BrokerType.ZERODHA) is None

    # 2. Custom Shoonya Reverse Symbol Resolver
    def shoonya_symbol_resolver(token: str, exchange: str = "NSE") -> str:
        if token == "SHOONYA_2885":
            return "RELIANCE"
        return ""

    register_broker_symbol_resolver(BrokerType.SHOONYA, shoonya_symbol_resolver)
    assert TokenResolver.get_symbol("SHOONYA_2885", broker=BrokerType.SHOONYA) == "RELIANCE"


def test_translate_symbol_cross_broker():
    # Same broker returns identical symbol
    assert TokenResolver.translate_symbol("RELIANCE", BrokerType.ANGELONE, BrokerType.ANGELONE) == "RELIANCE"

    # Strips prefixes/suffixes across brokers
    assert TokenResolver.translate_symbol("NSE:RELIANCE-EQ", BrokerType.ZERODHA, BrokerType.ANGELONE) == "RELIANCE"
    assert TokenResolver.translate_symbol("TCS.NS", BrokerType.INTERACTIVE_BROKERS, BrokerType.ANGELONE) == "TCS"

"""
Unit and Institutional Test Suite for SOTA Active Position Tracker
(execution/tracker.py)
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

from execution.tracker import (
    calculate_trailing_sl,
    update_position_extremes,
    _calculate_holding_days,
    evaluate_tranche_exits,
    check_paper_trades,
    get_open_trades_with_pnl,
)


def test_calculate_trailing_sl_long_and_short():
    """Verify ATR trailing stop ratchets upwards for LONG and downwards for SHORT."""
    # Long: Entry 100, Current Price 120, ATR 2.0 -> Trailing SL = max(100, 120 - 5.0) = 115.0
    long_sl = calculate_trailing_sl(
        entry=100.0,
        current_price=120.0,
        symbol="RELIANCE",
        signal_direction="LONG",
        current_sl=100.0,
        atr=2.0,
    )
    assert long_sl == 115.0

    # Long stop never ratchets down if price dips
    long_sl_dip = calculate_trailing_sl(
        entry=100.0,
        current_price=110.0,
        symbol="RELIANCE",
        signal_direction="LONG",
        current_sl=115.0,
        atr=2.0,
    )
    assert long_sl_dip == 115.0

    # Short: Entry 100, Current Price 80, ATR 2.0 -> Trailing SL = min(100, 80 + 5.0) = 85.0
    short_sl = calculate_trailing_sl(
        entry=100.0,
        current_price=80.0,
        symbol="TCS",
        signal_direction="SHORT",
        current_sl=100.0,
        atr=2.0,
    )
    assert short_sl == 85.0


def test_calculate_holding_days():
    """Verify calendar holding days calculation from ISO timestamp."""

    ten_days_ago = (now_ist() - timedelta(days=10)).isoformat()
    assert _calculate_holding_days(ten_days_ago) == 10

        "target_1": 1550.0,

        {"id": "tr-1", "tranche_number": 1, "quantity": 5, "target_price": 1550.0},

         patch("execution.tracker.close_tranche", mock_close_tranche), \

        assert sl_call_args[1]["current_sl"] == 1500.0

def test_split_tranche_quantities_all_cases():
    """Verify 3-tranche splitting math across 0, 1, 2, 3, and 100 shares."""
    # 0 shares
    assert split_tranche_quantities(0) == (0, 0, 0)

    # 1 share -> 100% in Tranche 1
    assert split_tranche_quantities(1) == (1, 0, 0)

    # 2 shares -> 1 in T1, 1 in T2, 0 in Runners
    assert split_tranche_quantities(2) == (1, 1, 0)

    # 3 shares -> 1 in T1, 1 in T2, 1 in Runners
    assert split_tranche_quantities(3) == (1, 1, 1)

    # 100 shares -> 50 in T1, 30 in T2, 20 in Runners
    assert split_tranche_quantities(100) == (50, 30, 20)


# â”€â”€ 3. FRACTAL PIVOT TESTS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def test_find_swing_low_and_high():
    """Verify fractal swing low and high discovery."""
    # Lows with a dip at index 5
    data_low = [
        {"Low": 100}, {"Low": 98}, {"Low": 95}, {"Low": 92}, {"Low": 90},
        {"Low": 85},  # Swing low (lower than 2 before and 2 after)
        {"Low": 88}, {"Low": 92}, {"Low": 94}, {"Low": 96}
    ]
    sw_low = find_swing_low(data_low, lookback=10)
    assert sw_low == 85.0

    # Highs with a peak at index 5
    data_high = [
        {"High": 100}, {"High": 102}, {"High": 105}, {"High": 108}, {"High": 110},
        {"High": 120},  # Swing high
        {"High": 115}, {"High": 112}, {"High": 108}, {"High": 105}
    ]
    sw_high = find_swing_high(data_high, lookback=10)
    assert sw_high == 120.0


# â”€â”€ 4. DERIVATIVE LOT SIZING & FREEZE LIMITS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def test_derivative_lot_sizing_and_freeze():
    """Verify lot sizing (multiples of 25) and freeze quantity caps."""
    # Calculate position size for NIFTY with lot_size = 25
    qty = calculate_position_size(
        entry=24000.0,
        stop_loss=23900.0,
        confidence=90.0,
        vix=14.0,
        trade_type="SWING",
        system_mode="LIVE",
        lot_size=25,
    )
    # Must be a multiple of 25
    assert qty % 25 == 0

    # Freeze quantity cap at 50
    qty_frozen = calculate_position_size(
        entry=24000.0,
        stop_loss=23900.0,
        confidence=90.0,
        vix=14.0,
        trade_type="SWING",
        system_mode="LIVE",
        lot_size=25,
        freeze_qty=50,
    )
    assert qty_frozen <= 50

def test_regulatory_cost_matrix():
    """Verify STT, GST, brokerage, and slippage calculations."""
    costs = calculate_costs(entry=1000.0, quantity=10, direction="BUY")
    assert costs["brokerage"] == 40.0   # â‚¹20 in + â‚¹20 out
    assert costs["stt"] > 0             # 0.1% delivery sell STT
    assert costs["gst"] > 0             # 18% GST
    assert costs["total"] > 40.0


# â”€â”€ 6. BIDIRECTIONAL TRADE LEVEL ENGINEERING TESTS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

def test_calculate_trade_levels_long_and_short():
    """Verify calculate_trade_levels generates complete geometry for LONG and SHORT."""
    # LONG Trade
    res_long = evaluate_trade_risk_levels(
        entry=1000.0,
        atr=15.0,
        confidence=85.0,
        vix=14.0,
        trade_type="SWING",
        signal_direction="LONG",
        system_mode="LIVE",
    )
    assert res_long.is_approved is True
    assert res_long.stop_loss < res_long.entry
    assert res_long.target > res_long.entry
    assert res_long.target_1 < res_long.target_2
    assert res_long.t1_quantity + res_long.t2_quantity + res_long.runner_quantity == res_long.quantity

    # SHORT Trade
    res_short = evaluate_trade_risk_levels(
        entry=1000.0,
        atr=15.0,
        confidence=85.0,
        vix=14.0,
        trade_type="SWING",
        signal_direction="SHORT",
        system_mode="LIVE",
    )
    assert res_short.is_approved is True
    assert res_short.stop_loss > res_short.entry
    assert res_short.target < res_short.entry
    assert res_short.target_1 > res_short.target_2

    mock_table.insert.return_value = mock_table
    mock_table.execute.return_value = MagicMock(data=[{"id": "tr-101", "symbol": "NIFTY26AUG24500CE"}])

    with patch("db.trades.sb", mock_sb):
        # Decision Price = 100.0, Fill Price = 100.50 -> Slippage = +50 bps

            "target_price": 130.0,
            "quantity": 50,
            "strategy_id": "GAMMA_SCALP",
        })
        assert res["id"] == "tr-101"
        call_payload = mock_table.insert.call_args[0][0]
        assert call_payload["slippage_bps"] == 50.0

@pytest.fixture
def donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df():
    """
    Generates a 250-row synthetic DataFrame:
    - Bars 0..225: Steady upward drift above EMA200.
    - Bars 226..248: Tight horizontal consolidation base (20-day high at 240.0).
    - Bar 249 (Final bar): Price breaks out explosively to 248.0 (new 20-day and 55-day high)
      with clean close near high (High=249.0), 1.8x volume surge, expanding ATR, and high ADX.
    """
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 250

    # Trend up to 230
    base = np.linspace(100.0, 230.0, n)
    close = base + np.random.normal(0, 0.4, n)

    # Tight horizontal base over bars 226..248 around 235..239
    close[226:249] = 238.0 + np.random.normal(0, 0.5, 23)
    open_ = close.copy()
    high = close + 1.0
    low = close - 1.0

    # Ensure confirmed 20-day high before final bar is 240.0
    high[235] = 240.0

    # Final bar: Explosive breakout to 248.0
    open_[-1] = 241.0
    close[-1] = 248.0
    high[-1] = 249.0  # Clean close: 248.0 >= 249.0 - 0.25*ATR
    low[-1] = 240.5
    volume = np.full(n, 50000.0, dtype=float)
    volume[-1] = 90000.0  # 1.8x volume surge

    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Open": open_,
        "High": high,
        "Low": low,
        "Close": close,
        "Volume": volume,
    })
    return df


@pytest.fixture
def downtrend_df():
    """Generates a 250-row secular downtrending DataFrame far below EMA200."""
    np.random.seed(99)
    n = 250
    close = np.linspace(250.0, 100.0, n)
    open_ = close + 0.5
    high = np.maximum(open_, close) + 1.0
    low = np.minimum(open_, close) - 1.0
    volume = np.full(n, 40000.0, dtype=float)

    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Open": open_,
        "High": high,
        "Low": low,
        "Close": close,
        "Volume": volume,
    })
    return df

def test_turtle_breakout_initialization_and_metadata():
    """Verify strategy metadata, parameters, and description."""
    strategy = TurtleBreakout()
    params = strategy.get_parameters()
    desc = strategy.get_description()

    assert strategy.name == "S03_TurtleBreakout"
    assert strategy.version == "2.2"
    assert strategy.timeframe == "POSITIONAL"
    assert params["breakout_period_s1"] == 20
    assert params["breakout_period_s2"] == 55
    assert params["sl_period"] == 10
    assert "Turtle Breakout" in desc


def test_turtle_breakout_generates_valid_signal(donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df):
    """Verify valid StrategySignalResult emitted on 20-Day Donchian Breakout."""
    strategy = TurtleBreakout()
    signal = strategy.generate_signal(
        df=donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df,
        symbol="TATASTEEL",
        vix=14.0,
        market_state="BULL",
        mqi_level="HIGH",
    )

    assert signal is not None
    assert isinstance(signal, StrategySignalResult)
    assert signal.is_valid() is True
    assert signal.symbol == "TATASTEEL"
    assert signal.strategy_id == "S03_TurtleBreakout"
    assert signal.signal_direction == "LONG"
    assert signal.signal_type == "BUY"
    assert signal.timeframe == "POSITIONAL"
    assert signal.technical_score >= 75.0
    assert signal.confidence >= 75.0
    assert signal.sl_method == "TURTLE_10D"
    assert signal.swing_low is not None and signal.swing_low > 0
    assert "pyramid_step" in signal.indicator_values
    assert len(signal.reasons) > 0


def test_turtle_breakout_hard_sentry_no_breakout_rejection(donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df):
    """Verify Hard Sentry 1: Rejects trades if price does not break above 20-day high."""
    strategy = TurtleBreakout()
    no_breakout_df = donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df.copy()
    # Pull back final close below the 20-day high (240.0)
    no_breakout_df.iloc[-1, no_breakout_df.columns.get_loc("Close")] = 237.0

    signal = strategy.generate_signal(
        df=no_breakout_df,
        symbol="JINDALSTEL",
        vix=14.0,
        market_state="BULL",
        mqi_level="HIGH",
    )

    assert signal is None


def test_turtle_breakout_hard_sentry_below_ema200_rejection(downtrend_df):

def test_turtle_breakout_higher_timeframe_filter(donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df):
    """Verify Higher Timeframe Filter applies penalty if Daily HTF is below EMA50."""
    strategy = TurtleBreakout()
    htf_n = 100
    htf_close = np.linspace(200.0, 50.0, htf_n)
    htf_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Open": htf_close + 1.0,
        "High": htf_close + 2.0,
        "Low": htf_close - 2.0,
        "Close": htf_close,
        "Volume": np.full(htf_n, 100000),
    })

    signal = strategy.generate_signal(
        df=donchian_breakout_ohlcv_df,
        symbol="NATIONALUM",
        vix=14.0,
        market_state="BULL",
        mqi_level="HIGH",
        higher_tf_df=htf_df,
    )

    if signal is not None:
        assert any("Higher timeframe" in r for r in signal.reasons)

"""
Unit and Institutional Test Suite for Options Volatility Engine & IV Rank
(options/volatility.py)
"""

import pytest

from options.volatility import (
    calculate_iv_rank,
    calculate_iv_percentile,
    classify_volatility_regime,
    calculate_iv_crush,
    analyze_volatility_term_structure,
    VolatilityRegimeResult,
)


def test_calculate_iv_rank():
    """Verify IV Rank formula (Current - Min) / (Max - Min) * 100."""
    # Min = 10%, Max = 30%, Current = 20% -> IVR = 50.0%
    assert calculate_iv_rank(current_iv=0.20, min_iv=0.10, max_iv=0.30) == 50.0

    # Current at 52-week high -> IVR = 100.0%
    assert calculate_iv_rank(current_iv=0.35, min_iv=0.10, max_iv=0.30) == 100.0

    # Current at 52-week low -> IVR = 0.0%
    assert calculate_iv_rank(current_iv=0.08, min_iv=0.10, max_iv=0.30) == 0.0


def test_calculate_iv_percentile():
    """Verify IV Percentile calculation over historical series."""
    history = [0.10, 0.12, 0.14, 0.16, 0.18, 0.20, 0.22, 0.24, 0.26, 0.28]
    # Current IV = 0.20 -> 5 items are strictly lower out of 10 -> IVP = 50.0%
    assert calculate_iv_percentile(current_iv=0.20, historical_iv_series=history) == 50.0

    # Current IV = 0.29 -> 100% percentile
    assert calculate_iv_percentile(current_iv=0.29, historical_iv_series=history) == 100.0


def test_classify_volatility_regime():
    """Verify volatility regime classification and strategy recommendation."""
    # Low Vol -> Option Buying
    low = classify_volatility_regime(iv_percentile=20.0, vix=12.0)
    assert low["regime"] == "LOW_VOLATILITY"
    assert low["recommended_action"] == "OPTION_BUYING_MOMENTUM"

    # High Vol -> S09 Theta Selling / Iron Condors
    high = classify_volatility_regime(iv_percentile=80.0, vix=18.0)
    assert high["regime"] == "HIGH_VOLATILITY"
    assert high["recommended_action"] == "OPTION_WRITING_THETA_DECAY"

    # Extreme Vol -> Wide Defined Risk
    extreme = classify_volatility_regime(iv_percentile=90.0, vix=26.0)
    assert extreme["regime"] == "EXTREME_VOLATILITY"


def test_calculate_iv_crush():
    """Verify post-event IV collapse calculation."""
    res = calculate_iv_crush(pre_event_iv=0.40, expected_crush_pct=0.35)
    assert res["pre_event_iv"] == 0.40
    assert res["post_event_iv"] == 0.26
    assert res["crush_pct"] == 35.0


def test_analyze_volatility_term_structure():
    """Verify Contango vs Backwardation term structure identification."""
    # Normal Contango: Monthly IV (18%) > Weekly IV (15%)
    contango = analyze_volatility_term_structure(near_term_iv=0.15, next_term_iv=0.18)
    assert contango["structure"] == "CONTANGO_NORMAL"

    # Backwardation Inversion: Weekly IV (22%) > Monthly IV (16%)
    backwardation = analyze_volatility_term_structure(near_term_iv=0.22, next_term_iv=0.16)
    assert backwardation["structure"] == "BACKWARDATION_INVERTED"

"""
Unit and Institutional Test Suite for S11 Volume Profile Auction Strategy
(strategy/registry/volume_profile.py)
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pytest

from strategy.registry.volume_profile import VolumeProfileStrategy
from strategy.registry.base import StrategySignalResult


@pytest.fixture
def volume_profile_val_bounce_df():
    """
    Generates an 80-row synthetic DataFrame with a Gaussian volume distribution around POC (~200.0)
    and a clean price rejection bounce off Value Area Low (~195.0) with high RVOL.
    """
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 80
    close = 200.0 + np.random.normal(0, 3.5, n)
    volume = 30000.0 * np.exp(-((close - 200.0) ** 2) / 30.0) + 5000.0

    # Final 3 bars: Dip to VAL (~195.0) and bounce to 197.0 on high volume
    close[-3] = 197.0
    close[-2] = 194.0
    close[-1] = 197.0
    open_ = close.copy()
    open_[-1] = 194.5
    high = close + 1.5
    low = close - 1.5
    low[-1] = 193.0  # lower shadow rejection at VAL
    volume[-1] = 45000.0

    return pd.DataFrame({
        "Open": open_,
        "High": high,
        "Low": low,
        "Close": close,
        "Volume": volume,
    })


def test_volume_profile_metadata():
    strategy = VolumeProfileStrategy()
    assert strategy.name == "S11_VolumeProfile"
    assert strategy.version == "1.0"


def test_volume_profile_val_bounce_signal(volume_profile_val_bounce_df):
    strategy = VolumeProfileStrategy()
    signal = strategy.generate_signal(
        df=volume_profile_val_bounce_df,
        symbol="TATASTEEL",
        vix=15.0,
        market_state="BULL",
        mqi_level="HIGH",
    )

    assert signal is not None
    assert isinstance(signal, StrategySignalResult)
    assert signal.is_valid() is True
    assert signal.signal_direction == "LONG"
    assert "poc" in signal.indicator_values
    assert "val" in signal.indicator_values
    assert signal.technical_score >= 70.0

def clean_websocket_state():
    """Reset in-memory websocket stores before each test."""
    with _prices_lock:
        live_prices.clear()
        live_volumes.clear()
        live_oi.clear()
        live_timestamps.clear()
    yield
    with _prices_lock:
        live_prices.clear()
        live_volumes.clear()
        live_oi.clear()
        live_timestamps.clear()

def test_token_staleness_measurement():

def test_on_close_clears_all_caches():
    """Verify on_close flushes live prices, volumes, and OI to prevent trading on stale data."""
    mock_ws = MagicMock()
    on_data(mock_ws, {"token": "2885", "last_traded_price": 250000, "volume": 1000, "oi": 5000})
    assert get_live_price("2885") is not None

    with patch("communication.telegram.send_message"):
        on_close(mock_ws)

    assert get_live_price("2885") is None
    assert get_live_volume("2885") is None
    assert get_live_oi("2885") is None


def test_concurrent_tick_writes_and_reads():
    """Thread safety test: Concurrent writers and readers never deadlock or corrupt store."""
    mock_ws = MagicMock()
    tokens = [str(i) for i in range(100)]

    def writer():
        for t in tokens:
            on_data(mock_ws, {"token": t, "last_traded_price": int(t) * 1000 + 100, "volume": int(t) * 10})

    def reader():
        for t in tokens:
            _ = get_live_quote(t)

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=writer),
        threading.Thread(target=reader),
        threading.Thread(target=writer),
        threading.Thread(target=reader),
    ]

    for th in threads:
        th.start()
    for th in threads:
        th.join()

    # Verify state integrity
    assert len(live_prices) == 100


def test_total_ticks_counter_increments_and_resets():
    """Verify total_ticks_received tracks lifetime ticks and resets cleanly."""
    from data.angelone.websocket import get_total_ticks_received, reset_tick_counter

    reset_tick_counter()
    assert get_total_ticks_received() == 0

    mock_ws = MagicMock()
    on_data(mock_ws, {"token": "100", "last_traded_price": 25000})
    on_data(mock_ws, {"token": "200", "last_traded_price": 35000})

    assert get_total_ticks_received() == 2

    reset_tick_counter()
    assert get_total_ticks_received() == 0


def test_dynamic_subscribe_and_unsubscribe_tokens():
    """Verify dynamic intraday token subscription and unsubscription."""
    from data.angelone.websocket import (
        subscribe_additional_tokens,
        unsubscribe_tokens,
        _token_list,
    )
    import data.angelone.websocket as ws_mod

    mock_sws = MagicMock()
    ws_mod._sws = mock_sws
    ws_mod._token_list = [{"exchangeType": 1, "tokens": ["1000", "2000"]}]

    # 1. Subscribe new tokens
    res = subscribe_additional_tokens(["3000", "4000"], exchange_type=1)
    assert res is True
    assert mock_sws.subscribe.called
    assert "3000" in ws_mod._token_list[0]["tokens"]
    assert "4000" in ws_mod._token_list[0]["tokens"]

    # 2. Unsubscribe token
    res_unsub = unsubscribe_tokens(["3000"], exchange_type=1)
    assert res_unsub is True
    assert "3000" not in ws_mod._token_list[0]["tokens"]
    assert "4000" in ws_mod._token_list[0]["tokens"]

    # Clean up mock
    ws_mod._sws = None


def test_on_data_extracts_day_ohlc_and_calculates_change_pct():
    """Verify Day Open, High, Low, Previous Close, and Change % extraction."""
    from data.angelone.websocket import (
        get_live_day_open,
        get_live_day_high,
        get_live_day_low,
        get_live_prev_close,
        get_live_quote,
    )

    mock_ws = MagicMock()
    tick_payload = {
        "token": "2885",
        "last_traded_price": 250000,           # â‚¹2500.00
        "open_price_of_the_day": 248000,       # â‚¹2480.00
        "high_price_of_the_day": 252000,       # â‚¹2520.00
        "low_price_of_the_day": 247500,        # â‚¹2475.00
        "closed_price": 245000,                # â‚¹2450.00 (prev close)
        "volume_trade_for_the_day": 150000,
        "open_interest": 45000,
    }

    on_data(mock_ws, tick_payload)

    assert get_live_day_open("2885") == 2480.0
    assert get_live_day_high("2885") == 2520.0
    assert get_live_day_low("2885") == 2475.0
    assert get_live_prev_close("2885") == 2450.0

    quote = get_live_quote("2885")
    assert quote is not None
    assert quote["high"] == 2520.0
    assert quote["low"] == 2475.0
    assert quote["open"] == 2480.0
    assert quote["prev_close"] == 2450.0
    # Change % = ((2500 - 2450) / 2450) * 100 = 2.04%
    assert quote["change_pct"] is not None
    assert round(quote["change_pct"], 2) == 2.04


def test_event_driven_tick_listener_observer_pattern():
    """Verify registered callbacks receive real-time tick events."""
    from data.angelone.websocket import register_tick_listener, unregister_tick_listener

    events_received = []

    def on_tick_callback(event):
        events_received.append(event)

    register_tick_listener(on_tick_callback)

    mock_ws = MagicMock()
    on_data(mock_ws, {"token": "999", "last_traded_price": 50000})

    assert len(events_received) == 1
    assert events_received[0]["token"] == "999"
    assert events_received[0]["ltp"] == 500.0

    # Unregister
    unregister_tick_listener(on_tick_callback)
    on_data(mock_ws, {"token": "999", "last_traded_price": 50500})
    assert len(events_received) == 1  # No new event received after unregister


def test_chunked_subscription_splits_large_token_lists():

def test_live_bid_ask_spread_and_slippage_guard():
    """Verify best bid/ask parsing, spread percentage, and institutional slippage guard."""
    from data.angelone.websocket import (
        get_live_bid,
        get_live_ask,
        get_live_spread_pct,
        is_spread_acceptable,
        get_live_quote,
    )

    mock_ws = MagicMock()
    # 1. Normal liquid stock: Bid = 2500.0, Ask = 2500.5 (Spread = 0.02%)
    tick_liquid = {
        "token": "2885",
        "last_traded_price": 250000,
        "best_5_buy_data": [{"price": 250000, "quantity": 500}],
        "best_5_sell_data": [{"price": 250050, "quantity": 400}],
    }
    on_data(mock_ws, tick_liquid)

    assert get_live_bid("2885") == 2500.0
    assert get_live_ask("2885") == 2500.5
    spread = get_live_spread_pct("2885")
    assert spread is not None
    assert round(spread, 3) == 0.02
    assert is_spread_acceptable("2885", max_spread_pct=0.25) is True

    # 2. Illiquid option: Bid = 100.0, Ask = 105.0 (Spread = 5.0% > 0.25% threshold)
    tick_illiquid = {
        "token": "9988",
        "last_traded_price": 10000,
        "best_5_buy_data": [{"price": 10000, "quantity": 50}],
        "best_5_sell_data": [{"price": 10500, "quantity": 25}],
    }
    on_data(mock_ws, tick_illiquid)

    assert get_live_spread_pct("9988") == 5.0
    # Guard blocks execution!
    assert is_spread_acceptable("9988", max_spread_pct=0.25) is False

"""
Unit and Institutional Test Suite for WebSocket Liveness Supervisor

import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

from orchestration.websocket_supervisor import (
    handle_websocket_health,
    get_supervisor_state,

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clean_state():
    """Reset supervisor state before each test."""
    reset_supervisor_state()
    yield
    reset_supervisor_state()


def test_websocket_supervisor_healthy_noop():
    """Verify healthy feed returns immediately without triggering restarts."""
    with patch("data.angelone.websocket.restart_websocket") as mock_restart, \
         patch("orchestration.websocket_supervisor.send_message") as mock_send:

        res = handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=True)
        assert res["healthy"] is True
        assert res["rest_fallback"] is False
        mock_restart.assert_not_called()
        mock_send.assert_not_called()


def test_websocket_supervisor_stale_triggers_restart_and_alert():
    """Verify stale feed triggers alert, web event, and restart_websocket."""
    with patch("data.angelone.websocket.restart_websocket") as mock_restart, \
         patch("orchestration.websocket_supervisor.send_message") as mock_send, \
         patch("orchestration.websocket_supervisor.publish_event") as mock_pub:

        res = handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)
        assert res["healthy"] is False
        assert res["consecutive_attempts"] == 1
        mock_restart.assert_called_once()
        mock_send.assert_called_once()
        mock_pub.assert_called_once()


def test_websocket_supervisor_rate_limits_alerts():
    """Verify duplicate alerts within cooldown window are throttled."""
    with patch("data.angelone.websocket.restart_websocket"), \
         patch("orchestration.websocket_supervisor.send_message") as mock_send:

        # First stale event -> alerts
        handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)
        assert mock_send.call_count == 1

        # Immediate second stale event -> throttled (no second alert)
        handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)
        assert mock_send.call_count == 1


def test_websocket_supervisor_consecutive_failures_trips_rest_fallback():
    """Verify 3 consecutive dropouts engages REST polling fallback."""
    with patch("data.angelone.websocket.restart_websocket"), \
         patch("orchestration.websocket_supervisor.send_message"):

        handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)  # #1
        handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)  # #2
        res3 = handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)  # #3

        assert res3["consecutive_attempts"] == 3
        assert res3["rest_fallback"] is True

        state = get_supervisor_state()
        assert state["rest_fallback_active"] is True
        assert state["consecutive_attempts"] == 3


def test_websocket_supervisor_healthy_restores_state():
    """Verify healthy feed resets consecutive failure counters."""
    with patch("data.angelone.websocket.restart_websocket"), \
         patch("orchestration.websocket_supervisor.send_message"):

        # Trip to attempt 2
        handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)
        handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=False)
        assert get_supervisor_state()["consecutive_attempts"] == 2

        # Recover to healthy
        res_rec = handle_websocket_health(ws_healthy=True)
        assert res_rec["healthy"] is True
        assert res_rec["rest_fallback"] is False
        assert get_supervisor_state()["consecutive_attempts"] == 0

# â”€â”€ WEBSOCKET â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@app.websocket("/ws")
async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket):
    """
    WebSocket for real-time dashboard updates.
    Client must send API key as first message.

    Message format:
      Auth     : {"api_key": "your_key"}
      Ping     : {"type": "ping"}
      Subscribe: {"type": "subscribe", "channel": "signals"}
    """
    await websocket.accept()
    client_id = None

    try:
        # Auth â€” first message must be API key
        auth_data = await asyncio.wait_for(
            websocket.receive_json(), timeout=10.0
        )
        api_key = auth_data.get("api_key", "")

        if not verify_ws_token(api_key):
            await websocket.send_json({
                "type"   : "error",
                "message": "Invalid API key",
            })
            await websocket.close(code=4001)
            return

        # Register connection
        client_id = await ws_manager.connect(websocket)
        logger.info(f"WebSocket client connected: {client_id}")

        await websocket.send_json({
            "type"     : "connected",
            "client_id": client_id,
            "message"  : "ArthAI Dashboard connected",
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        })

        # Listen for client messages
        while True:
            try:
                data = await asyncio.wait_for(
                    websocket.receive_json(), timeout=30.0
                )

                if data.get("type") == "ping":
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type"     : "pong",
                        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                    })

                elif data.get("type") == "subscribe":
                    channel = data.get("channel", "all")
                    ws_manager.subscribe(client_id, channel)
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type"   : "subscribed",
                        "channel": channel,
                    })

            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                # Heartbeat to keep connection alive
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type"     : "heartbeat",
                    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                })

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        if client_id:
            ws_manager.disconnect(client_id)
            logger.info(f"WebSocket client disconnected: {client_id}")
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        logger.warning("WebSocket auth timeout")
        await websocket.close(code=4002)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"WebSocket error: {e}")
        if client_id:
            try:
                ws_manager.disconnect(client_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            "status_code": exc.status_code,
            "timestamp"  : datetime.now().isoformat(),
        },
    )

async def general_exception_handler(request, exc):
    logger.error(f"Unhandled exception: {exc}", exc_info=True)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code = 500,
        content     = {
            "error"      : "Internal server error",
            "status_code": 500,
            "timestamp"  : datetime.now().isoformat(),
        },
    )

"""
ArthAI Dashboard - Authentication
Simple API key verification
"""

import os
import logging
from fastapi import HTTPException, Security
from fastapi.security import APIKeyHeader

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

API_KEY_HEADER = APIKeyHeader(name="X-API-Key", auto_error=False)


def get_api_key() -> str:
    """Get the expected API key from environment"""
    key = os.getenv("ARTHAI_API_KEY", "arthai-personal-key-2024")
    return key


def verify_api_key(api_key: str = Security(API_KEY_HEADER)) -> str:
    """
    Verify API key from request header
    Header: X-API-Key: your-key-here
    """
    expected_key = get_api_key()
    
    if not api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=401,
            detail="API key missing. Add header: X-API-Key"
        )
    
    if api_key != expected_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Invalid API key"
        )
    
    return api_key


def verify_ws_token(token: str) -> bool:
    """
    Verify WebSocket auth token
    Same as API key for simplicity
    """
    if not token:
        return False
    expected_key = get_api_key()
    return token == expected_key

"""
ArthAI Dashboard - WebSocket Manager
Handles real-time push to connected clients
"""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Set, Optional

from fastapi import WebSocket

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class WebSocketManager:
    """Manages all WebSocket connections and broadcasts"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        # All active connections: {client_id: websocket}
        self.connections: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
        # Channel subscriptions: {client_id: set of channels}
        self.subscriptions: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}
        # Message queue for broadcasting
        self.message_queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self._running = False
    
    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> str:
        """Register a new WebSocket connection"""
        client_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
        self.connections[client_id] = websocket
        self.subscriptions[client_id] = {"all"}  # Default: all channels
        logger.info(f"WS connected: {client_id} | Total: {len(self.connections)}")
        return client_id
    
    def disconnect(self, client_id: str):
        """Remove a disconnected client"""
        self.connections.pop(client_id, None)
        self.subscriptions.pop(client_id, None)
        logger.info(f"WS disconnected: {client_id} | Remaining: {len(self.connections)}")
    
    def subscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str):
        """Add client to a specific channel"""
        if client_id in self.subscriptions:
            self.subscriptions[client_id].add(channel)
    
    async def broadcast(self, message: dict, channel: str = "all"):
        """
        Broadcast message to all clients subscribed to channel
        Call this from anywhere in ArthAI to push updates
        """
        await self.message_queue.put({
            "message": message,
            "channel": channel,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
        })
    
    async def send_to_client(self, client_id: str, message: dict):
        """Send message to specific client"""
        if client_id in self.connections:
            try:
                await self.connections[client_id].send_json(message)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to send to {client_id}: {e}")
                self.disconnect(client_id)
    
    async def broadcast_loop(self):
        """
        Background task that processes message queue
        Runs continuously, sends to all matching subscribers
        """
        self._running = True
        logger.info("WebSocket broadcast loop started")
        
        while self._running:
            try:
                # Get message from queue (wait up to 1 second)
                try:
                    item = await asyncio.wait_for(
                        self.message_queue.get(),
                        timeout=1.0
                    )
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    continue
                
                message = item["message"]
                channel = item["channel"]
                
                # Add timestamp and channel to message
                message["_channel"] = channel
                message["_timestamp"] = item["timestamp"]
                
                # Send to all subscribed clients
                disconnected = []
                for client_id, websocket in self.connections.items():
                    client_channels = self.subscriptions.get(client_id, {"all"})
                    
                    # Send if subscribed to channel or "all"
                    if channel in client_channels or "all" in client_channels:
                        try:
                            await websocket.send_json(message)
                        except Exception:
                            disconnected.append(client_id)
                
                # Clean up disconnected clients
                for client_id in disconnected:
                    self.disconnect(client_id)
                    
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Broadcast loop error: {e}")
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
    
    def stop(self):
        self._running = False
    
    @property
    def connection_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.connections)
    
    async def broadcast_signal(self, signal: dict):
        """Broadcast new signal to all clients"""
        await self.broadcast({
            "type": "new_signal",
            "data": signal
        }, channel="signals")
    
    async def broadcast_market_mood(self, mood: dict):
        """Broadcast market mood update"""
        await self.broadcast({
            "type": "market_mood_update",
            "data": mood
        }, channel="market_mood")
    
    async def broadcast_trade_update(self, trade: dict):
        """Broadcast paper trade update"""
        await self.broadcast({
            "type": "trade_update",
            "data": trade
        }, channel="paper_trading")
    
    async def broadcast_system_alert(self, alert: dict):
        """Broadcast system-wide alert"""
        await self.broadcast({
            "type": "system_alert",
            "data": alert
        }, channel="all")


# Singleton instance
ws_manager = WebSocketManager()

#   encoding/parser problems.

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

Write-Host "============================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PATH EXCLUSION
# ------------------------------------------------------------

function Is-ExcludedPath {
    param(
        [string]$FullPath
    )

    $relative = $FullPath.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\')

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($relative)) {
        return $false
    }

    $parts = $relative -split '\\'

    foreach ($part in $parts) {
        if ($ExcludedDirectories -contains $part) {
            return $true
        }
    }

    $fileName = Split-Path -Leaf $FullPath

    if ($ExcludedFiles -contains $fileName) {
        return $true
    }

    return $false
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SECRET REDACTION
# ------------------------------------------------------------

function Redact-Secrets {
    param(
        [string]$Text
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Text)) {
        return $Text
    }

    $result = $Text

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE ASSIGNMENTS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $secretNamePattern =
        '(?i)(api[_-]?key|apikey|secret[_-]?key|secret|password|passwd|pwd|token|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|bot[_-]?token|private[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret|database[_-]?url|db[_-]?password|aws[_-]?secret|aws[_-]?access[_-]?key|credential|credentials)'

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        "(?m)^(\s*(?:export\s+)?$secretNamePattern\s*=\s*)(.*)$",
        '$1[REDACTED]'
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. JSON / YAML / TOML STYLE SECRETS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '(?i)("?(?:api[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|secret|password|passwd|pwd|token|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|private[_-]?key)"?\s*[:=]\s*)("[^"]*"|''[^'']*''|[^,\r\n}]+)',
        '$1[REDACTED]'
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. AUTHORIZATION HEADERS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '(?i)(Authorization\s*[:=]\s*(?:Bearer|Basic)\s+)[^\s\r\n"]+',
        '$1[REDACTED]'
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. BEARER TOKENS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '(?i)(Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+',
        '$1[REDACTED]'
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. PRIVATE KEY BLOCKS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '-----BEGIN [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----.*?-----END [^-]*PRIVATE KEY-----',
        '[REDACTED PRIVATE KEY]',
        [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. JWT TOKENS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\b',
        '[REDACTED JWT]'
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. TELEGRAM BOT TOKENS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '(?i)(telegram[_-]?bot[_-]?token\s*[:=]\s*)[A-Za-z0-9:_-]+',
        '$1[REDACTED]'
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. DATABASE URL PASSWORDS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    $result = [regex]::Replace(
        $result,
        '(?i)(://[^:/\s]+:)[^@\s]+(@)',
        '$1[REDACTED]$2'
    )

    return $result
}

function Add-Tree {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Prefix
    )

    $children = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -Force |
        Where-Object {

            if ($_.PSIsContainer) {
                return -not (
                    $ExcludedDirectories -contains $_.Name
                )
            }

            return -not (
                $ExcludedFiles -contains $_.Name
            )
        } |
        Sort-Object `
            @{Expression = {
                if ($_.PSIsContainer) {
                    0
                }
                else {
                    1
                }
            }}, `
            Name

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $children.Count; $i++) {

        $child = $children[$i]

        $isLast = ($i -eq ($children.Count - 1))

        if ($isLast) {
            $Branch = "\-- "
            $NextPrefix = "$Prefix    "
        }
        else {
            $Branch = "|-- "
            $NextPrefix = "$Prefix|   "
        }

        if ($child.PSIsContainer) {

            [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine(
                "$Prefix$Branch$($child.Name)\"
            )

            Add-Tree `
                -Path $child.FullName `
                -Prefix $NextPrefix
        }
        else {

            [void]$TreeBuilder.AppendLine(
                "$Prefix$Branch$($child.Name) [$($child.Length) bytes]"
            )
        }
    }
}

Add-Tree -Path $Root -Prefix ""

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar'
import { chatWithAssistant, getChatHistory, getSuggestions } from '@/lib/api'

interface Message {
  role: 'user' | 'assistant'
  content: string
  timestamp: Date
}

export default function AssistantPage() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([])
  const [input, setInput] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<string[]>([])
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    // Load initial data
    async function init() {
      const [history, sugg] = await Promise.all([
        getChatHistory(10),
        getSuggestions(),
      ])

      if (history?.conversations) {
        const msgs: Message[] = []
        // Reverse to show oldest first
        const convs = [...(history.conversations || [])].reverse()
        convs.forEach((c: any) => {
          msgs.push({
            role: 'user',
            content: c.message,
            timestamp: new Date(c.created_at)
          })
          msgs.push({
            role: 'assistant',
            content: c.response,
            timestamp: new Date(c.created_at)
          })
        })
        setMessages(msgs)
      } else {
        // Welcome message
        setMessages([{
          role: 'assistant',
          content: 'Namaste! I am ArthAI, your personal trading intelligence. ' +
                   'I analyze markets, explain signals, and help you become a better trader. ' +
                   'What would you like to know today?',
          timestamp: new Date()
        }])
      }

      if (sugg?.suggestions) {
        setSuggestions(sugg.suggestions)
      }
    }
    init()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })
  }, [messages])

  async function sendMessage(text?: string) {
    const messageText = text || input.trim()
    if (!messageText || loading) return

    setInput('')
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
      role: 'user',
      content: messageText,
      timestamp: new Date()
    }])
    setLoading(true)

    const response = await chatWithAssistant(messageText)

    setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
      role: 'assistant',
      content: response?.response || 'ArthAI is thinking... Please try again.',
      timestamp: new Date()
    }])
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-arthai-dark flex flex-col">
      <NavBar />
      
      <div className="flex-1 max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full px-4 py-6 flex flex-col">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6">
          ArthAI Assistant ðŸ¤–
        </h1>

        {/* Messages */}
        <div className="flex-1 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl 
                      p-4 mb-4 overflow-y-auto min-h-96 max-h-[500px]">
          {messages.map((msg, idx) => (
            <div key={idx}
                 className={`flex mb-4 animate-fade-in
                            ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}>
              <div className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 
                             ${msg.role === 'user'
                               ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                               : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-200'
                             }`}>
                {msg.role === 'assistant' && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-1">
                    <span className="text-blue-400 text-xs font-semibold">ArthAI</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                  {msg.content}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs opacity-50 mt-1">
                  {msg.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', {
                    hour: '2-digit',
                    minute: '2-digit'
                  })}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          
          {loading && (
            <div className="flex justify-start mb-4">
              <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3">
                <div className="flex gap-1">
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" 
                       style={{ animationDelay: '0ms' }} />
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" 
                       style={{ animationDelay: '150ms' }} />
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" 
                       style={{ animationDelay: '300ms' }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
        </div>

        {/* Suggestions */}
        {suggestions.length > 0 && messages.length <= 2 && (
          <div className="mb-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">Suggested questions:</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {suggestions.slice(0, 4).map((s, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  onClick={() => sendMessage(s)}
                  className="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 
                           rounded-full text-gray-300 hover:text-white hover:border-blue-600
                           transition-colors"
                >
                  {s}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Input */}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={input}
            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault()
                sendMessage()
              }
            }}
            placeholder="Ask ArthAI anything about markets..."
            className="flex-1 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3
                     text-white text-sm placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none
                     focus:border-blue-600 transition-colors"
            disabled={loading}
          />
          <button
            onClick={() => sendMessage()}
            disabled={loading || !input.trim()}
            className="px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium
                     hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed
                     transition-colors"
          >
            Send
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar'
import { getMarketMood, getMoodHistory, getVixData, getGlobalMarkets, getMarketRegime } from '@/lib/api'

// Add to api.ts
// export const getMarketRegime = () => fetchAPI('/api/market-mood/regime')

export default function MarketPage() {
  const [mood, setMood] = useState<any>(null)
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [vix, setVix] = useState<any>(null)
  const [global, setGlobal] = useState<any>(null)
  const [regime, setRegime] = useState<any>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const [m, h, v, g, r] = await Promise.all([
        getMarketMood(),
        getMoodHistory(7),
        getVixData(),
        getGlobalMarkets(),
        fetch('http://localhost:8000/api/market-mood/regime', {
          headers: { 'X-API-Key': process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY || 'arthai-personal-key-2024' }
        }).then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      ])

      if (m?.mood) setMood(m.mood)
      if (h?.history) setHistory(h.history)
      if (v) setVix(v)
      if (g?.markets) setGlobal(g.markets)
      if (r?.regime) setRegime(r.regime)
      setLoading(false)
    }
    load()
    const interval = setInterval(load, 60000)
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [])

  const moodColor = (m: string) => {
    if (!m) return 'text-gray-400'
    const upper = m.toUpperCase()
    if (upper.includes('BULL') || upper.includes('STRONG')) return 'text-emerald-400'
    if (upper.includes('BEAR') || upper.includes('PANIC')) return 'text-red-400'
    if (upper.includes('CAUTION') || upper.includes('VOLATILE')) return 'text-yellow-400'
    return 'text-blue-400'
  }

  const vixLevel = vix?.vix || 0

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-arthai-dark">
      <NavBar />
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6">Market Intelligence</h1>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-20 text-gray-400">
            Loading market data...
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Main Mood Card */}
            <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-6 mb-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm mb-2">Market Mood</p>
                  <p className={`text-3xl font-bold ${moodColor(mood?.mood)}`}>
                    {mood?.mood || 'NEUTRAL'}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">
                    Score: {mood?.score?.toFixed(1) || '--'}/10
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm mb-2">Market Regime</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400">
                    {regime?.current || mood?.regime || 'UNKNOWN'}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">Current phase</p>
                </div>

                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm mb-2">India VIX</p>
                  <p className={`text-3xl font-bold
                               ${vixLevel > 25 ? 'text-red-400' :
                                 vixLevel > 20 ? 'text-yellow-400' :
                                 vixLevel > 15 ? 'text-blue-400' :
                                 'text-emerald-400'}`}>
                    {vixLevel > 0 ? vixLevel.toFixed(1) : '--'}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">
                    {vix?.interpretation?.split(' - ')[0] || 'Fear gauge'}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm mb-2">Signal Today</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-400">
                    {mood?.mood?.includes('BULL') ? 'BULLISH BIAS' :
                     mood?.mood?.includes('BEAR') ? 'BEARISH BIAS' :

                  </p>
                  <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">Trading direction</p>
                </div>

              {mood?.reason && (
                <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-800">
                  <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">{mood.reason}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* VIX Gauge */}
            {vixLevel > 0 && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5 mb-6">

                  <div

                    style={{
                      left: `${Math.min(95, (vixLevel / 40) * 100)}%`
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-600">
                  <span>Low Fear (8)</span>
                  <span>Normal (15)</span>
                  <span>High Fear (25)</span>
                  <span>Extreme (40+)</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-3">
                  {vix?.interpretation || 'VIX interpretation loading...'}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Mood History */}
            {history.length > 0 && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5 mb-6">
                <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white mb-4">
                  7-Day Mood History
                </h2>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {history.slice(0, 7).map((item, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between
                               bg-gray-800/50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 w-20">
                          {item.date || item.created_at?.slice(0, 10) || '--'}
                        </span>

                          {item.mood || 'NEUTRAL'}

                        {item.vix && <span>VIX: {Number(item.vix).toFixed(1)}</span>}
                        {item.score !== undefined && (
                          <span>Score: {Number(item.score).toFixed(1)}</span>
                        )}
                        <span>{item.regime || '--'}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Global Markets */}
            {global && Object.keys(global).length > 0 && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5">
                <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white mb-4">
                  Global Markets
                </h2>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                  {Object.entries(global).map(([key, val]: [string, any]) => {
                    if (typeof val !== 'object' || !val) return null
                    const change = val.change_pct || val.change || 0
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={key}
                        className="bg-gray-800/50 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-center"
                      >
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1 capitalize">
                          {key.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                          {val.price || val.value || '--'}
                        </p>
                        <p className={`text-xs font-semibold mt-0.5
                                     ${Number(change) >= 0
                                       ? 'text-emerald-400'
                                       : 'text-red-400'}`}>
                          {Number(change) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{Number(change).toFixed(2)}%
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* No global data fallback */}
            {(!global || Object.keys(global || {}).length === 0) && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5">
                <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white mb-3">
                  Global Markets
                </h2>
                <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm text-center py-4">
                  Global market data refreshes every 30 minutes.
                  Check back during market hours.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const fmt = {
  num  : (n: number) => (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'),
  oi   : (n: number) =>
    n >= 1_000_000 ? `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`
    : n >= 1_000   ? `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K`
    : String(n ?? 0),
  pct  : (n: number) => `${(n ?? 0).toFixed(1)}%`,
  dec2 : (n: number) => (n ?? 0).toFixed(2),
  dec4 : (n: number) => (n ?? 0).toFixed(4),
  price: (n: number) =>
    (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }),
}

function OIBuildup({ value }: { value: string }) {
  if (value === 'BUILDUP')   return <span className="text-green-400 text-xs font-medium">â–² Build</span>
  if (value === 'UNWIND')    return <span className="text-red-400 text-xs font-medium">â–¼ Unwind</span>

}

function OIBar({ oi, maxOI, color = 'bg-blue-500' }: {
  oi   : number
  maxOI: number
  color?: string
}) {
  const pct = maxOI > 0 ? Math.min((oi / maxOI) * 100, 100) : 0
  return (
    <div className="w-full bg-gray-800 rounded-full h-1.5">
      <div
        className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${color}`}
        style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
