// Strike row
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

function StrikeRow({
  row,
  maxCallOI,
  maxPutOI,
  maxPain,
  underlyingPrice,
  showGreeks,
}: {
  row            : Strike
  maxCallOI      : number
  maxPutOI       : number
  maxPain        : number
  underlyingPrice: number
  showGreeks     : boolean
}) {
  const isATM     = row.moneyness === 'ATM' || row.moneyness === 'NEAR_ATM'
  const isMaxPain = row.strike === maxPain

  // For calls: ITM when strike < underlying
  // For puts : ITM when strike > underlying
  const ceITM = row.strike < underlyingPrice
  const peITM = row.strike > underlyingPrice

  const rowBg =
    isATM     ? 'bg-yellow-900/10 border-yellow-800/30' :
    isMaxPain ? 'bg-purple-900/10 border-purple-800/30' :
    'border-gray-800/50'

  const ceTxt = ceITM ? 'text-green-300' : 'text-gray-400'
  const peTxt = peITM ? 'text-green-300' : 'text-gray-400'

  return (
    <tr className={`border-b ${rowBg} hover:bg-gray-800/40 transition-colors`}>

      {/* â”€â”€ CE side (left, reading right-to-left toward strike) â”€â”€ */}
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right ${ceTxt}`}>
        <OIBuildup value={row.ce.oi_buildup} />
      </td>
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs ${ceTxt}`}>
        {fmt.oi(row.ce.oi_change)}
      </td>
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs ${ceTxt}`}>
        {fmt.oi(row.ce.volume)}
      </td>
      <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right min-w-[90px]">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 items-end">
          <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${ceTxt}`}>
            {fmt.oi(row.ce.oi)}
          </span>
          <OIBar oi={row.ce.oi} maxOI={maxCallOI} color="bg-red-500" />
        </div>
      </td>
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs ${ceTxt}`}>
        {fmt.pct(row.ce.iv)}
      </td>
      {showGreeks && (
        <>
          <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs ${ceTxt}`}>
            {fmt.dec2(row.ce.delta)}
          </td>
          <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs ${ceTxt}`}>
            {fmt.dec4(row.ce.gamma)}
          </td>
          <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs ${ceTxt}`}>
            {fmt.dec2(row.ce.theta)}
          </td>
        </>
      )}
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs font-medium border-r border-gray-700 ${ceTxt}`}>
        {fmt.price(row.ce.ltp)}
      </td>

      {/* â”€â”€ Strike center â”€â”€ */}
      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-center border-r border-gray-700 bg-gray-900/60">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5">
          <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${
            isATM     ? 'text-yellow-400' :
            isMaxPain ? 'text-purple-400' :
            'text-white'
          }`}>
            {fmt.num(row.strike)}
          </span>
          {isATM && (
            <span className="text-yellow-500 text-[9px] font-semibold tracking-wide">
              ATM
            </span>
          )}
          {isMaxPain && !isATM && (
            <span className="text-purple-400 text-[9px] font-semibold tracking-wide">
              MAX PAIN
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </td>

      {/* â”€â”€ PE side (right) â”€â”€ */}
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-medium ${peTxt}`}>
        {fmt.price(row.pe.ltp)}
      </td>
      {showGreeks && (
        <>
          <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs ${peTxt}`}>
            {fmt.dec2(row.pe.delta)}
          </td>
          <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs ${peTxt}`}>
            {fmt.dec4(row.pe.gamma)}
          </td>
          <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs ${peTxt}`}>
            {fmt.dec2(row.pe.theta)}
          </td>
        </>
      )}
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs ${peTxt}`}>
        {fmt.pct(row.pe.iv)}
      </td>
      <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-left min-w-[90px]">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${peTxt}`}>
            {fmt.oi(row.pe.oi)}
          </span>
          <OIBar oi={row.pe.oi} maxOI={maxPutOI} color="bg-green-500" />
        </div>
      </td>
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs ${peTxt}`}>
        {fmt.oi(row.pe.volume)}
      </td>
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs ${peTxt}`}>
        {fmt.oi(row.pe.oi_change)}
      </td>
      <td className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-left ${peTxt}`}>
        <OIBuildup value={row.pe.oi_buildup} />
      </td>
    </tr>
  )
}

// Main page
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export default function OptionsPage() {
  const [symbol,      setSymbol]      = useState('NIFTY')
  const [expiryIndex, setExpiryIndex] = useState(0)
  const [chain,       setChain]       = useState<ChainData | null>(null)
  const [loading,     setLoading]     = useState(false)
  const [error,       setError]       = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [lastRefresh, setLastRefresh] = useState('')
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState(false)
  const [showGreeks,  setShowGreeks]  = useState(true)

  // â”€â”€ Fetch â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const fetchChain = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `${API_BASE}/chain?symbol=${symbol}&expiry_index=${expiryIndex}`,
        { headers: HEADERS }
      )
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)
      const json = await res.json()
      if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.error || 'Unknown error')
      setChain(json.data)
      setLastRefresh(new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN'))
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load options chain')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [symbol, expiryIndex])

  // â”€â”€ Load on mount and symbol/expiry change â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  useEffect(() => { fetchChain() }, [fetchChain])

  // â”€â”€ Auto refresh every 60s â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoRefresh) return
    const id = setInterval(fetchChain, 60_000)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [autoRefresh, fetchChain])

  // â”€â”€ Derived â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const maxCallOI    = chain ? Math.max(...chain.strikes.map(s => s.ce.oi), 1) : 1
  const maxPutOI     = chain ? Math.max(...chain.strikes.map(s => s.pe.oi), 1) : 1
  const summary      = chain?.summary
  const maxPain      = summary?.max_pain ?? 0
  const underlying   = chain?.underlying_price ?? 0

  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  // Render
  // â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-arthai-dark text-white">
      <NavBar />

                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold

                    symbol === s
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar'
import StatCard from '@/components/StatCard'
import SignalCard from '@/components/SignalCard'
import {
  getSystemStatus,
  getSignalStats,
  getPortfolioSummary,
  getMarketMood,
  getTodaySignals,
  getTradeStats,
  getPsychologyState,
  getTodayLesson,
  getVixData,
} from '@/lib/api'

export default function Dashboard() {
  const [systemStatus, setSystemStatus] = useState<any>(null)
  const [signalStats, setSignalStats] = useState<any>(null)
  const [portfolio, setPortfolio] = useState<any>(null)
  const [marketMood, setMarketMood] = useState<any>(null)
  const [todaySignals, setTodaySignals] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [tradeStats, setTradeStats] = useState<any>(null)
  const [psychState, setPsychState] = useState<any>(null)
  const [lesson, setLesson] = useState<any>(null)
  const [vix, setVix] = useState<any>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [lastUpdate, setLastUpdate] = useState<Date>(new Date())

  async function loadData() {
    const [sys, sigStats, port, mood, sigs, trades, psych, les, vixData] =
      await Promise.all([
        getSystemStatus(),
        getSignalStats(),
        getPortfolioSummary(),
        getMarketMood(),
        getTodaySignals(),
        getTradeStats(),
        getPsychologyState(),
        getTodayLesson(),
        getVixData(),
      ])

    if (sys?.status) setSystemStatus(sys.status)
    if (sigStats) setSignalStats(sigStats)
    if (port?.summary) setPortfolio(port.summary)
    if (mood?.mood) setMarketMood(mood.mood)
    if (sigs?.signals) setTodaySignals(sigs.signals)
    if (trades?.stats) setTradeStats(trades.stats)
    if (psych?.state) setPsychState(psych.state)
    if (les?.lesson) setLesson(les.lesson)
    if (vixData?.vix !== undefined) setVix(vixData)
    
    setLastUpdate(new Date())
    setLoading(false)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData()
    const interval = setInterval(loadData, 60000) // Refresh every minute
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [])

  const moodColor = (mood: string) => {
    if (!mood) return 'text-gray-400'
    const m = mood.toUpperCase()
    if (m.includes('BULL') || m.includes('STRONG')) return 'text-emerald-400'
    if (m.includes('BEAR') || m.includes('PANIC')) return 'text-red-400'

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar'
import { getOpenTrades, getClosedTrades, getTradeStats, closePaperTrade } from '@/lib/api'

export default function PaperTradingPage() {
  const [openTrades, setOpenTrades] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [closedTrades, setClosedTrades] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<any>(null)
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('open')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [closingSymbol, setClosingSymbol] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ message: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null)

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [open, closed, st] = await Promise.all([
      getOpenTrades(),
      getClosedTrades(30),
      getTradeStats(),
    ])
    if (open?.trades) setOpenTrades(open.trades)
    if (closed?.trades) setClosedTrades(closed.trades)
    if (st?.stats) setStats(st.stats)
    setLoading(false)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    load()
    const interval = setInterval(load, 15000)
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [load])

  // Toast auto-dismiss
  useEffect(() => {
    if (toast) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000)
      return () => clearTimeout(t)
    }
  }, [toast])

  const handleExitTrade = async (symbol: string) => {
    if (closingSymbol) return // prevent double-click
    setClosingSymbol(symbol)

    try {
      const result = await closePaperTrade(symbol, 'MANUAL_UI_EXIT')

      if (result?.success) {
        setToast({ message: `âœ… ${symbol} position closed successfully`, type: 'success' })
        // Immediately refresh data
        await load()
      } else {
        setToast({ message: `âŒ Failed: ${result?.message || 'Unknown error'}`, type: 'error' })
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setToast({ message: `âŒ Network error closing ${symbol}`, type: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setClosingSymbol(null)
    }
  }

  const s = stats || {}

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-arthai-dark">
      <NavBar />
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">

        {/* Toast Notification */}
        {toast && (
          <div className={`fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 px-5 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border text-sm font-medium
                          transition-all duration-300 animate-slide-in
                          ${toast.type === 'success'
                            ? 'bg-emerald-900/90 border-emerald-600 text-emerald-200'
                            : 'bg-red-900/90 border-red-600 text-red-200'}`}>
            {toast.message}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Paper Trading</h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">
              Live â€¢ Updates every 15s
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 mb-6">
          {[
            { label: 'Open', value: s.open_trades || 0, color: 'text-blue-400' },
            { label: 'Wins', value: s.wins || 0, color: 'text-emerald-400' },
            { label: 'Losses', value: s.losses || 0, color: 'text-red-400' },
            {
              label: 'Win Rate',
              value: `${(s.win_rate || 0).toFixed(1)}%`,
              color: (s.win_rate || 0) >= 65 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-yellow-400'
            },
            {
              label: 'Total P&L',
              value: `â‚¹${(s.total_pnl || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(s.total_pnl || 0).toFixed(0)}`,
              color: (s.total_pnl || 0) >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-400'
            },
          ].map((item) => (
            <div key={item.label}

              <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{item.label}</div>
            </div>
          ))}

                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (

              <p className="text-sm mt-1">Closed trades will appear here</p>

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar'
import SignalCard from '@/components/SignalCard'
import { getSignals, getSignalStats, getSignalRejections } from '@/lib/api'

export default function SignalsPage() {
  const [signals, setSignals] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<any>(null)
  const [rejections, setRejections] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all')
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('signals')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  async function loadData() {
    const [sigs, sigStats, rej] = await Promise.all([
      getSignals(50),
      getSignalStats(),
      getSignalRejections(20),
    ])

    if (sigs?.signals) setSignals(sigs.signals)
    if (sigStats) setStats(sigStats)
    if (rej?.rejections) setRejections(rej.rejections)
    setLoading(false)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData()
  }, [])

  const filteredSignals = signals.filter(s => {
    if (filter === 'all') return true
    if (filter === 'BUY') return s.action === 'BUY'
    if (filter === 'SELL') return s.action === 'SELL'
    if (filter === 'strong') return s.consensus === 'STRONG_CONSENSUS'
    return true
  })

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-arthai-dark">
      <NavBar />
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6">
          Signal History
        </h1>

        {/* Stats */}
        {stats && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
            {[
              { label: 'Total', value: stats.total_signals, color: 'text-white' },
              { label: 'Avg Confidence', value: `${stats.avg_confidence?.toFixed(0)}%`, color: 'text-blue-400' },
              { label: 'Today', value: stats.today_signals, color: 'text-yellow-400' },
              { label: 'Strong', value: stats.strong_signals, color: 'text-emerald-400' },
            ].map((item) => (
              <div key={item.label} 
                   className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4 text-center">
                <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${item.color}`}>{item.value}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{item.label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
          {['signals', 'rejections'].map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t}
              onClick={() => setTab(t)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium capitalize
                         transition-colors
                         ${tab === t
                           ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                           : 'bg-gray-900 text-gray-400 hover:text-white border border-gray-800'
                         }`}
            >
              {t} {t === 'signals' ? `(${signals.length})` : `(${rejections.length})`}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {tab === 'signals' && (
          <>
            {/* Filter */}
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4 flex-wrap">
              {['all', 'BUY', 'SELL', 'strong'].map((f) => (
                <button
                  key={f}
                  onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium
                             transition-colors
                             ${filter === f
                               ? 'bg-blue-600/30 text-blue-400 border border-blue-600'
                               : 'bg-gray-900 text-gray-400 border border-gray-800 hover:text-white'
                             }`}
                >
                  {f.toUpperCase()}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-gray-500">Loading signals...</div>
            ) : filteredSignals.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {filteredSignals.map((signal, idx) => (
                  <SignalCard key={signal.id || idx} signal={signal} />
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-20 text-gray-500">
                No signals found
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {tab === 'rejections' && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {rejections.map((rej, idx) => (
              <div key={idx}
                   className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <span className="font-bold text-white">{rej.symbol}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                    {rej.created_at
                      ? new Date(rej.created_at).toLocaleString('en-IN')
                      : '--'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-red-400 mb-1">
                  Stage: {rej.stage} | Confidence: {rej.confidence?.toFixed(0)}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                  {rej.rejection_reason}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
            {rejections.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">
                No rejections recorded yet
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar'
import { getWatchlist, addToWatchlist, removeFromWatchlist } from '@/lib/api'

export default function WatchlistPage() {
  const [watchlist, setWatchlist] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [newSymbol, setNewSymbol] = useState('')
  const [newReason, setNewReason] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false)
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null)

  async function load() {
    const data = await getWatchlist()
    if (data?.watchlist) setWatchlist(data.watchlist)
    setLoading(false)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load()
    const interval = setInterval(load, 60000)
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [])

  async function handleAdd() {
    if (!newSymbol.trim()) return
    setAdding(true)
    setMessage(null)

    const result = await addToWatchlist(newSymbol.trim().toUpperCase(), newReason.trim() || undefined)

    if (result?.success) {
      setMessage({ text: `${newSymbol.toUpperCase()} added to watchlist`, type: 'success' })
      setNewSymbol('')
      setNewReason('')
      await load()
    } else {
      setMessage({ text: result?.message || 'Failed to add symbol', type: 'error' })
    }
    setAdding(false)
  }

  async function handleRemove(symbol: string) {
    const result = await removeFromWatchlist(symbol)
    if (result?.success) {
      setMessage({ text: `${symbol} removed`, type: 'success' })
      await load()
    }
  }

  // Auto clear message after 3 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (message) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setMessage(null), 3000)
      return () => clearTimeout(timer)
    }
  }, [message])

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-arthai-dark">
      <NavBar />
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-6">Watchlist</h1>

        {/* Add Symbol */}
        <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5 mb-6">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white mb-4">
            Add Stock to Watchlist
          </h2>

          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newSymbol}
              onChange={(e) => setNewSymbol(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAdd()}
              placeholder="Symbol (e.g. RELIANCE)"
              maxLength={20}
              className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg
                       px-4 py-2.5 text-white text-sm placeholder-gray-500
                       focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 transition-colors"
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newReason}
              onChange={(e) => setNewReason(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Reason (optional)"
              className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg
                       px-4 py-2.5 text-white text-sm placeholder-gray-500
                       focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 transition-colors"
            />
            <button
              onClick={handleAdd}
              disabled={adding || !newSymbol.trim()}
              className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm
                       font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50
                       disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors"
            >
              {adding ? 'Adding...' : 'Add'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Message */}
          {message && (
            <div className={`mt-3 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm
                           ${message.type === 'success'
                             ? 'bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800'
                             : 'bg-red-900/30 text-red-400 border border-red-800'}`}>
              {message.text}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Common NSE stocks hint */}
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-600">Quick add:</span>
            {['RELIANCE', 'TCS', 'HDFCBANK', 'INFY', 'ICICIBANK', 'WIPRO'].map((sym) => (
              <button
                key={sym}
                onClick={() => setNewSymbol(sym)}
                className="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-gray-800 text-gray-400
                         rounded hover:text-white hover:bg-gray-700
                         transition-colors border border-gray-700"
              >
                {sym}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Watchlist */}
        <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">
              Watching ({watchlist.length} stocks)
            </h2>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              ArthAI scans these every 15 min
            </span>
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">
              Loading watchlist...
            </div>
          ) : watchlist.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {watchlist.map((item, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between
                           bg-gray-800/50 border border-gray-700
                           rounded-xl px-4 py-3
                           hover:border-gray-600 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    {/* Symbol */}
                    <span className="font-bold text-white w-28">
                      {item.symbol}
                    </span>

                    {/* Reason */}
                    <span className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                      {item.reason || 'No reason given'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {/* Added date */}
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-600">
                      {item.added_at
                        ? new Date(item.added_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', {
                            day: 'numeric',
                            month: 'short'
                          })
                        : '--'}
                    </span>

                    {/* Status badge */}
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs
                                   bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-400
                                   border border-emerald-800/50">
                      {item.status || 'active'}
                    </span>

                    {/* Remove button */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleRemove(item.symbol)}
                      className="text-xs px-3 py-1 bg-red-900/30 text-red-400
                               border border-red-800/50 rounded-lg
                               hover:bg-red-900/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      Remove
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-16">
              <div className="text-4xl mb-3">ðŸ‘ï¸</div>
              <p className="text-gray-400 text-lg mb-2">Watchlist is empty</p>
              <p className="text-gray-600 text-sm">
                Add stocks above to monitor them for signals
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Info box */}
        <div className="mt-4 bg-blue-900/10 border border-blue-900/30
                      rounded-xl p-4">
          <p className="text-blue-400 text-sm font-medium mb-1">
            How Watchlist Works

            ArthAI already scans all Nifty 50 stocks every 15 minutes.

FILE: mjonai-dashboard\frontend_src\components\SignalCard.tsx

interface Signal {
  id?: string
  symbol: string
  action: string
  entry_price?: number
  entry_low?: number
  entry_high?: number
  stop_loss?: number
  target_1?: number
  target_2?: number
  confidence?: number
  final_confidence?: number
  consensus?: string
  risk_percent?: number
  risk_reward?: number
  market_mood?: string
  bull_verdict?: string
  bear_verdict?: string
  econ_verdict?: string
  devil_verdict?: string
  why_approved?: string
  status?: string
  trading_mode?: string
  created_at?: string
  correlation_multiplier?: number
  vix_size_multiplier?: number
  vix_regime?: string
  vix_value?: number
}

interface SignalCardProps {
  signal: Signal
}

function AgentBadge({
  agent,
  verdict
}: {
  agent: string
  verdict?: string
}) {
  const isBullish = verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('buy') ||
    verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('bullish') ||
    verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('agree') ||
    verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('failed')  // devil failed to break = good

  const isNeutral = verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('neutral') ||
    verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('caution') ||
    verdict?.toLowerCase().includes('moderate')

  const color = isBullish
    ? 'bg-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-800'
    : isNeutral
    ? 'bg-yellow-900/50 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-800'
    : 'bg-red-900/50 text-red-400 border-red-800'

  return (
    <div className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded border ${color} flex items-center gap-1`}>
      <span className="font-medium">{agent}:</span>
      <span>{verdict || 'N/A'}</span>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function SignalCard({ signal }: SignalCardProps) {
  const isBuy = signal.action === 'BUY'
  const confidence = signal.final_confidence || signal.confidence || 0
  const entry = signal.entry_price || signal.entry_low || 0
  
  const time = signal.created_at
    ? new Date(signal.created_at).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true
      })
    : '--'

  const actionColor = isBuy
    ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-600'
    : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-600'

  const confidenceColor =
    confidence >= 80 ? 'text-emerald-400' :
    confidence >= 65 ? 'text-yellow-400' :
    'text-red-400'

  return (
    <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5 
                    hover:border-blue-800 transition-all duration-200 animate-fade-in">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="text-xl font-bold text-white">{signal.symbol}</span>
          <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold border ${actionColor}`}>
            {signal.action}
          </span>
          {signal.trading_mode === 'PAPER' && (
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs bg-blue-900/50 
                           text-blue-400 border border-blue-800">
              PAPER
            </span>
          )}
          
          {/* Risk Scaling Badge (Task 2.1) */}
          {(() => {
            const corrMult = signal.correlation_multiplier ?? 1.0
            const vixMult  = signal.vix_size_multiplier ?? 1.0
            const totalMult = corrMult * vixMult
            
            if (totalMult >= 1.0) return null
            
            return (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-bold bg-orange-950/40 
                               text-orange-400 border border-orange-800"
                      title={`Final Size: ${Math.round(totalMult * 100)}%`}>
                  {(totalMult * 100).toFixed(0)}% SIZE
                </span>
                {corrMult < 1.0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-orange-500/80 font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter" title="Sector Exposure Cap">
                    [SEC-LOCK]
                  </span>
                )}
                {vixMult < 1.0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-red-500/80 font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter" title="Market Volatility Cap">
                    [VOL-LOCK]
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })()}
        </div>
        <div className="text-right">
          <div className={`text-lg font-bold ${confidenceColor}`}>
            {confidence.toFixed(0)}%
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{time}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Price Levels */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4">
        <div className="text-center">
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Entry</div>
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
            {entry ? `Rs ${entry.toFixed(0)}` : '--'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-center">
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Stop Loss</div>
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-400">
            {signal.stop_loss ? `Rs ${signal.stop_loss.toFixed(0)}` : '--'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-center">
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Target 1</div>

interface StatCardProps {
  title: string
  value: string | number
  subtitle?: string
  trend?: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral'
  color?: 'green' | 'red' | 'yellow' | 'blue' | 'purple' | 'default'
  icon?: string
}

export default function StatCard({
  title,
  value,
  subtitle,
  trend,
  color = 'default',
  icon
}: StatCardProps) {
  const colorClasses = {
    green: 'text-emerald-400',
    red: 'text-red-400',
    yellow: 'text-yellow-400',
    blue: 'text-blue-400',
    purple: 'text-purple-400',
    default: 'text-white'
  }

  const trendIcon = trend === 'up' ? 'â–²' : trend === 'down' ? 'â–¼' : 'â—'
  const trendColor = trend === 'up' 
    ? 'text-emerald-400' 
    : trend === 'down' 
    ? 'text-red-400' 
    : 'text-gray-400'

  return (
    <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl p-5 
                    hover:border-gray-700 transition-all duration-200 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm font-medium">{title}</p>
        {icon && <span className="text-xl">{icon}</span>}
      </div>
      
      <div className={`text-2xl font-bold mb-1 ${colorClasses[color]}`}>
        {value}
      </div>
      
      {subtitle && (
        <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs flex items-center gap-1">
          {trend && (
            <span className={trendColor}>{trendIcon}</span>
          )}
          {subtitle}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * ArthAI API Client
 * All API calls go through this file
 */

const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000'
const API_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY || 'arthai-personal-key-2024'

const headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': API_KEY,
}

async function fetchAPI(endpoint: string, options?: RequestInit) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${endpoint}`, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        ...headers,
        ...options?.headers,
      },
    })

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`API Error: ${response.status}`)
    }

    return await response.json()
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`API call failed for ${endpoint}:`, error)
    return null
  }
}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/**
 * ArthAI WebSocket Client
 * Real-time updates from backend
 */

const WS_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL || 'ws://localhost:8000/ws'
const API_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY || 'arthai-personal-key-2024'

type MessageHandler = (data: any) => void

class ArthAIWebSocket {
  private ws: WebSocket | null = null
  private handlers: Map<string, MessageHandler[]> = new Map()
  private reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
  private reconnectDelay = 3000
  private isConnected = false

  connect() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
    
    try {
      this.ws = new WebSocket(WS_URL)
      
      this.ws.onopen = () => {
        console.log('ArthAI WebSocket connected')
        // Send auth immediately
        this.ws?.send(JSON.stringify({ api_key: API_KEY }))
      }
      
      this.ws.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(event.data)
          
          if (data.type === 'connected') {
            this.isConnected = true
            console.log('ArthAI WebSocket authenticated')
            return
          }
          
          if (data.type === 'heartbeat' || data.type === 'pong') {
            return
          }
          
          // Dispatch to type-specific handlers
          const typeHandlers = this.handlers.get(data.type) || []
          const allHandlers = this.handlers.get('*') || []
          
          ;[...typeHandlers, ...allHandlers].forEach(handler => {
            try {
              handler(data)
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('WebSocket handler error:', e)
            }
          })
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('WebSocket parse error:', e)
        }
      }
      
      this.ws.onclose = () => {
        this.isConnected = false
        console.log('ArthAI WebSocket disconnected, reconnecting...')
        this.scheduleReconnect()
      }
      
      this.ws.onerror = (error) => {
        console.error('ArthAI WebSocket error:', error)
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('WebSocket connection failed:', e)
      this.scheduleReconnect()
    }
  }

  private scheduleReconnect() {
    if (this.reconnectTimer) return
    this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.reconnectTimer = null
      this.connect()
    }, this.reconnectDelay)
  }

  on(type: string, handler: MessageHandler) {
    const existing = this.handlers.get(type) || []
    this.handlers.set(type, [...existing, handler])
  }

  off(type: string, handler: MessageHandler) {
    const existing = this.handlers.get(type) || []
    this.handlers.set(type, existing.filter(h => h !== handler))
  }

  ping() {
    this.ws?.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'ping' }))
  }

  disconnect() {
    if (this.reconnectTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer)
      this.reconnectTimer = null
    }
    this.ws?.close()
    this.ws = null
    this.isConnected = false
  }

  get connected() {
    return this.isConnected
  }
}

// Singleton
export const arthaiWS = new ArthAIWebSocket()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ==============================================================================
# MJONAI 1-CLICK ORACLE CLOUD LINUX VM (UBUNTU 22.04/24.04) SETUP SCRIPT
# ==============================================================================

set -e

echo "======================================================="
echo "Setting up MJONAI Live Production Environment on Oracle Linux..."
echo "======================================================="

# 1. Update OS packages & install build essentials
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y
sudo apt install -y software-properties-common curl git build-essential ufw

# 2. Install Python 3.11 & venv
sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:deadsnakes/ppa
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y python3.11 python3.11-venv python3.11-dev

# 3. Create clean Linux virtual environment
if [ ! -d ".venv" ]; then
    echo "Creating Python 3.11 virtual environment..."
    python3.11 -m venv .venv
fi

# 4. Install & Upgrade Python Dependencies
echo "Installing MJONAI requirements..."
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 5. Verify Installation
.venv/bin/python -c "import pandas, numpy, scipy, duckdb, pyarrow, yfinance, fastapi, uvicorn, SmartApi, pyotp; print('ALL ORACLE LINUX PACKAGES VERIFIED 100% OPERATIONAL!')"

# 6. Configure Systemd Daemon Service
echo "Configuring MJONAI systemd background service..."
sudo cp scripts/mjonai.service /etc/systemd/system/
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable mjonai.service

echo "======================================================="
echo "MJONAI Oracle Cloud Linux Setup Complete!"
echo "To start the background trading service: sudo systemctl start mjonai"
echo "To view live logs: sudo journalctl -u mjonai -f"
echo "======================================================="

# ==============================================================================
# MJONAI 1-CLICK WINDOWS ENVIRONMENT SETUP SCRIPT
# ==============================================================================

Write-Host "=======================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Setting up MJONAI Unified Environment for Windows 11..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "=======================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 1. Check Python 3.11
$pythonPath = (Get-Command py).Source
if (-not $pythonPath) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: Python launcher 'py' not found. Please install Python 3.11+." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# 2. Create Virtual Environment
if (-not (Test-Path ".venv")) {
    Write-Host "Creating clean Python 3.11 virtual environment in .venv..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    py -3.11 -m venv .venv
} else {
    Write-Host "Found existing .venv directory." -ForegroundColor Green
}

# 3. Upgrade pip and install requirements
Write-Host "Installing pinned dependencies from requirements.txt..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 4. Verify Installation
Write-Host "Verifying environment packages..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import pandas, numpy, scipy, duckdb, pyarrow, yfinance, fastapi, uvicorn, SmartApi, pyotp; print('ALL CORE PACKAGES VERIFIED 100% OPERATIONAL!')"

Write-Host "To activate in PowerShell: .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1" -ForegroundColor Cyan
